Kaadi zikwataganyizibwa ku ID, oba ku nnamba ya kaadi n'erinnya; kaadi ezitakwatagana ziwandiikibwa era zirekebwa nga bwe ziri. Sooka olabe ekyokulabirako okulaba ekigenda okukyuka.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprints: __created__ empya, __matched__ eziri dda ku lubaawo luno, __skipped__ ezitayingiziddwa
scrum-import-preview-releases: Ebifulumizibwa: __created__ ebipya, __matched__ ebiri dda ku lubaawo luno, __skipped__ ebitayingiziddwa
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Tewali kya kukyusa: olubaawo luno lulina dda entegeka eno.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Entegeka ya Scrum eyingiziddwa era ewandiikiddwa mu Byafaayo.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Kaadi ekwatagana ne kaadi ezisukka mu emu ku lubaawo luno: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Kaadi ya lubaawo lulala era erekeddwa nga bw'eri: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Sprint oba ekifulumizibwa kikwatagana n'ebisukka mu kimu ku lubaawo luno: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Sprint, ekifulumizibwa oba omukolo tebyasobodde kuyingizibwa: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Londa omuwendo ku buli butakkaanya. Sync eddamu okugezaako oluvannyuma lwa buli kulonda. Tewali kiweerezebwa eri enkola ensibuko.
sync-conflict-refresh: Ddamu odduke Sync okwekenneenya emiwendo egiriwo kati.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Kaadi eziweereddwa ggwe zeekenneenyezeddwa. Tewakyali butakkaanya bwa nnimiro. Sync y'olukalala olujjuvu teyadduse.
sync-conflict-keep-mapping: Kaadi eno ejja kusigala nga ekwataganyizibwa
sync-conflict-detach: Kuuma eddiŋŋana nga kaadi ey'omu kifo
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Ggyawo okugatta kwa Sync okw'eddiŋŋana lino lyokka. Ebirimu bisigala mu WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Okuteeka mu Tterekero kuziyiziddwa kaadi entono ezikola
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Ekintu ensibuko kyagenda, naye kaadi entono ezikola ziziyiza okuteeka mu Tterekero. Kuuma kaadi eno mu kifo kyo ng'oggyawo okugatta kwayo kwa Sync. Kaadi entono tezikyusibwa.
sync-conflict-keep-card-local: Kuuma kaadi eno mu kifo kyo
sync-conflict-creation: Kola kaadi ya Sync ey'okudda mu kifo
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Kuuma kaadi eyasooka nga bw'eri era okole kaadi ya Sync empya mu lukalala luno. Okuddamu okugezaako kukozesa nate eyo edda mu kifo.
sync-preview-saved: Kisinziira ku ntegeka eziterekeddwa. Sync kati ekima era n'ekebera ensibuko nate.
sync-preview-unavailable: Tereka ensibuko ya Sync nga tonnasaba kyakulabirako.
sync-preview-blocked: Gonjoola obutakkaanya obuli wansi nga tonneekenneenya nteekateeka y'enkyukakyuka.
sync-preview-scope: Emiwendo gikwata ku nnimiro z'ensibuko ezitegekeddwa. Data endala eyinza okulekebwa ekisoma ensibuko.
sync-source-scope: Amakubo gagatta ennimiro we zirabikira mu bintu by'ensibuko. Ebintu ebitagattiddwa byalangirirwa nga byonna; emiwendo gyabyo tegiragibwa.
sync-source-converted: Kikyusiddwa okufuuka ebigambo oba engeri endala
sync-source-occurrences: Ennimiro oba ebintu ebyalangiriddwa we birabikira
sync-source-truncated: Alipoota ekomeddwa ku makubo 100 n'amannya g'ennimiro agasaliddwako.
sync-report-retention: Okudduka 20 okusembyeyo. Alipoota zikuumibwa okumala ennaku 30.
sync-report-partial: Okudduka okwalemye oba okutaggwa kuyinza okuba nga kwakyusa kaadi ezimu. Alipoota zino tezizza mu maaso wadde okusazaamu okudduka.
sync-report-unfinished: Kikyagenda mu maaso oba kyasalibwako; ekivuddemu tekiwandiikiddwa
sync-report-unavailable: Alipoota z'okudduka zeetaaga olukusa lw'okuwandiika ku lukalala lwonna ne seva eriwo.
sync-recovery-description: Alipoota za Sync ezikuumiddwa okuva mu nnaku 30 ezisembyeyo. Noonya ku ID y'olubaawo oba y'olukalala. Ekivuddemu ekitaggwa kiyinza okuba nga kikyadduka oba kyasalibwako. Zza obuggya okukebera nate; alipoota zino tezisobola kuzza mu maaso wadde okusazaamu enkyukakyuka.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Tekisoboka kusoma kwekebejja kwa Sync. Kebera olukusa lw'omuddukanya n'oba seva eriwo.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Londa ennimiro ey'ennamba erina ID y'ennimiro ya Jira n'ekipimo ky'okubalirira, nga bwe yakolebwa okuyingiza kwa Jira okugattiddwa. Enkyukakyuka ez'omu kifo zeekenneenyezebwa nga obutakkaanya. Emiwendo gy'ensibuko egibulawo gibuusibwa amaaso; null eyogeddwa obulungi esiimuula omuwendo ogugattiddwa.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Obuzito oba okubalirira kw’obudde kwa GitLab kuwandiikibwa mu kifo ky’ennamba ky’olonda. Enkyukakyuka ez’awano zeekenneenyezebwa ng’obutakkaanya; ensonga etaliiko buzito esangula omuwendo ogugattiddwa.
email-recovery-description: Olunyiriri lumu ku buli afuna obubaka. Noonya ng'okozesa ID y'omukozesa. Ebirimu mu bubaka n'ebifo by'imeyilo y'afuna obubaka tebiragibwa. Okuyimiriza okumala akaseera kukwata obubaka obuliwo n'obujja; Okugenda mu maaso kuddamu okugezaako okuweereza obubaka obuli mu lunyiriri kati. Okusazaamu kuggyawo obubaka obwateekebwa mu lunyiriri okutuuka ku ssaawa y'okusaba. Bwe kiba nti okuweereza kukyagenda mu maaso, gezaako nate oluvannyuma lw'akaseera. Obubaka obwatandise okuweerezebwa tebusobola kukomezebwawo, era okuweereza okutakakasiddwa kusobola okuddamu. Okulemererwa okw'olubeerera n'obubaka obutuuse ku kkomo ly'okugezaako bisigalawo okwekebejjebwa. Okuddamu okugezaako obubaka obwalemererwa kutandika oluzingulula olupya olw'okugezaako era kukuuma okuyimiriza okw'akaseera okuliwo.
email-recovery-changed: Enkyukakyuka esembayo ey'omukozi akola ku nkola
email-recovery-empty: Tewali bubaka mu lunyiriri era tewali bafuna obubaka abayimiriziddwa okuweerezebwa okumala akaseera.
email-recovery-unavailable: Tekisobose okusoma olunyiriri lw'imeyilo. Kebera olukusa lw'omuddukanya n'okuba nti seva esobola okutuukibwako.
email-recovery-busy: Okuweereza oba omulimu omulala ogw'olunyiriri gukolebwa. Zza buggya era gezaako nate oluvannyuma lw'akaseera.
email-recovery-failed: Omulimu tegusobose kukakasibwa. Zza olunyiriri buggya era gezaako nate ekikolwa kye kimu bwe kiba kyetaagisa.
email-recovery-superseded: Ekikolwa ekipya eky'omukozi akola ku nkola kizzewo okusaba kuno. Embeera y'olunyiriri eya kati eragibwa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Sazaamu obubaka bwonna obuli mu lunyiriri kati obw'omuntu ono? Ebirimu bijja kuggyibwawo era tebisobola kukomezebwawo. Obubaka obupya obukoleddwa oluvannyuma lw'okusaba kuno bujja kusigalawo.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Okutuusa tekwasobodde kukakasibwa; kyekenneenye nga tonnaddamu kugezaako
sync-time-estimate-hint: Okubalirira kw'obudde kukozesa ennimiro ez'ennamba ez'obudde obwasooka/obusigaddeyo ezaakolebwa okuyingiza kwa Jira. Ennimiro emu yokka ekwatagana erina okubeera ku lubaawo luno. Enkyukakyuka ez'omu kifo zeekenneenyezebwa nga obutakkaanya; emiwendo gy'ensibuko egibulawo gibuusibwa amaaso era null eyogeddwa obulungi esiimuula omuwendo.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint n'ebifulumizibwa bikwataganyizibwa nga Scrum ekoleezeddwa ku lubaawo luno kyokka. Sprint oba ekifulumizibwa ekibulawo kikolebwa ku lubaawo luno, n'ennaku ensibuko z'ewa; ekiriwo kikwataganyizibwa ku ID yaakyo ey'ensibuko okusooka, oluvannyuma ku linnya. Enkyukakyuka y'entegeka ey'omu kifo esigalawo okutuusa ensibuko lw'ekyusa entegeka y'ensonga eyo, era Sync esooka tegiggyawo ntegeka.
activity-recovery-description: Obubaka obutaggwa buddamu okugezesebwa mu ngeri ey'otoma. Ekenneenya emirimu egibulawo oba egikyusiddwa nga tonnaddamu kugezaako. Okuddamu okugezaako tekuddamu kukola mulimu.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Tekisobose kufuna bubaka bwa mirimu obulindiridde.
activity-recovery-busy: Omukozi omulala akola ku bubaka buno. Zza obuggya oddemu ogezeeko.
activity-recovery-denied: Olukusa lw'afuna oba by'ayagala ku bubaka tebikyakkiriza kutuusa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Omulimu ogwasooka gubulawo oba gukyusiddwa. Tewali kyaddamu kukolebwa.
activity-recovery-failed: Tekisobose kumaliriza kutuusa bubaka. Omulimu ogulindiridde gukuumiddwa.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Obubaka buno bwakyuse okuva lwe bwafunibwa. Ekenneenya embeera empya nga tonnaddamu kugezaako.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Tekisobose kukakasa ntegeka ya kutuusa. Zza obuggya era wekenneenye embeera yaayo eriwo kati.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Sazaamu ddala okutuusa okusigaddeyo okw'omulimu guno? Kino tekisobola kuddamu kutandikibwa. Imeyilo ezaali ziteekeddwa dda mu lunyiriri n'obubaka obwatuusibwa tebiddizibwayo.
rule-email-recovery-description: Kebera okugezaako okuwandiikiddwa okw'okusindika imeyilo z'amateeka. Okugezaako okutannakakasibwa kuyinza okuba nga kukyasindika oba nga kwataataaganyizibwa. Ggulawo okugezaako kumu ne «Kebera» okukuddamu okusindika, okukussaako akabonero nti kwasindikiddwa oba okukusazaamu.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Tewali kugezaako kusindika imeyilo z'amateeka kukwatagana na kunoonya kuno.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Tekisobose kufuna kugezaako kwa imeyilo za mateeka. Zza obuggya oddemu ogezeeko.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan teddamu kusindika imeyilo etennakakasibwa ku bwayo. Okuddamu okusindika kuba eri abafuna abatannakakasibwa bokka. Gisseeko akabonero nti yasindikiddwa bw'oba omanyi nti yatuuse, oba gisazeemu.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Okusindika okwasooka kuyinza okuba nga kukyagenda mu maaso. Osobola okusalawo oluvannyuma lwa __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Ddamu osindikire abafuna abatannakakasibwa imeyilo eno? Buli muntu ajja kugifuna emirundi ebiri singa seva ye eya imeyilo yagikkiriza nga WeKan temanyisiddwa.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Teeka ku imeyilo eno akabonero nti yasindikiddwa eri bonna? Kino kikole bw'oba omanyi nti yatuuse kyokka.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Osazeemu imeyilo eno? Tejja kusindikibwa eri abafuna abatannakakasibwa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Okusindika okwasooka kuyinza okuba nga kukyagenda mu maaso. Gezako nate oluvannyuma.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Okuddamu okusindika okw'emabega kuyinza okuba nga kukyagenda mu maaso. Gezako nate oluvannyuma.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Buli afuna yakakasibwa dda. Gisseeko akabonero nti yasindikiddwa mu kifo ky'okuddamu okugisindika.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva ya imeyilo teyazzeemu. Imeyilo eyaddamu okusindikibwa eyinza okuba nga yatuuse oba nga tetuuse; eragibwa ng'ekyagenda mu maaso.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Omuddukanya omulala akola ku imeyilo eno. Gezako nate mu kaseera katono.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeyilo eterekeddwa tekyakwatagana na kugezaako kuno, n'olwekyo tesobola kukolebwako wano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Ebiwandiiko ebyaterekebwa ku kugezaako kuno si bituufu, n'olwekyo tekusobola kukolebwako wano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Tekisobose kukola ku imeyilo eno. Ddamu otikke era ogezeeko nate.
rule-email-legacy-description: Imeyilo z'amateeka zino zategekebwa enkyusa ya WeKan ey'edda etaawandiika nsibuko y'ebizirimu, n'olwekyo WeKan tejja kuzisindika ku bwayo. Sooka okebere oba eyakola etteeka akyalina olukusa okuyingira, olwo oddemu okuyunga imeyilo etegekebwe nate okuva ku kaadi nga bw'eri kati, oba gisuule.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Ebikwata ku kaadi okuva mu nkyusa ey'edda
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Ddamu otegeke imeyilo eno okuva ku kaadi nga bw'eri kati? Ebigirimu biyinza okwawukana ku ebyategekebwa emabega.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Osuule imeyilo eno? Tegenda kusindikibwa n'akatono.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Tekisobose kutikka imeyilo z'amateeka ezirindirira okukeberebwa. Ddamu otikke ogezeeko nate.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Eyakola etteeka takyalina lukusa okuyingira ku kaadi eno, oba etteeka lyakyuka, n'olwekyo imeyilo tesobola kuddamu kuyungibwa. Osobola okugisuula.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Ekikolwa ekyatandika imeyilo eno kyakyuka, n'olwekyo tesobola kuddamu kuyungibwa. Osobola okugisuula.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kaadi imeyilo eno kwe yava tekyaliwo, n'olwekyo tesobola kuddamu kuyungibwa. Osobola okugisuula.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Okuddukanya etteeka okwategeka imeyilo eno tekukyali mu biterekeddwa, n'olwekyo tesobola kuddamu kuyungibwa. Osobola okugisuula.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imeyilo eno yasindikibwa dda, yagezesebwa okusindikibwa, oba yasuulibwa.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Tekisobose kumaliriza kikolwa kino. Ddamu otikke era ogezeeko nate.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Emirimu gya List Sync egitasobola kuddamu kukolebwa
stuck-sync-operation-description: Buli gumu ku mirimu gino egya List Sync egyaterekebwa gwayimirira wakati era tegukyasobola kumalirizibwa, kubanga olukalala lwagwo lwaggyibwawo, lwaddamu okukolebwa oba lwaddamu okutegekebwa, oba omukozesa eyagutandika yafiirwa olukusa lw'okuwandiika. Nga waliwo gumu ogulindiridde, olukalala olwo terusobola kukola Sync. Gusuule okuleka olukalala okuddamu okukola Sync: enkyukakyuka ezaali zikoleddwa dda zisigalawo, enkyukakyuka ezaaterekebwa ezisigaddeyo teziwandiikibwa n'akatono, era Sync eddako egeraageranya olukalala n'ensibuko yaalwo nate.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Olukalala lwaggyibwawo, lwaddamu okukolebwa oba entegeka zaalwo eza Sync zaakyuka
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Omukozesa eyagutandika takyalina lukusa lwa kuwandiika ku lukalala lwonna
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Gwaterekebwa WeKan version eyasooka nga tegulina ekyagutandika
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Gusobola okuddamu okukolebwa kati era gujja kuggwa gwokka, kale tegusobola kusuulibwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Suula omulimu guno ogwa List Sync ogwaterekebwa? Enkyukakyuka gwe gwali gukoze dda zisigalawo; ezisigaddeyo teziwandiikibwa n'akatono. Olukalala lusobola okuddamu okukola Sync.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Tewali mirimu gya List Sync egirindiridde kwekenneenyezebwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: 50 egisinga obukadde gyokka gye giragiddwa. Suula egimu ozze obuggya okulaba egisingawo.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Tekisobose kufuna mirimu gya List Sync. Zza obuggya oddemu ogezeeko.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Omulimu guno tegusangiddwa nga gusibye, kale tegusobola kusuulibwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Omulimu guno gusobola okuddamu okukolebwa kati era gujja kuggwa gwokka, kale tegwasuuliddwa.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Olukalala luno lukola Sync kati. Ddamu ogezeeko mu kaseera.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Tekisobose kumaliriza kikolwa kino. Ddamu otikke era ogezeeko nate.
interrupted-import-description: Buli kumu ku kuyingiza embaawo kuno kwayimirira wakati - seva yaddamu okutandika, oba okuyingiza kwalemwa - era kwaleka olubaawo olw'ekitundu. Okuyingiza tekusobola kugenda mu maaso, kubanga fayiro yaakwo ensibuko tekuumibwa. Kuuma olubaawo nga bwe luli, oba lusuule oddemu oyingize fayiro. Okusuula kuggyawo olubaawo okuyingiza kuno lwe kwakola na buli kimu ekiriko, nga mw'otwalidde buli kimu ekyalwongerwako okuva olwo.
interrupted-import-scrum: Omutendera gwakwo ogwa Scrum gulina ekifo kyagwo eky'okukebera (__state__, __next__ ku mitendera __total__). Bw'okuuma olubaawo, kumaliriza oba kusuule okuva mu kuzzaawo okuyingiza kwa Scrum okw'olubaawo.
interrupted-import-counts: Obukubo __swimlanes__, enkalala __lists__, kaadi __cards__, enkalala z'okukebera __checklists__, endowooza __comments__, ebiyungiddwako __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Kuuma olubaawo luno olw'ekitundu nga bwe luli? Tewali kiggyibwawo, era okuyingiza tekukyawandiikibwa wano.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Suula okuyingiza kuno? Olubaawo lwe kwakola na buli kimu ekiriko biggyibwawo ddala.
interrupted-import-empty: Tewali kuyingiza mbaawo okwasalibwako okulindiridde kwekenneenyezebwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: 50 egisinga obukadde gyokka gye giragiddwa. Kuuma oba suula egimu ozze obuggya okulaba egisingawo.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Tekisobose kufuna kuyingiza mbaawo okwasalibwako. Zza obuggya oddemu ogezeeko.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Olubaawo olulina id eno terwakolebwa kuyingiza kuno, kale terwakwatiddwako.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Omutendera gwakwo ogwa Scrum gukyawandiikibwa oba gukyazzibwawo. Ddamu ogezeeko mu dakiika ntono.
interrupted-import-failed: Tekisobose kumaliriza kikolwa kino. Ddamu otikke era ogezeeko nate.
saml-login-not-started: Okuyingira kuno okwa SAML tekwatandikidde mu tabu eno eya bulawuza. Ddamu oyingire.
history-request-pending-undo: Seva tennakakasa kukomyawo mabega kwo okusembyeyo.
history-request-pending-redo: Seva tennakakasa kuddamu kukola kwo okusembyeyo.
history-request-hint: Bw'oddamu okugezaako, osindika okusaba kwe kumu nate, kale tekisobola kukomyawo mabega nkyukakyuka ya kubiri.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Okuddayo, okuddamu oba okuzzaawo enkyukakyuka za Scrum kwayimiridde ku butakkaanya. Okukyusa Scrum ku lubaawo luno kuziyiziddwa okutuusa nga kugonjoddwa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Enkyukakyuka __applied__ ku __total__ zaawandiikibwa, __pending__ tezaawandiikibwa, ate __conflicted__ zaakyusibwa omuntu omulala okuva olwo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Okuzza emabega kuzzaawo buli kiwandiiko ekyakyusibwa nga bwe kyali edda; kuweebwa kyokka nga tewali muntu mulala eyakyusa ebiwandiiko ebyo okuva olwo. Okukuuma olubaawo nga bwe luli kuggyawo omulimu ogwayimiridde era tekukyusa biwandiiko. Mu ngeri zombi, kiwandiikibwa mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya, Ebizibu, Okuzzaawo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Kuuma buli kiwandiiko nga bwe kiri kati, nga mw'otwalidde enkyukakyuka omulimu ogwayimiridde ze gwali guwandiise dda?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Omuddukanya olubaawo asobola okukizza emabega oba okukuuma olubaawo nga bwe luli.
header-login: Okuyingira okuyita mu mitwe gya HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Ggyawo omuwendo oguterekeddwa mu kifo ky'abaddukanya
login-setting-after-restart: Kitandika okukola nga WeKan etandikiddwa buto
login-setting-env-only: Embeera ya seva yokka y'eteekawo bino. Biragiddwa wano nga bya kusoma kwokka.
email-to-card-description: Imeyilo esindikiddwa ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo lwo efuuka ekaadi ku lubaawo olwo.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook y'imeyilo eziyingira okuva ku mugabi (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark oba MIME relay embisi)
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Olubaawo imeyilo ezisindikibwa ku grain eno gye zigenda
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Tewali - imeyilo zokka ezirina akabonero k'olubaawo mu subject
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Teeka kino mu subject okutuuka ku lubaawo luno nga ggwe:
email-to-card-address-private: Gikuume nga ya kyama: buli agirina asobola okwongerako kaadi nga ggwe.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Okufuna imeyilo tekuteekeddwateekeddwa mu Kifo ky'abaddukanya.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Omuddukanya w'olubaawo tannaggulawo imeyilo ku lubaawo luno.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Waggyako endagiriro z'embaawo zo mu Ntegeka za Bamemba.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain tennafuna ndagiriro yaayo ey'imeyilo. Ddamu otikke omuko.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Weetaaga olukusa okuwandiika ku lubaawo luno.
inbound-domain-invalid: Eryo si linnya lya domain ettuufu.
inbound-account-invalid: Bbokisi ya IMAP yeetaaga erinnya lya seva ettuufu.
feature-views-email-desc: Olubaawo ng'ekisanduuko ky'ebbaluwa: olukalala lw'imeyilo lwe Kisanduuko ekiyingira, enkalala ze fayiro, obubonero bwe bubonero, era abamemba bawandiika era baddamu imeyilo okuva ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo.
email-view-not-receiving: Olubaawo luno terunnafuna imeyilo. Lukoleeze mu Nteekateeka z'obubaka bw'olubaawo → Imeyilo okufuuka ekaadi.
email-view-invalid-address: Endagiriro emu si ndagiriro ya imeyilo ntuufu.
email-view-too-many: Imeyilo nnyingi nnyo zaweerezeddwa mu ssaawa ewedde. Gezaako oluvannyuma.
feature-views-chat-desc: Olubaawo ng'ekifo eky'okunyumyiramu: ebifo by'emirimu, embaawo, obukubo, enkalala n'ekaadi ng'omuti gw'emikutu, ekaadi wakati n'endowooza zaayo ng'obubaka bw'okunyumya.
chat-view-pick-card: Londa ekaadi okuva mu mikutu okugiraba wano.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Kaadi ze zimu mu bibinja by'empagi ebiwerako ebirina amannya - okusinziira ku kumaliriza, obukulu, omutendera oba ekirala kyonna - zisengulwa wakati w'empagi nga zisikibwa.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu ya bboodi → Amateeka gaweereza amateeka okuva ku bantu bye bakola n'omukono emirundi mingi.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu ya bboodi → Mu bufunze kiraga buli muntu ky'akoze ku bboodi ku lunaku oba wiiki esembayo, n'ebyayitako ekiseera.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu ya bboodi → Okuva lwe wasembayo okujja kiraga abalala bye bakyusizza ku bboodi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Okunoonya okwa wonna kutegeera ebigambo nga "kaadi zange eziyise ekiseera".
column-sets-empty: Tewannabaawo bibinja by'empagi. Omuddukanya w'olubaawo asobola okukola kimu: kituume erinnya, oluvannyuma ogattako empagi zaakyo.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Olubaawo ng'ekikebera ensonga za GitHub oba Gitea: kaadi ng'ensonga, obubonero n'ebituuko, endowooza ng'emboozi, ebiyungiddwako ng'efayiro, n'ebyafaayo by'olubaawo n'okuzzaayo.
vcs-no-milestones: Tewannabaawo bituuko. Akabonero akalina olunaku olusembayo kye kituuko.
vcs-no-list: Olubaawo luno terulina lukalala wadde ekkubo ery'ensonga.
card-qr-code-desc: Gikebere okuggulawo kaadi eno ku ssimu oba ku tabuleti.
card-qr-code-too-long: Enyunzi ya kaadi eno mpanvu nnyo ku koodi ya QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Tewannabaawo wiki. Okuyingiza ekibiina kya GitHub kuleeta wiki ya tterekero wano.
github-org-import-desc: Buli tterekero ly'ekibiina oba ly'omukozesa lifuuka lubaawo lwalyo, oluggulwa mu Board View / Version Control: ensonga zaalyo n'endowooza zaazo, obubonero ne fayiro, ebifulumiziddwa byalyo, enkola za GitHub Actions zaalyo nga Mateeka, ne wiki yaalyo.
github-org-import-token-hint: Kyetaagisa ku materekero ag'ekyama n'ekkomo lya API erisingako. Kikozesebwa kyokka ng'okuyingiza kukyagenda mu maaso era tekiterekebwa n'akatono.
github-org-import-actions: Enkola za GitHub Actions nga Mateeka
github-org-import-result: Ensonga %s, ebifulumiziddwa %s, amateeka %s, empapula za wiki %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Wandiika erinnya ly'ekibiina oba ery'omukozesa, oba endagiriro yaakyo eya GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: REST API ezifaanana nga API z'ebirondoozi ebirala, apps zaabwe ne scripts zisobole okukozesa WeKan eno ng'emabega lyazo: bye zitereka biterekebwa mu WeKan, ku mbaawo za WeKan. Buli emu eba nzikize okutuusa lw'eteekebwako akabonero wano. Tewali n'emu erina obuyinza bwayo: kasitoma ayingira ne token ya API eya WeKan era asobola okulaba n'okukyusa ebyo byokka omuntu oyo by'asobola okulaba n'okukyusa mu WeKan. Zonna zeetaaga WeKan REST API okuba nga ekola (WITH_API=true). Endagiriro eri wansi wa buli emu y'eyo kasitoma gy'akozesa nga seva ye.
optional-api-trello-desc: Apps ne scripts ezaawandiikibwa ku lwa REST API ya Trello (okugeza Trellinator) zikola ne WeKan: embaawo, enkalala, kaadi, obubonero, abamemba, endowooza n'enkalala z'okukebera. Token ya Trello ye token ya API eya WeKan. Okusazaamu kaadi kugitwala mu tterekero mu WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Bakasitoma ba REST API v2 eya Jira bakola ne WeKan: pulojekiti lubaawo (ekisumuluzo kyayo kye kisumuluzo ky'olubaawo), ensonga ye kaadi (DEV-7), embeera lwe lukalala, era enkyukakyuka etambuza kaadi. Okunoonya kukkiriza JQL ennyangu: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ne ORDER BY. Yingira ne token ya API eya WeKan ng'ekigambo ky'okuyingira. Okusazaamu ensonga kugitwala mu tterekero.
optional-api-github-desc: Bakasitoma ba REST API ya GitHub ku nsonga bakola ne WeKan: etterekero lya koodi lubaawo, ensonga ye kaadi, n'obubonero, ebituuko (obubonero obulina olunaku olw'enkomerero), endowooza, n'okuba nga eggule oba eggale nga mu Endaba y'olubaawo / Okufuga enkyusa. Token ye token ya API eya WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Bakasitoma ba REST API ya Gitea ne Forgejo ku nsonga bakola ne WeKan mu ngeri y'emu nga API ekwatagana ne GitHub: etterekero lya koodi lubaawo ate ensonga ye kaadi. Token ye token ya API eya WeKan.
bots-none: Tewannabaawo bboti. Bboti kidduka ku seeva yo - omukozi wa AI, omulimu gwa CI, sikulipiti - olubaawo luno lwe luwa kaadi.
bot-not-found: Bboti eyo teri ku lubaawo luno.
bot-option-not-found: Okuddamu okwo si kwe bboti yawaayo.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks ezifuluma tezisobola kutuuka ku ndagiriro eziri ku mukutu gwa WeKan gwennyini, waleme kubaawo muntu yenna asobola okulaga webhook y'olubaawo ku mpeereza ey'omunda. Wandiika wano ba host abali ku mukutu ogwo webhooks be zisobola okutuukako - Node-RED, seva y'okunyumya - omu ku buli lunyiriri, ng'erinnya oba ndagiriro, ne port okukkiriza port eyo yokka. Kikalu: tewali. Abaddukanya omukutu bokka be basobola okukyusa olukalala luno.
account-webhook-desc: Endagiriro emu WeKan gy'etegeeza ng'omuntu ayingidde oba ng'akawunti empya ekoleddwa. Tewali kiweerezebwa okutuusa ng'ekibaddewo wansi kiteereddwako akabonero. Etwala ekibaddewo, erinnya ly'omukozesa n'obudde; teeka akabonero ku bifo ebirala singa oyo afuna abyetaaga.
account-webhook-field-ip: Endagiriro ya IP okuyingira gye kwavudde
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Sazaamu obubaka bwonna obulindiridde obw'emirimu egisukka ennaku mmeka?
vcs-synced-from: Kwataganyiziddwa okuva ku %s: giggulire era ogiggalire eyo.
vcs-synced-issue: Ensonga eno ekwataganyiziddwa: giggulire era ogiggalire mu nkola yaayo egigoberera.
sync-write-back: Wandiika enkyukakyuka okudda ku GitLab: omutwe, ennyonyola, endowooza, okuggalawo n'okuddamu okuggulawo
email-bounces-description: Ekyo WeKan ky'ekola ku imeyilo ezikomawo: endagiriro ewandiikiddwa obubi, ebbokisi ejjudde, okuddamu nti omuntu taliiwo, okwemulugunya ku spam. Buli kika kirina ebikolwa byakyo, ebikolebwa nga kikomyewo emirundi egyo.
email-bounces-enabled: Kola ku imeyilo ezikomawo mu WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Lekera awo okuweereza imeyilo ku ndagiriro eno
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Endagiriro teriiwo: ensobi mu kuwandiika, akawunti esaziddwamu, domain etamanyiddwa.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Tetuuse kati: ebbokisi ejjudde, seva erina emirimu mingi. Emirundi mingi egiddiringana gyokka gye gitegeeza ekintu.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Okuddamu nti omuntu taliiwo, ali mu luwummula oba okuva mu nkola ya tikiti. Imeyilo yatuuka.
email-bounces-ses-description: Mu Amazon SES, weereza obubaka bwa Bounce ne Complaint, n'etteeka ly'okufuna ku ndagiriro WeKan gy'eweerereza, ku mutwe gwa SNS, era wandiisa endagiriro eno ku gwo ng'oyita mu HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN z'emitwe gya SNS ez'okukkiriza, emu ku buli lunyiriri
email-bounces-stopped-only: Endagiriro zokka WeKan z'etaweereza imeyilo nate
email-bounces-clear-hint: Erabira okukomawo kw'endagiriro eno era ogiweereze imeyilo nate
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Ekyo si ARN y'omutwe gwa SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: WeKan bw'eba eweereza ng'eyita mu emu ku mpeereza zino, gikoleeze, wa empeereza endagiriro eno eya webhook ku bintu byayo eby'imeyilo ezikomawo n'okwemulugunya ku spam, era wano teekamu ekisumuluzo ky'ekozesa okubiteekako omukono, oba ekigambo ekyekusifu ky'otadde mu ndagiriro nga https://user:password@… oba ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Empeereza ekoleezeddwa yeetaaga ekisumuluzo kyayo eky'omukono oba ekigambo ekyekusifu.
activity-pub-enabled: Embaawo ez'olukale zifulumya emirimu gy'ekaadi zaazo ku fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Kiggale okusookera ddala. Bw'okikoleeza, buli lubaawo lwa lukale lusobola okugobererwa okuva ku Mastodon ne seva endala eza fediverse nga @board-<id> ku ndagiriro ya WeKan eno, era emirimu emipya egy'ekaadi gituuka ku bagoberezi baalwo. Kya kusoma kyokka: tewali kintu seva ya fediverse ky'esindika kikyusa lubaawo, era embaawo ez'ekyama tezifulumizibwa n'akatono.
caldav-sync-desc: Teeka ennaku ezisembayo ez'ekaadi z'olubaawo luno mu kalenda - Nextcloud Calendar oba kalenda yonna eya CalDAV. Olunaku olusembayo olukyusibwa mu kalenda luddayo ku kaadi. Kozesa ekigambo ekyekusifu eky'apu, so si ekigambo kyo ekyekusifu.
caldav-enabled: Kwataganya ennaku ezisembayo ne kalenda eno
caldav-invalid-url: Endagiriro ya kalenda erina okuba endagiriro ya http:// oba https://, nga temuli linnya lya mukozesa oba kigambo kyekusifu.
caldav-not-linked: Sooka otereke endagiriro ya kalenda era okoleeze okukwataganya.
webdav-storage-description: Tereka ebiyungiddwako mu folda ku seva ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud oba endala yonna. Kozesa ekigambo ekyekusifu eky'apu ekyakolerwa WeKan. Seva eri ku mukutu gwa WeKan gwennyini esobola okukozesebwa wano, kubanga omuddukanya w'omukutu yekka y'ateeka endagiriro eno.
sqrl-desc: Kiggaddwako mu butonde. Bwe kiteekebwako, olupapula lw'okuyingira luwa SQRL, era abammemba basooka kwongerako endagamuntu yaabwe eya SQRL mu Ntegeka z'omumemba. SQRL yeetaaga WeKan okuba ku ndagiriro ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Sika koodi n'app yo eya SQRL, oba ggulawo pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL ku kyuma kino.
sqrl-expired: Koodi eno eya SQRL eweddeko obudde. Tandika buggya.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL yeetaaga WeKan okuba ku ndagiriro ya https://.
sqrl-description: Yingira ng'okozesa endagamuntu yo eya SQRL mu kifo ky'ekigambo ekyekusifu. Gyongereko wano omulundi gumu ng'okozesa pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL; osobola okugiggyawo wano essaawa yonna.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Okuyingira ng'okozesa SQRL kuggaddwa ku akawunti eno okuva mu pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL. Kuddemu okukuggulawo eyo ng'okozesa koodi yo ey'okuwonya.
sqrl-only-on: Pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL esibye akawunti eno ku SQRL yokka: engeri endala zonna ez'okuyingira zigaaniddwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Pulogulaamu yo eya SQRL esibye akawunti eno ddala: okuzzaawo ekigambo ekyekusifu n'okukyusa imeyilo bigaaniddwa.
sqrl-only: Akawunti eno eyingira ng'ekozesa SQRL yokka.
sqrl-hardlock: Akawunti eno esibiddwa ku SQRL: tesobola kuzzibwawo wadde okukyusibwa mu ngeri endala yonna.
windows-sso-failed: Okuyingira ng'okozesa Windows kulemye. Akawunti yo eya Windows oboolyawo tekkirizibwa wano.
enrollment-password-instructions: Kakasa ekigambo kyo eky'ekyama okutandika. Kino tekikuyingiza. Enkola eriwo ekola tesobola kukyusibwa wano.
enrollment-setup-denied: Tekisobola kutandika kuteekateeka. Kebera ebikukakasa n'obanga koodi ez'omulundi gumu zaakolebwa dda.
enrollment-code-instructions: Kozesa koodi ezesigamye ku budde: SHA1, ennamba mukaaga, sekondi 30. Kuuma ekyama kyo nga kya kyama. Okuteekateeka kuno kuggwaako mu ddakiika ttaano.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: Koodi ey'okukakasa ekozeseddwa. Linda koodi empya mu authenticator yo nga tonnayingira.
registration-first-admin: Akawunti eno esooka ejja kuba Domain Global Admin.
auth-too-many-attempts: Okugezaako okuyingira kungi nnyo. Ddamu oluvannyuma.
registration-global-admin-disabled: Akawunti za Global Admin zitandikibwa mu kitundu. Okwewandiisa okwa bonna kuggaddwa.
expedite-limit: Ekaadi emu yokka eggule ku olubaawo esobola okuba Kya mangu omulundi gumu.
list-policy-placeholder: Ekaadi eyinza ddi okuyingira mu lukalala luno, era ddi lw'ewedde wano?
commitment-point-hint: Okuva ku lukalala luno omulimu gwewaayirwa; enkalala ezilusooka ze ziyinza okulondebwa.
person-wip-over: __user__ alina ekaadi __count__ ezigguddwa; WIP Limit ku muntu eri __limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: Enkola ya buli lukalala - ekaadi ddi lw'eyingira era ddi lw'ewedde - ku mutwe gw'olukalala. Etandikibwa ku buli lubaawo mu Entegeka z'olubaawo / Olukalala.
feature-commitment-point-desc: Olukalala omulimu kwe gwewaayirwa, olumanyiddwa ku mutwe gwalwo. Lulondebwa ku buli lubaawo mu Entegeka z'olubaawo / Olukalala.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Ekaadi ezigguddwa mmeka omuntu omu z'ayinza okukwata ku lubaawo; ekaadi egguddwa erabula ku buli asukkiridde. Eteekebwa ku buli lubaawo mu Entegeka z'olubaawo / Olukalala.
feature-standup-timer-desc: Olukung'aana lwa buli lunaku mu menu y'olubaawo: abamemba b'olubaawo mu nsengeka etabuddwa, buli omu n'obudde bwe bumu. Luggyibwako ku buli lubaawo mu Entegeka za Scrum.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Olubaawo lw'okutunuulira emabega mu menu y'olubaawo: olubaawo olupya olw'ekyama n'ebikalala Tandika okukola, Lekera awo okukola, Weyongere okukola n'Ebirina okukolebwa. Luggyibwako ku buli lubaawo mu Entegeka za Scrum.
show-split-lists: Kkiriza enkalala okwawulwamu mu Bikolebwako ne Kiwedde
split-done: Kiwedde wano, kirinze okusikibwa okugenda mu maaso
feature-split-lists-desc: Olukalala olwawuddwamu mu Bikolebwako ne Kiwedde: ekaadi eteekeddwako akabonero nti ewedde eyo erinda, ng'efuuse enzirugavu, okusikibwa mu lukalala oluddako, era omutwe gw'olukalala gubala byombi. Kikkirizibwa ku buli lubaawo mu Entegeka z'olubaawo / Olukalala, oluvannyuma ne kikoleezebwa mu menyu y'olukalala lwonna.
workload-intro: Essaawa ezibalirirwa n'obubonero bw'emboozi bw'amakaadi agaweereddwa buli muntu, wiiki ku wiiki, okugeraageranya n'essaawa z'alina: obudde bwe obw'okukola, okubulawo n'ennaku z'eggandaalo. Nyiga ku wiiki okulaba amakaadi gaayo.
workload-truncated: Bingi nnyo okulagibwa omulundi gumu: lipoota eraga abantu n'amakaadi abasooka bokka. Londa wiiki ntono oba embaawo ntono.
workload-allocations-intro: Obudde bw'omuntu bwenkana wa obugenda ku lubaawo, oba mirimu ki olubaawo gye lulyetaaga nga tewannaba muntu yenna kulondebwa.
workload-invalid-estimate: Okubalirira kulina okuba wakati wa 0 ne 10000 essaawa.
feature-workload-desc: Obungi bw'emirimu n'obusobozi mu menu y'omukozesa: essaawa ezibalirirwa n'obubonero bw'emboozi bw'amakaadi ga buli muntu, wiiki ku wiiki, okugeraageranya n'obudde bwe obw'okukola, okubulawo n'ennaku z'eggandaalo, n'okugaba ku mbaawo n'emirimu egy'okukwatira ekifo.
billing-intro: Embaawo z'oli muddukanya waazo: embalirira yaazo, emirimu gyazo gye gisasuddeko n'egye gijja okusasula ku miwendo gy'essaawa gy'oteeka, n'empapula z'okusasula essaawa ezaakozesebwa. Abaddukanya embaawo bokka be balaba kino.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h tezirina muwendo gwa ssaawa era tezibaliriddwa. Teeka omuwendo ku lubaawo oba ku bantu abo.
billing-set-rate-first: Sooka oteeke omuwendo gw'essaawa ku lubaawo luno.
feature-billing-desc: Embalirira n'okusasula mu menyu y'omukozesa: embalirira y'olubaawo mu nsimbi oba mu ssaawa, emiwendo gy'essaawa, ssente n'okuteebereza kw'emirimu gyalwo, n'empapula z'okusasula essaawa ez'okusasulwa ezaakozesebwa. Abaddukanya embaawo bokka be bakiraba.
billing-method-link: Link y'okusasula (kaadi, waleti, okusasula ku mutimbagano)
billing-method-sepa: Okusindika ssente kwa SEPA (koodi ya QR)
billing-pay-by-scanning: Sasula ng'osika koodi n'app ya bbanka yo oba ey'okusasula
billing-reverse-charge: Okukyusa omusolo: omusolo gwa VAT gusasulwa omuguzi
billing-method-zbp: Koodi ya QR ya bbanka za Poland
billing-method-mnb: Koodi ya QR ey'okusindika ssente amangu eya Hungary
billing-field-promptpay-target: Ennamba y'essimu, ID y'eggwanga oba ID ya waleti
billing-field-proxy: Ennamba y'essimu, UEN, ID ya FPS oba emayiro
billing-uncosted: __hours__ h tezirina nsaasaanya ya ssaawa era tezibalibwa mu nsaasaanya.
billing-bill-time: Sasuza obudde ku ssaawa (bwe kiggyibwako: omuwendo ogutakyuka, ensasula ezitakyuka n'ebisaasaanyizibwa byokka bye biwandiikibwa)
billing-approve-time: Kakasa obudde nga tebunnawandiikibwa ku lupapula lw'okusasula
billing-fees-intro: Ekituuko oba omuwendo ogutakyuka gusasulwa omulundi gumu, okuva ku lunaku lwagwo; ensasula eya buli mwezi buli mwezi okuva ku lunaku lwayo okutuuka ku nkomerero yaayo.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h zirinda kukakasibwa era teziri ku lupapula luno.
billing-quotes-intro: Ekiteeso ky'omuwendo kibalirira omulimu ogusigadde - okuteebereza kwa buli kaadi enzigule okuggyako obudde obwakozesebwa - n'ensasula ezitannawandiikibwa.
workload-utilization-title: Essaawa ezisasulwa ezawandiikibwa nga zigeraageranyizibwa n'obudde bw'okukola obwa wiiki zino
cloud-panel-settings-intro: Ku Domeeni ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin akuuma domeeni za bakasitoma, database zaabwe, DNS ya CloudFlare n'amakubo ga Caddy, era buli kasitoma alaba empapula ze ez'okusasula era ayogera ne SuperAdmin. SuperAdmin ye mukulembeze wa WeKan eyaliwo dda.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: Endagiriro domeeni gye zisonga (endagiriro ya IP oba erinnya lya kompyuta)
cloud-panel-dns-apply: Kola era otereeze ebiwandiiko bya DNS
cloud-panel-dns-conflict: __name__ erina dda ekiwandiiko kya __type__: kirekeddwa nga bwe kiri.
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: Caddy eweereza Domeeni ya Cloud Panel ne buli domeeni egabanibwa eri WeKan eno, ne buli domeeni erina database yaayo eri ekibokisi kyayo ekya WeKan.
cloud-panel-caddy-admin: Endagiriro ya API y'obukulembeze bwa Caddy
cloud-panel-customers: Bakasitoma abayingira wano (amannya g'abakozesa oba endagiriro za e-mail)
cloud-panel-domain-cloudflare: Kuuma ekiwandiiko kyayo ekya DNS ku CloudFlare
cloud-panel-import-files: Ebigattiddwako __count__: koppa ne fayiro okuva mu tterekero lya fayiro erya WeKan enkadde.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin eri ku kitundu kyokka ekitegeezebwa CLOUD environment variable ya seva, eri ba Cloud Admin baayo n'eri bakasitoma b'ennyiriri z'alaga.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: Ebitundu IPv4 ne IPv6, n'ebitundu ebiwerako nga 203.0.113.0/24, Cloud Admin w'asobola okuyingirira. Kimu ku buli lunyiriri. Kikalu: ekitundu kyonna.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Ekitundu kyo __address__ tekiri mu lukalala luno. Okukiterekera kujja kukuggalira ebweru, noolwekyo tekiterekeddwa.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: Endagiriro za IPv4 ne IPv6 n'ebitundu by'endagiriro, emu ku buli lunyiriri, okuva gye basobola okukozesa Ekifo ky'abaddukanya ne admin REST API. Kyereere: endagiriro yonna.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: Ekikyuusa kya server ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES kye kisalawo, so si lukalala luno.
admin-panel-address-refused: Ekifo ky'abaddukanya tekisobola kukozesebwa okuva ku ndagiriro yo __address__.
website-view-empty: Tewali kifulumiziddwa ku mukutu guno n'okutuusa kati.
feature-views-website-desc: Olubaawo ng'omukutu: kaadi z'olukalala lwalwo Published, akakubo Pages nga menyu, ne kaadi endala ng'ebiwandiiko, ebipya okusooka, n'ebiyungiddwako byabyo. Olubaawo olwa bonna lusobola okuggulirwa mu ndaba eno, abagenyi ne balaba omukutu ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo.
feature-views-shop-desc: Ebintu ebiri ku kaadi z'olubaawo ng'edduuka ly'oku mukutu: kaadi erina ebbeeyi kye kintu, obubonero bwayo bwe bika, era oda ye kaadi mu lukalala lwa Oda. Olubaawo olw'olukale lusobola okuggulwawo mu yo, abagenyi ne bagulira ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo.
shop-sale-lists: Enkalala eziri ku katale (tewali erondeddwa: buli lukalala okuggyako olukalala lwa Oda)
shop-category-labels: Obubonero obulagibwa ng'ebika (tewali bulondeddwa: buli kabonero)
shop-orders-private: Oda ziwandiikibwa ku lubaawo olw'ekyama, kubanga olubaawo olw'olukale lulaga buli kaadi eri buli muntu.
shop-show-on-public: Laga Edduuka mu kifo ky'olubaawo olw'olukale
shop-show-on-public-note: Olubaawo olw'olukale luggulwawo mu ndabika emu yokka. Okulonda Edduuka wano kikyusa __view__ eri abagenyi, era okulonda Omukutu oba endabika endala mu Entegeka z'olubaawo / Lubaawo Laba kikyusa Edduuka.
shop-empty: Tewannaba kubaawo bintu. Kaadi erina ebbeeyi mu lukalala oluli ku katale kye kintu.
shop-privacy-note: Erinnya lyo n'ebikukwatako biwandiikibwa ku oda edduuka lisobole okugituusa, so si walala.
shop-price-changed: Ebbeeyi ekyuse. Kebera omugatte omupya oddemu okuragira.
shop-confirmation-email: Weereza omuguzi okukakasa oda ku imeyilo
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Mu WordPress, londa 'Tools', 'Export', 'All content' ne 'Download Export File', olonde fayiro eyo eya .xml wano, oba ssaamu ebigambo byayo. Squarespace, Wix n'emikutu emirala egifulumya fayiro ya WordPress bikola mu ngeri y'emu. Buli lupapula na buli kiwandiiko kifuuka kaadi mu lukalala lw'embeera yaakyo, empapula mu kakubo Pages n'ebiwandiiko mu Posts, n'ebirimu byakyo, ebika n'obubonero (tags) ng'obubonero, n'endowooza ezikkiriziddwa.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Tereka ebiwandiiko n'empapula bya WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts ne /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) nga fayiro emu eya .json, ogironde wano oba ogissaamu. Buli lupapula na buli kiwandiiko kifuuka kaadi mu lukalala lw'embeera yaakyo.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Mu Ghost, londa 'Settings', 'Labs', 'Export your content', olonde fayiro ya .json wano oba ogissaamu. Buli lupapula na buli kiwandiiko kifuuka kaadi mu lukalala lw'embeera yaakyo, n'obubonero bwakyo.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Mu Blogger, londa 'Settings', 'Back up content', olonde fayiro ya .xml wano oba ssaamu ebigambo byayo. Buli kiwandiiko na buli lupapula kifuuka kaadi, ekitannawedde mu lukalala Draft, n'obubonero bwakyo n'endowooza.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Funza ensibuko z'omukutu gwa Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro oba omulala ogutakyuka mu .zip - fayiro za Markdown ne front matter yaazo, n'ebifaananyi byazo - olonde .zip wano. Buli fayiro ya Markdown efuuka kaadi: ebiwandiiko okuva mu fooda za posts oba ezirina olunaku mu linnya lya fayiro, endala empapula, ebitannawedde mu lukalala Draft, n'ebifaananyi bye ekozesa ng'ebiyungiddwako byayo.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Funza fayiro z'omukutu mu .zip - empapula zaagwo eza .html n'ebifaananyi, nga bwe byaterekebwa ne wget oba HTTrack, oba ebyafulumizibwa mu Medium - olonde .zip wano. Buli lupapula lufuuka kaadi n'ebigambo byalwo ebikulu, n'ebifaananyi bye lukozesa ng'ebiyungiddwako; sikulipu, menyu ne foomu birekebwa bweru.
import-board-instruction-substack: Mu Substack, londa 'Settings', 'Exports', 'Create new export', olonde .zip ewanuddwa wano. Buli kiwandiiko kifuuka kaadi n'ebigambo byakyo, ekifulumiziddwa oba ekitannawedde.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Obukubo bwawula olubaawo mu bitundu ebyebunguludde, buli kaadi n'eba mu lukalala era mu kakubo. Akakubo kayinza okuyimirirawo ku ttiimu, omuntu, kasitoma oba ekika ky'omulimu, ate enkalala ne zisigala nga ziraga emitendera gy'omulimu.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Nyiga + ku mutwe gw'akakubo, oba londa Yongerako Akakubo mu menu yaako, wandiika erinnya era olonde oba kagenda waggulu oba wansi w'akakubo akalondeddwa. Okuteekamu ennyiriri eziwera kiyinza okukola akakubo kamu ku buli lunyiriri. Nyiga erinnya okulikyusa, kozesa akasaale okuzinga oba okwanjuluza akakubo, sika omukono gwako okukyusa ensengeka y'obukubo, era sika ensalo yaako eya wansi okukyusa obugulumivu bwako okuggyako ng'omuddukanya w'olubaawo yaziyiza okukyusa obunene.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Enkalala ze mpagi ezikwata amakaadi. Ku lubaawo lwa kanban buli lukalala mutendera gwa mulimu, era ekaadi eva ku lukalala n'egenda ku lulala ng'omulimu bwe gugenda mu maaso. Mu ndaba y'Obukubo olukalala luyinza okuba olw'akakubo kamu.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Nyiga akabonero k'okwongerako olukalala ku nkomerero ey'oku ddyo ey'omutwe gw'olukalala, oba Yongerako mu menu y'olukalala, wandiika erinnya era olonde olukalala lwe luddirira; okuteekamu ennyiriri eziwera kiyinza okukola olukalala lumu ku buli lunyiriri. Nyiga omutwe gw'olukalala okugukyusa, era akasaale ku mutwe gwalwo kaluzinga oba kalwanjuluza ku lulwo lwokka. Menu y'olukalala erina n'okukoppa, okusengula n'okutwala mu tterekero, era osobola okusika omukono wakati w'enkalala okukyusa obugazi bwazo bwe kikkirizibwa.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: Endaba ya Tabbulu eraga amakaadi g'olubaawo ng'emmeeza efaanana spreadsheet, olunyiriri lumu ku buli kaadi, n'olukalala lwayo, akakubo, abantu, obubonero n'ennaku. Eyamba okutunuulira amakaadi amangi omulundi gumu n'okwongerako oba okusengula amakaadi nga tolina kugasika okuva ku lukalala okudda ku lulala.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Nyiga omutwe gw'empagi okusengeka, era ogunyige nate okukyusa ensengeka. Wandiika mu kasanduuko k'okunoonya okufuna emitwe gy'amakaadi, enkalala, obukubo n'obubonero, era kozesa Ekyasooka n'Ekiddako okuyita mu nnyiriri 25 omulundi gumu. Eppeesa lya Kyusa liggulawo ekaadi waggulu ku tabbulu. Okuzinga emitwe n'Okugatta okusinziira ku kakubo bikyusa endabika era bijjukirwa mu browser eno. Amakaadi agali mu tterekero tegalagibwa, era Sengejja ey'oku mabbali ekendeeza ku nnyiriri.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: Endaba ya Kalenda eteeka amakaadi g'olubaawo ku kalenda okusinziira ku nnaku zaago: ekaadi erina olunaku lw'okutandika n'olw'okumaliriza eragibwa ng'omuggo wakati wazo, ate ennaku zaayo ez'okufunibwa, olusembayo n'ez'okumaliriza ziragibwa nga ebiwandiiko byazo. N'ebintu by'olukalala lw'okukebera ebirina ennaku nabyo birabika.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Kozesa Leero, Ekyasooka n'Ekiddako okutambula, era kyusa wakati w'olunaku, wiiki n'omwezi, buli kimu nga ekipande oba olukalala. Sika ekaadi okugiwa olunaku olusembayo oluggya, oba gigolole okukyusa olunaku lwayo olw'okumaliriza. Nyiga olunaku, oba sika ku ssaawa mu kipande kya wiiki oba olunaku, okukola ekaadi empya esembayo mu kiseera ekyo; egenda mu kakubo akasooka n'olukalala olusooka olw'olubaawo.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Enkola ya Kalenda eraga buli kaadi ku lunaku lwayo olusembayo, n'obubonero bwayo n'omutwe gwayo gwonna, mu kipande ky'omwezi oba wiiki. Kye kifaananyi ky'okusoma kyokka eky'ebisembayo ddi, nga kalenda ya Trello.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Kozesa Leero, Ekyasooka n'Ekiddako okutambula omwezi oba wiiki, era Wiiki oba Omwezi okukyusa ekipande; okulonda kujjukirwa mu browser eno. Nyiga ekaadi okugiggulawo. Amakaadi agali mu tterekero tegalagibwa era Sengejja ey'oku mabbali ekola. Okukyusa ennaku ng'osika, kozesa endaba ya Kalenda.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Kalenda y'Embaawo Ennyingi eraga amakaadi agalina ennaku ku buli lubaawo lw'oli memba mu kalenda emu, olabe byonna ebisembayo wiiki eno ne bwe biba ku lubaawo ki. Buli kiwandiiko kitandika n'omutwe gw'olubaawo lwakyo mu bukomera.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Giggulawo okuva mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo ku lubaawo lwonna era olinde amakaadi g'embaawo zo zonna gamale okutikka. Kozesa Leero, Ekyasooka n'Ekiddako n'endaba z'olunaku, wiiki n'omwezi, buli emu era ng'olukalala. Ennaku ez'okufunibwa, olusembayo n'ez'okumaliriza zifuna ebiwandiiko byazo. Nyiga ekiwandiiko okuggulawo ekaadi eyo ku lubaawo lwayo. Ennaku tezisobola kusikibwa wano.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: Endaba y'Ebiseera ekuŋŋaanya okugoberera ebiseera kw'olubaawo mu kifo kimu: ebiseera bimeka ebikozeseddwa, ani yabikozesa era ku makaadi ki, n'ebiseera bimeka ebisigaddeyo okutuuka ku lunaku amakaadi lwe gasembayo. Ebiseera biwandiikibwa ku makaadi gennyini; endaba eno ebiraga bulazi.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Soma omugatte gw'ebiseera ebikozeseddwa waggulu, oluvannyuma okwawulamu okusinziira ku aweereddwa omulimu n'okusinziira ku kaadi, n'amakaadi agasusse ebiseera nga gabonereddwa. Wansi waago buli nkyukakyuka mu ssaawa ezaawandiikibwa ku kaadi eragibwa n'omuntu eyagikola. Nyiga Fulumya okutereka lipoota nga PDF oba Excel. Abamemba abayinza okulaba amakaadi ge baaweereddwa gokka bafuna omugatte gw'amakaadi gaabwe, ate ebitundu ebirala ne bisigala nga bikalu.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: Endaba y'Ekiseera ekiyitawo eraga olubaawo nga bwe lwali mu kaseera akayise, ng'ekozesa ebyafaayo by'olubaawo. Ekuyamba okulaba ekyakyuka n'okuzzaawo ekaadi nga bwe yali.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Nyiga akatonnyeze ku lunyiriri okulaba buli kaadi nga bwe yali mu kiseera ekyo, nga zigattiddwa okusinziira ku lukalala lwazo mu kiseera ekyo, n'omutwe, ennyonyola, obubonero, abamemba n'olunaku olusembayo. Nyiga Kati okudda mu kiseera kino. Ku kaadi, Zzaawo embeera eno ezzaawo emiwendo egyo ng'omaze okukakasa. Tewali kisazibwamu: okuzzaawo kuwandiikibwa ng'ebyafaayo ebipya, era eppeesa liragibwa bokka abayinza okukyusa ekaadi eyo.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Ebibalo biraga embeera y'olubaawo mu kutunula omulundi gumu: amakaadi gaalwo bwe gatikkibwa n'obukubo, enkalala, amakaadi, amakaadi agali mu tterekero, obubonero, abamemba n'ebifo eby'obwannannyini bimeka lwe lulina.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Ggulawo Ebibalo okuva mu kibinja ky'Okulaba Okw'awamu mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo era osome tabbulu y'Embeera y'olubaawo. Okutikka amakaadi kukubuulira oba olubaawo luno lutikka amakaadi agalabika gokka oba amakaadi gonna, era oba ekyo kyalondebwa kyokka olw'olubaawo olunene. Emiwendo gibalirirwa ku seva, kale gituufu ne ku lubaawo olunene. Omuwendo gwonna gusobola okulondebwa n'okukoppebwa, era okuggulawo endaba tekukyusa kintu.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Okugatta okusinziira ku Aweereddwa omulimu kuteeka buli kaadi wansi w'omuntu gw'eweereddwa, mu kifo ky'olukalala lwayo, olabe ani alina ki nga toggulawo buli lukalala. Kirungi mu lukiiko lwa ttiimu.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Kiggulewo okuva mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo. Buli aweereddwa omulimu afuna ekitundu n'amakaadi ge, olunaku olusembayo we lubeera n'essaawa ng'ekaadi esusse ebiseera; amakaadi agatalina aweereddwa gali wansi wa Tewali aweereddwa. Nyiga omutwe gw'ekaadi okugiggulawo. Okugatta kukozesa ekifo ky'Aweereddwa omulimu eky'ekaadi, so si Abamemba baayo. Abantu abakkirizibwa okulaba amakaadi ge baaweereddwa gokka tebafuna data wano.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: Endaba za Gantt zikuba amakaadi g'olubaawo ku kalenda olabe ekitandika, ekisembayo n'ebyekwatagana. Gantt ye tabbulu erina olunyiriri lumu ku buli kaadi n'akabonero ku buli lunaku lwayo, ate Frappe Gantt ne DHTMLX Gantt zikuba buli kaadi ng'omuggo okuva ku kutandika okutuuka ku nkomerero.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Londa Gantt, Frappe Gantt oba DHTMLX Gantt mu kibinja kya Kalenda n'ebiseera mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo; amakaadi geetaaga waakiri olunaku lumu olw'okufunibwa, okutandika, olusembayo oba olw'okumaliriza. Mu Gantt, buli wiiki erina ennaku efuna tabbulu yaayo; nyiga erinnya ly'ekaadi okugiggulawo oba akabonero k'olunaku okulukyusa. Mu Frappe Gantt ne DHTMLX Gantt, abamemba abalina olukusa okuwandiika basobola okusika omuggo okukyusa ekiseera ky'ekaadi.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: Product Backlog lwe lukalala olusengekeddwa olw'omulimu ttiimu ya Scrum gw'etannaba kutwala mu sprint. Luraga amakaadi g'olubaawo agatalina sprint eriwo kati, nga gasengekeddwa okusinziira ku ddaala lya backlog, nga tegaggibwa mu nkalala zaago.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Noonya ekaadi mu tabbulu era, mu kifo kyayo eky'Ebikolwa, teekawo Sprint yaayo, Eddaala lya backlog, Okufulumya, Ekika ky'omulimu n'Ebisaanyizo by'okukkiriza, oluvannyuma onyige Tereka. Amadaala amatono gasooka. Kwata Ctrl, oba Cmd ku Mac, okuteeka ekaadi mu kufulumya okuwera. Nyiga omutwe gw'ekaadi okugiggulawo, ne Laga ebisingawo okutikka amakaadi 100 agaddako. Okukyusa kugoberera olukusa olwa bulijjo olw'amakaadi.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: Sprint kye kiseera ekimpi era ekigere ttiimu ya Scrum mw'emalira omulimu ogulondeddwa okutuuka ku kigendererwa. Endaba ya Sprints w'eri sprints z'olubaawo we zitegekerwa, we zitandikirwa, we ziggalirwa oba we zisazibwamu, wamu n'okufulumya kwalwo n'emikolo gya Scrum.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: Omuddukanya w'olubaawo asooka okuggulawo entegeka za Scrum, n'akoleeza okuteekateeka kwa Scrum era n'alonda ensibuko y'okubalirira, yuniti, enkola y'okumaliriza n'ennaku ez'okukola. Oluvannyuma kola sprint etegekeddwa n'erinnya, ekigendererwa, okutandika n'enkomerero, giweemu amakaadi okuva mu Product Backlog, onyige Tandika sprint. Okumaliriza, londa omulimu ogutaggwa gye gugenda onyige Ggalawo sprint, oba waayo ensonga onyige Sazaamu sprint. Abaddukanya b'olubaawo bokka be baddukanya sprints.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: Lipoota ya sprint eraga ekyabaawo mu sprint emu eggaddwa: ekyasuubizibwa, ekyamalirizibwa, ekyayongerwako, ekyaggibwamu n'ekyasigala nga tekiggwa. Velocity eraga ebivaamu ebyo ku buli sprint eggaddwa, sprint eddako esobole okuteekebwateekebwa okusinziira ku ttiimu kye yakola ddala.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: Mu Lipoota ya Sprint, londa sprint era olonde Amakaadi oba Okubalirira waggulu w'emiggo, oluvannyuma osome obunene bwa buli lunaku n'omulimu ogusigadde n'ebyafaayo by'enkyukakyuka wansi. Mu Velocity, soma olunyiriri lumu ku buli sprint eggaddwa. Ebivaamu biva mu bifaananyi ebyakwatibwa buli sprint bwe yatandika n'okuggalwa, kale enkyukakyuka mu kubalirira ezaddirira tezibiwandiika buggya. Fulumya etereka ebivaamu nga PDF oba Excel, ate Zza buggya etikka lipoota nate.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: Ebipande bino ebya Scrum biraga okugenda mu maaso okumala ekiseera. Burndown eraga omulimu ogusigadde buli lunaku ate Burnup ogumaliriziddwa, Velocity eraga buli sprint eggaddwa kye yamaliriza, Release Burndown egoberera omulimu ogusigadde mu kufulumya, ate Epic Progress eraga amakaadi amazadde we gatuuse.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Londa ekipande wansi wa Scrum mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo. Buli kimu kikubibwa okuva ku makaadi ne sprints by'olubaawo lwennyini era kiraga emiwendo mu tabbulu wansi w'ekipande. Velocity yeetaaga waakiri sprint emu eggaddwa, era ekukkiriza okulonda Amakaadi oba Okubalirira. Nyiga Fulumya waggulu okutereka emiwendo gye gimu nga PDF oba Excel. Ekipande ekitannaba kuba na kya kukuba kigamba Tewali bivaamu.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: Roadmap egatta amakaadi mu nnyiriri okusinziira ku muwendo gw'ekifo eky'obwannannyini, nga okufulumya oba epic, era ekuba amakaadi ga buli lunyiriri ku layini y'ebiseera. Eyamba ku roadmap y'okufulumya oba ey'omulamwa ng'okugatta okwo kumaze okukuumibwa mu kifo eky'obwannannyini.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: Olubaawo lwetaaga waakiri ekifo eky'obwannannyini kimu eky'ebiwandiiko oba eky'okulondako. Londa ekifo mu Gatta okusinziira ku waggulu; buli muwendo gufuna ekipande kyagwo ekitono ekya Gantt eky'amakaadi gaagwo, ate amakaadi agatalina muwendo gagattibwa wansi wa Tewali muwendo. Amakaadi gateekebwa okusinziira ku nnaku zaago, kale gawe ennaku ez'okutandika n'ezisembayo ogalabe ku layini y'ebiseera.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: Ebipande bino eby'Okulaba Okw'awamu biddamu olubaawo bwe lulina emirimu emingi n'omulimu gwalwo bwe gwawuliddwamu: Dashboard ne Pulse bifunza olubaawo, Workload eraga ani alina ki, Distribution amakaadi bwe gagabanyiziddwa, Dependency Map amakaadi bwe gaziyizagana oba bwe geesigamagana, ate Activity Heatmap abantu lwe bakola ku lubaawo.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Londa ekipande mu kibinja ky'Okulaba Okw'awamu mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo. Buli lupapula lukuba ekipande okuva ku makaadi n'ebyafaayo by'olubaawo era luraga tabbulu y'emiwendo egiri emabega waakyo. Nyiga Fulumya waggulu okutereka data y'emu nga PDF oba Excel. Bwe watabaawo kya kukuba, ekipande kigamba Tewali bivaamu.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Bigboard eteeka buli lubaawo lw'oli memba ku lupapula lumu olusobola okuseeseetebwa, buli lumu n'enkalala n'amakaadi gaalwo, osobole okukola ku mbaawo zo zonna omulundi gumu.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Ggulawo Bigboard okuva mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo era olinde amakaadi ga buli lubaawo gatikke. Buli kitundu ky'olubaawo kikola ng'olubaawo olwa bulijjo: sika amakaadi wakati w'enkalala, ggulawo amakaadi era okyuse enkalala. Osobola n'okusika ekaadi mu lukalala lw'olubaawo olulala ku lupapula, ekigitwala ku lubaawo olwo. Enkalala zisobola okusikibwa mu lubaawo lwazo lwokka. Nyiga omutwe gw'olubaawo okuluggulawo lwokka.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: Ebipande by'entambula ya Kanban biraga omulimu bwe gutambula mu lubaawo: entambula egattibwa, ekiseera ky'okufuga n'eky'enzirukanya, ekiseera ky'okutuusa, obulungi bw'entambula, ebiyitamu, WIP, omulimu ogukaddiwa, ebiziyiza, okulagula omulimu lwe gulimalirizibwa, enneeyisa y'enkola n'oba okubalirira okunene kutwala ebbanga eddene. Bikuyamba okuzuula omulimu we gukuŋŋaanira n'ebbanga lye gutwala ddala.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Londa ekipande mu kibinja ky'entambula ya Kanban mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo. Soma ekiwandiiko wansi w'omutwe, ekigamba bwe kipima, oluvannyuma ekipande ne tabbulu wansi waakyo. Empapula ezimu zitwala entegeka, nga amakaadi agagendererwa n'olunaku mu Monte Carlo Forecasts oba ekifo ky'obunene mu Work Item Size vs. Cycle Time, ezikozesebwa ne Kozesa. Fulumya waggulu etereka tabbulu nga PDF oba Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: Lipoota zino ziraga omulimu bwe gutambula mu lubaawo buli wiiki: amakaadi agakoleddwa n'agamaliriziddwa, entambula entuufu, amakaadi bwe gamala mu buli lukalala, emyaka egya wakati egy'amakaadi amaggule, ebiyitamu buli wiiki n'emirundi ennaku ezisembayo lwe zituukirizibwa.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Londa lipoota mu kibinja ky'entambula ya Kanban mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo: Created vs. Resolved, Net Flow, Time in List, Average Age, Throughput Run Chart oba Due Date Performance. Buli emu eraga ekipande era, wansi waakyo, tabbulu y'emiwendo mwe kikubibwa. Nyiga Fulumya waggulu okutereka tabbulu eyo nga PDF oba Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: Endaba ya Maapu eraga amakaadi g'olubaawo ng'obubonero ku kifaananyi omuddukanya w'olubaawo ky'ateekako, nga pulaani y'ennyumba oba maapu y'ekifo. Esaanira omulimu ogukolerwa mu bifo, nga ebisenge, ebyuma oba ettaka.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: Omuddukanya w'olubaawo anyiga Teekako ekifaananyi kya maapu n'alonda fayiro ya PNG, JPEG, GIF oba WebP, era asobola okugiggyawo oluvannyuma nga tafiiriddwa bifo bya makaadi. Abantu abayinza okukyusa olubaawo balaba amakaadi agatannaba ku maapu; sika emu ku kifaananyi, oba gironde onyige w'egwanira, era sika akabonero okukasengula. Akabonero kafuna langi y'akabonero akasooka ak'ekaadi, era okukanyiga kuggulawo ekaadi.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: Endaba ya Imeyilo eraga olubaawo ng'ekisanduuko ky'ebbaluwa: amakaadi bye bubaka, enkalala ze fayiro, ate obubonero bwe bubonero. Osobola okuwandiika n'okuddamu imeyilo okuva ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo lwennyini, okuddamu ne kudda ku lubaawo ng'amakaadi n'endowooza.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Nyiga Inbox, Ebyaweerezeddwa, Imeyilo zonna, olukalala oba akabonero okulonda ekiragibwa, wandiika mu kasanduuko k'okunoonya okukendeeza ku nnyiriri, era onyige olunyiriri okuggulawo ekaadi, endowooza zaayo nga gwe mboozi. Wandiika ekola imeyilo empya ate akasaale k'okuddamu kaddamu emu, nga ziweerezebwa okuva ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo. Olubaawo lusooka kufuna imeyilo, ekikoleezebwa mu Entegeka z'Obubaka bw'olubaawo wansi wa Imeyilo okudda ku kaadi.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: Endaba ya Chat eraga olubaawo ng'ekifo ky'okunyumyamu: buli kaadi erimu emboozi ye mukutu era endowooza zaayo bwe bubaka. Omuti gw'emikutu gubikka buli lubaawo lw'osobola okulaba, n'omuwendo gw'obubaka bw'otannaba kusoma.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Ggulawo ekifo ky'okukoleramu n'olubaawo mu Mikutu era onyige ekaadi; eggulukira mu kitundu eky'omu makkati n'obubaka bwayo mu kitundu kya chat. Wandiika obubaka onyige Enter oba Weereza; Shift+Enter etandika olunyiriri oluggya. Okutandika emboozi ku kaadi etalina bubaka, nyiga Laga amakaadi gonna ag'olubaawo olwo era olonde ekaadi. Ebitundu bikyusibwa ku nnimi eziwandiikibwa okuva ku ddyo okudda ku kkono.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: Endaba ya Version Control eraga olubaawo ng'ekigoberera ensonga eky'etterekero ly'enkoodi: amakaadi ze nsonga, obubonero bwe bubonero, obubonero obulina olunaku olusembayo bwe bubonero bw'omutendera, endowooza ye mboozi ate ebiyungiddwako ze fayiro. Era eyingiza n'okukwataganya ensonga okuva ku GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ne Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Tunuulira ensonga enzigule n'enzigale, sengejja okusinziira ku kabonero oba omutendera, era oggulewo ensonga okusoma n'okwongera ku mboozi yaayo. Ekaadi ebalibwa ng'eggaddwa ng'eri mu tterekero oba mu lukalala nga Closed oba Done. Ensonga empya zifuuka amakaadi mu lukalala oluggule olw'olubaawo, era Ggalawo oba Ddamu oggulewo esengula ekaadi wakati w'enkalala enzigule n'enzigale. Buli kimu data ya kaadi eya bulijjo, kale enkyukakyuka zikuumibwa mu byafaayo by'olubaawo.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Ebibinja by'empagi bikukkiriza okusengeka amakaadi ge gamu mu ngeri endala, nga okusinziira ku bukulu, omutendera oba obunene, nga tewali kaadi eggibwa mu lukalala lwayo. Buli kibinja kirina empagi zaakyo ezirina langi.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: Omuddukanya w'olubaawo awandiika erinnya mu Kibinja ky'empagi ekipya n'anyiga Yongerako, oluvannyuma n'ayongerako empagi n'erinnya ne langi. Londa ekibinja waggulu; buli kaadi eri mu emu ku mpagi zaakyo oba mu Teteekeddwa. Sika ekaadi ku mpagi endala okukyusa ekifo kyayo mu kibinja kino kyokka; olukalala lwayo, akakubo, obubonero n'abamemba bisigala bye bimu. Buli kaadi era eraga obubonero obutono obw'empagi yaayo mu bibinja ebirala.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: Endaba ya Mukutu eraga olubaawo nga omukutu ogwazimbibwa okuva ku makaadi gaalwo n'ebiyungiddwako, okugeza omukutu ogwayingizibwa okuva ku WordPress, Ghost, Blogger oba omukutu ogutakyukakyuka. Olubaawo olwa bonna lusobola okuggulukira mu ndaba eno, abagenyi ne balaba omukutu ku ndagiriro y'olubaawo.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Amakaadi agali mu lukalala oluyitibwa Published gali ku mukutu, oba amakaadi ga buli lukalala nga terulina lukalala ng'olwo; amakaadi agali mu tterekero tegalabika n'akatono. Amakaadi agali mu kakubo akayitibwa Pages gakola menu, n'emirimu emitono ng'empapula entono, ate amakaadi amalala ge biwandiiko ku lupapula olusooka, ebisinga obuggya nga bye bisooka. Ennyonyola y'ekaadi kye kiwandiiko ky'olupapula era ebiyungiddwako byayo bye bifaananyi byayo ne fayiro. Okugikozesa ng'endaba y'olubaawo olwa bonna, gironde mu Entegeka z'Olubaawo / Endaba y'Olubaawo.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: Endaba ya Dduuka eraga ebintu ebiri ku makaadi g'olubaawo nga dduuka ery'oku mukutu, n'ebifaananyi, emiwendo, ebika, olupapula lw'ekintu, ekikapu n'okusasula. Ekaadi eri mu lukalala olutundibwamu efuuka ekintu ng'ekifo kyayo eky'omuwendo kirimu ennamba, era obubonero bwayo bufuuka ebika.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: Omuddukanya w'olubaawo ateekateeka dduuka mu Entegeka z'Olubaawo / Dduuka: ebifo by'omuwendo, ennamba y'ekintu n'ebiriwo, olukalala lwa Orders olwa kyama, ensimbi, VAT, engeri z'okusasula, enkalala ezitundibwamu n'obubonero obulagibwa ng'ebika, oluvannyuma n'akebera Dduuka liggule. Abagula basengejja okusinziira ku kika, bateeka ebintu mu kikapu era basasula. Buli kiragiro kifuuka ekaadi empya mu lukalala lwa Orders, era omuguzi afuna imeyilo ey'okukakasa.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: Sengejja eraga amakaadi gokka agakwatagana n'ekyo ky'olonda, nga obubonero, abamemba, abaweereddwa omulimu, ennaku, emiwendo gy'ebifo eby'obwannannyini, ebiwandiiko by'ekaadi oba ebbanga amakaadi lye gamaze mu lukalala. Tekyusa kaadi yonna wadde olukusa lw'omuntu yenna, era okugatta kw'ebisengejja kusobola okuterekebwa n'erinnya ne kukozesebwa nate.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Londa obubonero, abantu, ennaku oba embeera endala ku mabbali, olubaawo ne luraga amakaadi gokka agakwatagana. Wansi w'Obubonero, OR ekwatagana n'akabonero konna akalondeddwa ate AND yeetaaga bwonna; okunyiga nate akabonero akalondeddwa kukaggyamu. Ebiwandiiko by'ekaadi bikola ng'owandiika. Okuggalawo ekitundu kukuuma ekisengejja nga kikola okutuusa lw'okiggyawo. Okunoonya Okw'awamu, nakwo wano, kuzuula amakaadi mu mbaawo zo zonna.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Noonya ezuula amakaadi n'enkalala ez'olubaawo luno ebiwandiiko byazo ebirimu ky'owandiika, era eraga buli kaadi ezuuliddwa ku lubaawo lwennyini. Ku Mbaawo zonna eppeesa lye limu likendeeza ku lukalala lw'embaawo zo okusinziira ku mutwe.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Wandiika mu kifo onyige Enter. Ekitundu ky'oku mabbali kiraga enkalala n'amakaadi ebikwatagana, era ekaadi esooka eggulukira ku lubaawo n'ekibalo wansi w'ekifo. Nyiga Enter nate ku kaadi eddako oba Shift+Enter ku eyasooka; obusaale bukola kye kimu era bwetooloola. Nyiga ekaadi oba olukalala mu bivaamu okubiraga ku lubaawo, era onyige Noonya nate okuggalawo ekitundu ky'oku mabbali.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Okulonda ebingi kukukkiriza okukebera amakaadi agawera n'okukola ekintu kimu ku gonna omulundi gumu: okuteekako akabonero oba memba, okukyusa langi, okusengula, okukoppa oba okugatwala mu tterekero. Ku Mbaawo zonna kulonda embaawo mu kifo ky'ekyo.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Koleeza Okulonda ebingi ku mutwe gw'olubaawo, oluvannyuma okebere obusanduuko bw'amakaadi, oba kozesa Sengejja okudda ku kulonda mu kitundu kya Sengejja okulonda buli kaadi ekisengejja ky'eraga. Londa ekikolwa ku mabbali, nga Teekako akabonero ku bilondeddwa, Sengula ebilondeddwa oba Twala ebilondeddwa mu Tterekero. Nyiga Ggyako Okulonda ebingi, X eri okumpi n'eppeesa ly'omutwe, bw'omaliriza. Weetaaga olukusa okukyusa olubaawo.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Ebifo eby'obwannannyini bye bifo eby'enjawulo eby'olubaawo lwennyini eby'amakaadi, nga enkyusa, bajeti, kasitoma, akasanduuko k'okukebera oba okulonda okuva mu lukalala. Ekifo kinnyonnyolwa omulundi gumu ku lubaawo, era buli kaadi esobola okukwata omuwendo gwayo gwennyini.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Nyiga + okukola ekifo, kiwe erinnya n'ekika (ebiwandiiko, ennamba, olunaku, okulondako, okulondako okungi, akasanduuko k'okukebera, ensimbi oba ekyokulabirako ky'ebiwandiiko) era olonde we kiragibwa: ku kaadi, ku kaadi entono, ku makaadi amaggya oba ku buli kaadi. Ekika tekisobola kukyusibwa oluvannyuma. Ebifo by'ennamba n'ensimbi bisobola okulaga omugatte gwabyo waggulu wa buli lukalala. Emiwendo gy'ekaadi giteekebwamu ku kaadi enzigule.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: Tterekero likwata amakaadi, enkalala n'obukubo ebyatwalibwa mu Tterekero. Okutwala mu tterekero kukweka ekintu nga tekibula, kisobole okuzzibwawo oluvannyuma, ate okusazaamu kukiggyawo emirembe gyonna.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Londa tabu ya Amakaadi, Enkalala oba Obukubo era onyige Zzaawo okumpi n'ekintu, oba Zzaawo byonna. Ekaadi eyinza obutazzibwawo ng'olukalala lwayo luli mu tterekero oba lujjudde okusinziira ku kkomo lyalwo erya WIP, era Tterekero likigamba. Abaddukanya b'olubaawo era balaba Sazaamu ne Sazaamu byonna, ebitasobola kuzzibwawo. Embaawo ezili mu tterekero zizzibwawo okuva ku lupapula lwa Tterekero olw'Embaawo zonna.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Ebifo ebyasooka biraga buli kakubo, olukalala n'ekaadi we byateekebwa nga bikolebwa, era biki ku byo ebisengudde okuva olwo. Kiyamba oluvannyuma lw'okusengeka okunene, oba okulaba omutwe ekaadi gwe yakolebwa nagwo.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Soma ebibinja bisatu, Obukubo, Enkalala n'Amakaadi. Buli kintu kiraga erinnya lyakyo erya kati, Kisengudde nga tekikyali we kyateekebwa, ekifo mwe kyakolerwa, omutwe gwakyo ogwasooka bwe gubeera gukyuse, ne lwe kyakolebwa. Nyiga Zza buggya okusoma nate ebyafaayo by'olubaawo. Ebintu ebyakolebwa ng'ebifo tebinnaba kuwandiikibwa tebirina lunyiriri.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Omugatte ye lipoota ey'olukiiko olw'okuyimirira ey'ekyabaawo ku lubaawo, omuntu ku muntu, ng'eggiddwa mu biwandiiko by'olubaawo lwennyini. Eddamu buli omu ku ffe kye yakola mu lunaku oba wiiki eyise, n'ebiyiseeko olunaku.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Londa Olunaku oluyise oba Wiiki eyise. Buli memba eyakola ekintu oba alina amakaadi agayiseeko olunaku afuna ebibinja by'amakaadi Agamaliriziddwa, Agasengudde, Agayongeddwako n'Agaliko endowooza, n'amakaadi ge Agayiseeko olunaku, era buli kaadi eggulukira okuva ku link yaayo. Nyiga Koppa ng'ebiwandiiko okukoppa omugatte gwonna, nga gwetegefu okuteekebwa mu chat oba imeyilo.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Okuva lwe wasembayo okujja kulaga abantu abalala kye baakyusa ku lubaawo luno okuva lwe wasembayo okuluggulawo: amakaadi amaggya, okusengula, endowooza, enkyukakyuka mu nnaku ezisembayo n'abamemba abayongeddwako. Ekiwandiiko mu menu kiraga omuwendo gw'enkyukakyuka.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Okuggulawo olubaawo kuwandiika okujja kwo. Ggulawo endaba eno okulaba enkyukakyuka nga zigattiddwa okusinziira ku kaadi, ezisinga obuggya nga ze zisooka, era onyige olunyiriri okuggulawo ekaadi eyo. Enkyukakyuka zo tezilagibwa. Omuddukanya asobola okukweka ekintu kino mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Entegeka / Ebikozesebwa.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Okulabika kusalawo ani asobola okulaba olubaawo: abantu bokka abaayongerwako (Kya kyama), buli mukozesa ayingidde ku WeKan eno (Abakozesa abayingidde), oba buli muntu alina link (Kya bonna). Okukyusa kusigala ku bamemba b'olubaawo okuggyako ng'omuddukanya w'olubaawo akkiriza ekirala.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: Omuddukanya w'olubaawo anyiga eppeesa ly'okulabika ku mutwe gw'olubaawo n'alonda Kya kyama, Abakozesa abayingidde oba Kya bonna; okulonda okuliwo kulina akabonero k'okukakasa era eppeesa olwo ne liraga entegeka empya. Ku lubaawo lw'Abakozesa abayingidde oba olwa bonna, omuddukanya bw'akkiriza, omuddukanya w'olubaawo asobola n'okukebera Buli ayingidde asobola okukyusa. Ku bantu abalala eppeesa liraga bulazi entegeka.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Kuuma eteekawo bungi ki bw'owulira ku lubaawo luno: Okulaba kukutegeeza buli nkyukakyuka, Okugoberera enkyukakyuka zokka ku makaadi ge wakola oba g'oli memba, ate Kisirisiddwa tewali. Entegeka eno yiyo; abamemba abalala balonda ezaabwe.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Nyiga eppeesa lya kuuma ku mutwe gw'olubaawo olonde Okulaba, Okugoberera oba Kisirisiddwa; eddaala lyo erya kati lirina akabonero k'okukakasa era eppeesa liraga eddaala eppya. Enkyukakyuka bw'egaanibwa, obubaka bugamba lwaki era tewali kikyuka. Eppeesa likwekebwa ng'omuddukanya aziyiza okukuuma.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Tegeka Kaadi ekyusa ensengeka amakaadi mwe galagibwa mu buli lukalala: okusinziira ku lunaku olusembayo, omutwe, ekiseera ky'okukolebwa, obululu oba ensengeka y'obubonero bw'olubaawo. Ekyusa bulazi ky'olaba, era tewali kaadi esengulwa.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Nyiga Tegeka Kaadi ku mutwe gw'olubaawo olonde ensengeka; amakaadi mu buli lukalala gagigoberera era eppeesa ligamba Okusengeka kukola. Nyiga X okumpi naalyo okuggyawo okusengeka n'okudda ku nsengeka amakaadi mwe gaasikibwa. Okulonda kukuumibwa mu browser yo ne bw'otikka nate. Ku nsengeka y'Obubonero, omuddukanya w'olubaawo asobola okukyusa ensengeka y'obubonero ne Yambusa ne Kka ng'akyusa akabonero.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Entegeka z'Olubaawo zikuŋŋaanya buli kintu ekiteekeddwawo ku lubaawo luno lwokka: amateeka gaalwo, okuteekateeka, langi n'ekifaananyi eky'emabega, ennaku, endaba, obukubo, enkalala n'amakaadi, okufulumya n'okuyingiza, obubaka, webhooks n'etterekero. Ebisinga bya baddukanya b'olubaawo; omulimu gwo n'entegeka z'omukutu bye bisalawo biki by'olaba.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Ggulawo ekitundu ky'oku ddyo eky'olubaawo ne menu ey'ennyiriri essatu era onyige Entegeka z'Olubaawo. Londa ekiwandiiko, akapapula kaakyo oba olupapula ne lugulukawo. Ebiwandiiko bigattiddwa: amateeka gasooka, oluvannyuma endabika y'olubaawo, oluvannyuma bwe lukubibwa, oluvannyuma ekiyingira n'ekifuluma mu lwo, era ku nkomerero etterekero.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Kyusa langi eteekawo langi y'olubaawo luno lwennyini, buli memba gy'alaba ku lubaawo luno. Ngeri ya kwawula embaawo mu kutunula omulundi gumu. Abaddukanya b'olubaawo bokka be basobola okugikyusa.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Nyiga ekyokulabirako kya langi; ekola amangu ago, nga tewali ppeesa lya Tereka. Ku langi ez'olugalamivu n'ez'entangaavu osobola n'okulonda langi zo ne nnamuziga za langi n'ozikebera mu kulaba nga tonnaba. Langi gy'oteekawo ku lulwo mu Entegeka za Memba ekyasinga langi y'olubaawo ku lulwo.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: Ekirango ky'olubaawo bubaka omuddukanya w'olubaawo bw'awandiikira buli muntu ku lubaawo luno, obulagibwa mu lunyiriri waggulu w'enkalala z'olubaawo. Bukozese ku bigambo buli memba by'asaana okulaba, nga olunaku olusembayo oba enkyukakyuka mu ngeri olubaawo gye lukozesebwamu.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Wandiika ebiwandiiko, okutuuka ku nnukuta 2000 ez'ebiwandiiko ebyangu, kebera Kiraga buli muntu ku lubaawo luno, onyige Tereka. Abamemba balaba olunyiriri okutuusa lwe baluggalawo ne X yaalwo, ekirukweka ku bo bokka. Ekirango bwe kikyusibwa, kiddamu okulagibwa buli muntu.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: Ekifaananyi eky'emabega kifaananyi ekiragibwa emabega w'enkalala z'olubaawo, era ng'akatimba k'olubaawo ku lupapula lw'Embaawo zonna. Kiyinza okuba endagiriro y'ekifaananyi ku mukutu oba ekifaananyi ekyateekebwako ne kiterekebwa mu WeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Wandiika endagiriro y'ekifaananyi mu URL y'Ekifaananyi eky'emabega onyige Tereka, oba kozesa Ggyawo Ekifaananyi eky'emabega okukiggyawo. Okutereka ekifaananyi, nyiga Teekako ekifaananyi eky'emabega olonde fayiro; ebifaananyi ebiteekeddwako biragibwa wansi, okunyiga ekimu kukifuula ekifaananyi eky'emabega eky'olubaawo, era obubonero bukiwanula oba bukisazaamu.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Olunaku lukkiriza omuddukanya w'olubaawo okulonda engeri y'okuwandiika ennaku emu ku buli muntu ku lubaawo luno, mu kifo ky'engeri eteekeddwawo ku mukutu gwonna. Akapapula ke kamu kalina eppeesa lyo ery'ennamba za wiiki era, ku baddukanya b'olubaawo, okukwataganya kalenda okuteeka ennaku ezisembayo ez'amakaadi mu kalenda ya CalDAV nga Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Kebera Engeri y'Ennaku ey'olubaawo, londa engeri onyige Tereka; ggyako okukebera okudda ku ntegeka y'omukutu. Engeri ya memba gy'akoleeza mu Entegeka za Memba ekyasinga. Laga wiiki y'omwaka ekoleeza oba ezikiza ennamba za wiiki ku lulwo amangu ago. Ku kukwataganya kalenda, wandiika endagiriro ya kalenda, erinnya ly'omukozesa n'ekigambo ekyekusifu ekya app, kebera akasanduuko k'okukwataganya era Tereka.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: Entegeka z'Embaawo zonna zisalawo akatimba k'olubaawo luno kye kalaga ku lupapula lw'Embaawo zonna, nga omuwendo gw'amakaadi ga buli lukalala n'ebifaananyi by'abamemba. Era ziteekawo okukaddiwa kw'amakaadi, okutwala mu tterekero mu ngeri ey'otoma amakaadi agatakwatiddwako, n'oba obugazi bw'enkalala bwa muntu oba bwa bonna.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Kebera oba ggyako okukebera ku lunyiriri era luterekebwa amangu ago. Okukaddiwa kw'amakaadi bwe kukola, wandiika ennamba ssatu ez'ennaku oluvannyuma lwazo amakaadi gazikira mu madaala. Ku kutwala mu tterekero okw'otoma, wandiika ennaku mmeka ekaadi z'eyinza okumala nga tewali kikolebwa nga tennatwalibwa mu tterekero, oba kirekere awo nga kikalu okukiziyiza. Ebyokulabirako tebitwalibwa mu tterekero n'akatono.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Endaba y'Olubaawo erondawo endaba ki, nga Obukubo, Enkalala, Tabbulu, Kalenda, Gantt oba ebipande, eziweebwa mu menu y'Endaba y'Olubaawo luno, n'eyo olubaawo mw'eggulukira. Eteekebwawo okwawukana olubaawo bwe luba olwa bonna ne bwe luba olwa kyama.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: Akapapula kalina olunyiriri lumu ku buli ndaba n'obusanduuko buna: endaba eya bulijjo n'endaba ezilagibwa ku lubaawo olwa bonna, n'ebibiri bye bimu ku lubaawo olwa kyama. Kebera akasanduuko ka Laga ak'endaba okugiwa mu menu, n'akasanduuko kaayo aka Bulijjo okuggulawo olubaawo mu yo.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Akakubo kakwata entegeka z'obukubo ez'olubaawo lwonna: oba obukubo busobola okusikibwa, oba obugulumivu bwabwo busobola okukyusibwa, oba obukubo bwonna bugabana olunyiriri lumu olw'emitwe gy'enkalala, n'ebifo bya Scrum ki akakubo bye kalaga. Ebibinja by'Ekkomo lya WIP, amakomo ag'omulimu oguli mu kukolebwa agagabanibwa ku nkalala eziwera, nabyo biri wano.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Kebera obusanduuko bw'oyagala; akasanduuko ka Kisikibwa kali mu tabbulu waggulu. Olunyiriri lumu olw'emitwe gy'enkalala olugabanibwa luraga buli kakubo n'enkalala zonna ez'olubaawo wansi w'olunyiriri lumu olw'emitwe olusigala waggulu, nga tekyusa nkalala. Nyiga Ebibinja by'Ekkomo lya WIP wansi okwongerako oba okukyusa amakomo agagabanibwa.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: Olukalala lukwata entegeka z'enkalala ez'olubaawo lwonna: oba enkalala zisobola okusikibwa, oba obugazi bwazo busobola okukyusibwa, oba buli lukalala lulina obugazi bwe bumu, n'ekifo kya Scrum olukalala kye luraga. Era lukoleeza enkola z'entambula ya Kanban: enkola z'olukalala, enkalala ezaawuddwamu Kikolebwa ne Kimaliriziddwa, ekifo eky'okwewaayo n'ekkomo lya WIP ku buli muntu.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Kebera ebikoleeza by'oyagala; akasanduuko ka Kisikibwa kali mu tabbulu waggulu. Okukyusa obunene bwe kukkirizibwa, sika omukono wakati w'enkalala okukyusa obugazi. Olunyiriri lw'enkola y'entambula lulabika ng'ekintu ekyo kikoleezeddwa ku mukutu, era bwe kimala okukola, ebikwata ku kyo biteekebwawo okuva mu menu ya buli lukalala.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: Dduuka lifuula amakaadi g'olubaawo dduuka ery'oku mukutu eriragibwa mu ndaba y'olubaawo eya Dduuka. Omuddukanya w'olubaawo alonda ebifo eby'obwannannyini ki ebiri omuwendo, ennamba y'ekintu n'ebiriwo, enkalala ki ezitundibwamu, obubonero ki bwe bika, ebiragiro we biwandiikibwa n'engeri z'okusasula eziweebwa.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Teekawo ennyiriri onyige Tereka; buli kimu kiterekebwa wamu era seva ekikebera nate. Ekaadi erina omuwendo mu lukalala olutundibwamu efuuka ekintu. Ebiragiro biwandiikibwa ng'amakaadi mu lukalala lwa Orders, olulina okuba ku lubaawo olwa kyama, era omuguzi asobola okufuna imeyilo ey'okukakasa. Osobola n'okufuula Dduuka kye balaba abagenyi b'olubaawo olwa bonna.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: Ekaadi esalawo amakaadi amatono n'amakaadi amaggule ag'olubaawo luno kye galaga, ne mu nsengeka ki, buli kimu ku bwakyo. Gikozese ng'olubaawo lwesigama ku bifo bitono, okugeza okuteeka ennyonyola oba ebifo eby'obwannannyini okusooka, oba okulaga olunaku olusembayo okusooka ku makaadi amatono.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: Akapapula kalina ebitundu bibiri, Laga ku Kaadi Ntono ne Laga ku Kaadi. Kebera oba ggyako okukebera ekitundu oba ekifo okukiraga oba okukikweka, era sika ennyiriri okukyusa ensengeka yazo. Ebitundu ebimu birina menu yaabyo n'entegeka endala, nga Emirimu emitono n'engeri z'okusika ekaadi.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: Fulumya ewandiika olubaawo luno, oba ekitundu kyalwo, mu fayiro: engeri za WeKan zennyini, spreadsheets, PDF, HTML, fayiro za kalenda n'engeri z'ebikozesebwa ebirala bingi. Yingiza eyongera ebirimu okuva mu kufulumya kwa WeKan ku lubaawo luno. Okufulumya olubaawo si kopi-ey'obukuumi ey'omukutu gwonna.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: Mu Fulumya, sooka olonde ky'oyagala okuteekamu, oluvannyuma onyige engeri era fayiro ewanulwa. Mu Yingiza, londa fayiro y'okufulumya kwa WeKan mu ngeri ya json oba zip era ebirimu byayo byongerwa ku lubaawo luno. Okuyingiza kwetaaga olukusa okuwandiika ku lubaawo, era buli kimu kisobola okuzikizibwa omuddukanya w'omukutu.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: Obubaka buteekawo entegeka za bulijjo ez'olubaawo luno ez'obubaka bwa imeyilo n'obw'omu app, okujjukiza ku nnaku ezisembayo, imeyilo okudda ku kaadi, n'engeri obubaka gye butuusibwamu. Okulonda kwa memba okw'olwatu kusobola okusinga entegeka ya bulijjo ey'olubaawo.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: Ku kasanduuko k'omu app ne imeyilo, londa Bulijjo okugoberera entegeka y'omukutu, oba Yee oba Nedda okugisinga ku lubaawo luno. Wansi w'Okujjukiza ku nnaku ezisembayo, wandiika ennaku ez'okujjukirizaako, nga zaawuddwamu n'obuwumbi, 0 nga lwe lunaku olusembayo ate ennamba ez'ensa nga ze nnaku oluvannyuma lwalwo, oluvannyuma onyige Tereka. Ebitundu by'okutuusa wansi biteekawo obubaka kye bukwata, okugatta n'ebiseera.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: Webhooks ezifuluma ziweereza ebikolwa by'olubaawo luno ku mpeereza endala, nga ekikozesebwa kya chat oba okugatta kwo kwennyini, nga bwe bibaawo.
