Buli webhook eweereza ebiwandiiko by'ekikolwa wamu n'amannya ne links z'olubaawo, olukalala, akakubo, ekaadi n'abantu abakirimu.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Wandiika erinnya, endagiriro empeereza efuna gye yakuwa era, bw'eba egyagala, token, londa ekika onyige Kola. Webhook eterekeddwa eraga engeri endala: ebikolwa ki by'eweereza, obubaka obwa bwannannyini eri abamemba b'ekaadi ku Mattermost, n'engeri obubaka bwayo gye bugattibwamu n'ebiseera. Gikyuse era Tereka nate, oba kozesa Ziyiza Webhook Eno okugiyimiriza.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Abayambi babiri ab'enkiiko za Scrum, abaweebwa buli memba w'olubaawo. Daily standup ye ssaawa ey'okubala ewa buli memba ebbanga lye limu, ate Olubaawo lw'okwetunuulira lukola olubaawo oluggya olw'okwetunuulira kwa Tandika, Lekera awo, Weeyongere.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-how-i: Daily standup eraga abamemba b'olubaawo mu nsengeka etabuddwatabuddwa; Tandika ebala ebiseera by'omuntu asooka, ebifuuka ebimyufu bwe bisukka, ate Ekiddako ekwasa ku muddako okutuusa ku asembayo. Essaawa ekola mu browser yo yokka. Olubaawo lw'okwetunuulira lukola era luggulawo olubaawo oluggya olwa kyama n'enkalala Tandika okukola, Lekera awo okukola, Weeyongere okukola n'Ebikolwa.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-wha: Ekibinja ky'ekkomo lya WIP kkomo limu ery'omulimu oguli mu kukolebwa erigabanibwa enkalala bbiri oba okusingawo wamu, ku ntikko y'ekkomo lya buli lukalala. Kiyamba ng'omulimu oguli mu kukolebwa gubuna enkalala eziwera, nga Kikolebwa, Okwekebejja n'Okugezesa, oba ng'oyagala okussa ekkomo ku kakubo konna.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-how: Wansi wa Yongerako ekibinja ky'ekkomo lya WIP, kebera enkalala ez'okubalira awamu, oba londa akakubo onyige Kozesa ku kakubo okukebera enkalala zaako. Teekawo ekkomo onyige Yongerako ekibinja ky'ekkomo lya WIP. Ekibinja ekiriwo kisobola okukyusibwa ne Kozesa, okukoleezebwa oba okuzikizibwa ne Koleeza Ekkomo lya WIP, oba okuggibwawo ne Sazaamu.
help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: Emirimu emitono gyawula ekaadi ennene mu makaadi amatono, buli emu esobola okuweebwa omuntu, okuteekerwa ebiseera n'okusengulwa ku bwayo, ate ekaadi enzadde n'egiraga n'ebala emmeka egimaliriziddwa. Entegeka zino zisalawo emirimu emitono emipya we gikolerwa n'omulimu omutono bwe gulaga omuzadde gwagwo.
help-board-settings-subtasks-how-it-work: Londa engeri ekaadi entono ey'omulimu omutono gy'etuumamu omuzadde gwayo, oba amakaadi g'olubaawo galina ekitundu ky'Emirimu emitono, n'olubaawo, olukalala n'akakubo emirimu emitono emipya mwe gikolerwa. Mu bulijjo gigenda ku lubaawo lwagyo. Emirimu emitono gyennyini gyongerwako okuva mu kitundu ky'Emirimu emitono eky'ekaadi enzigule.
help-rules-what-it-is-description: Amateeka gakola olubaawo mu ngeri ey'otoma: ekintu bwe kibaawo, ekisitula, WeKan ekola ekintu, ekikolwa. Okugeza, ekaadi bw'esengulwa ku Done, giteeke ng'emaliriziddwa. Amateeka gakolebwa abaddukanya b'olubaawo, era olubaawo lusobola okukkiriza abamemba baalwo okugasoma.
help-rules-how-it-works-description: Wandiika omutwe, londa ekisitula era ojjuze ebifo byakyo, oluvannyuma olonde ekikolwa; etteeka literekebwa era likola okuva olwo okuggyako nga lizikiziddwa. Mu ndaba ya Workflow osobola okuzimba amateeka ng'osika ekisitula n'ekikolwa. Amateeka gasobola okukyusibwa amannya, okusazibwamu, okufulumizibwa n'okuyingizibwa, era etteeka liyinza okuba n'ebisitula n'ebikolwa ebisingawo mu bikwata ku lyo.
help-member-settings-what-it-is-descript: Entegeka za Memba ye menu yo, eggulwawo okuva ku linnya lyo ery'omukozesa oba ekifaananyi kyo waggulu ku ddyo. Erina empapula zo nga Amakaadi gange, Amakaadi agasembayo n'Agalina emmunyeenye, okulaba okw'awamu okw'embaawo, n'entegeka zo zonna, okuva ku profile n'ekigambo ekyekusifu okutuuka ku lulimi n'ennukuta.
help-member-settings-how-it-works-descri: Nyiga erinnya lyo ery'omukozesa oba ekifaananyi kyo olonde ekiwandiiko; olupapula lwakyo oba akapapula ne kagulukawo. By'olaba bisinziira ku kika kya akawunti yo, omulimu gwo n'entegeka z'omukutu. Profile y'ebikozesebwa ey'omuddukanya w'omukutu bw'ekweka ebikozesebwa ebimu ku lulwo, menu egamba bimeka ebikwekeddwa.
help-member-edit-profile-what-it-is-desc: Kyusa Profile ekyusa abantu abalala bwe bakulaba mu WeKan: erinnya lyo lyonna n'ennukuta ezisooka, era, omukutu bwe gukkiriza, erinnya lyo ery'omukozesa n'endagiriro ya imeyilo. Omukutu bwe gukkiriza, osobola n'okusazaamu oba okukweka erinnya ku akawunti yo wano.
help-member-edit-profile-how-it-works-de: Kyusa ebifo onyige Tereka; akapapula kaggalwa nga kikoze era kaaraga ensobi bwe kitaba bwe kityo. Erinnya ly'omukozesa oba endagiriro ya imeyilo ekozesebwa akawunti endala egaanibwa, era endagiriro ya imeyilo ekyusiddwa eteekebwako nti tekakasiddwa. Sazaamu eggyawo akawunti yo nga tekuzzibwawo, ate Kweka erinnya ku akawunti ekuuma ebyafaayo byo naye n'ekyusa erinnya lyo.
help-member-change-settings-what-it-is-d: Kyusa Entegeka ekwata okulonda kwo okw'okukyusa n'okulaga, nga emikono gy'okusika, okubonera amakaadi agakyuse okuva lwe wasembayo okugaggulawo, ensalo y'okussaako omwoyo, okutereka ebikyusa ne Enter, okuggulawo amakaadi amangi omulundi gumu n'eddoboozi ly'olukalala lw'okukebera. Bikola ku lulwo lwokka, ku buli lubaawo.
help-member-change-settings-how-it-works: Nyiga ekikoleeza okukikoleeza oba okukizikiza; akabonero k'okukakasa kalaga nti kikola era kiterekebwa amangu ago. Ku Laga omuwendo gw'amakaadi ng'olukalala lulimu agasukka, wandiika ennamba onyige Tereka. Engeri y'ennaku, entandikwa ya wiiki n'obubaka birina ebiwandiiko byabyo mu Entegeka za Memba.
help-member-change-color-what-it-is-desc: Kyusa langi eteekawo langi yo ey'endabika ya WeKan. Esinga langi y'omukutu wonna era ne langi y'olubaawo lwennyini ku mpapula z'olubaawo, naye ku lulwo lwokka.
help-member-change-color-how-it-works-de: Nyiga ekyokulabirako kya langi; ekola amangu ago. Ku langi ez'olugalamivu n'ez'entangaavu osobola okulonda langi zo ne nnamuziga za langi n'ozilaba mu kulaba nga tonnaba. Londa Langi eya bulijjo okuggyawo okulonda kwo n'okulaba nate langi z'olubaawo oba ez'omukutu.
help-member-change-font-what-it-is-descr: Ennukuta zikukkiriza okulonda ekika ky'ennukuta, obunene bw'ebiwandiiko ne langi y'ebiwandiiko eby'endabika ya WeKan yonna ku lulwo. Kiyamba okusoma, okugeza n'obunene obusingawo oba langi esaanira amaaso go.
help-member-change-font-how-it-works-des: Nyiga Bulijjo oba erimu ku mappeesa g'ennukuta; ennukuta ezateekebwa mu browser yo zokka ze ziweebwa. Londa obunene era olonde langi y'ebiwandiiko ku nnamuziga ya langi, oba nyiga Ggyawo okudda ku langi y'endabika. Enkyukakyuka zikola amangu ago era ziterekebwa ku profile yo, era olunyiriri olw'okulaba luraga ekivaamu.
help-member-change-avatar-what-it-is-des: Avatar yo kye kifaananyi ekitono ekiragibwa ku lulwo ku makaadi, mu nkalala z'abamemba, endowooza n'omutwe. Kyusa Avatar ekukkiriza okuteekako ebifaananyi, okulonda ekimu ekikozesebwa, okubisazaamu, oba okudda ku nnukuta zo ezisooka.
help-member-change-avatar-how-it-works-d: Nyiga Teekako avatar olonde ekifaananyi; kyongerwa ku lukalala, era okunyiga olunyiriri lwakyo kukifuula avatar yo, nga kibonereddwa n'akabonero k'okukakasa. Nyiga Ennukuta ezisooka okulaga ennukuta zo ezisooka mu kifo ky'ekyo. Akabonero k'akasero kasazaamu ekifaananyi ng'omaze okukakasa. Akapapula kaaraga amakomo g'obunene n'ekika kya fayiro omukutu bwe gubiteekawo.
help-member-change-password-what-it-is-d: Kyusa ekigambo ekyekusifu kikyusa ekigambo ekyekusifu ky'oyingiza mu WeKan. Kya akawunti ezirina ekigambo ekyekusifu ekya WeKan; akawunti eziyingira nga ziyita mu mpeereza endala zikyusiza ekigambo kyazo eyo.
help-member-change-password-how-it-works: Wandiika ekigambo kyo ekyekusifu ekya kati, oluvannyuma ekipya emirundi ebiri, oweereze. Omukutu guyinza okwetaaga obuwanvu obutono era ne gugaana ebigambo ebyekusifu ebifaanagana ennyo n'erinnya lyo ery'omukozesa oba imeyilo, oba ebyazuulibwa mu kubba data okumanyiddwa. Oluvannyuma lw'enkyukakyuka buli kiseera kya akawunti yo kifulumizibwa, n'oyingira nate n'ekigambo ekyekusifu ekipya.
help-member-passkeys-what-it-is-descript: Passkey ekukkiriza okuyingira n'ekinkumu, ffeesi, ekisiba sikiriini oba ekisumuluzo eky'obukuumi eky'ekyuma kino mu kifo ky'ekigambo kyo ekyekusifu. Passkey esigala ku kyuma kyo era WeKan ekuuma ekitundu kyayo eky'olwatu kyokka.
help-member-passkeys-how-it-works-descri: Wandiika erinnya nga Essimu yange onyige Yongerako passkey ku kyuma kino, oluvannyuma okakase n'ekisiba sikiriini kyo browser bw'ebuuza. Passkeys zo ziragibwa n'amannya gaazo n'ennaku, era akabonero k'akasero kaggyawo emu. Browser bw'etasobola kukola passkeys, akapapula kakigamba.
help-member-sqrl-what-it-is-description: SQRL ekukkiriza okuyingira ng'osika koodi ya QR ne app ya SQRL, nga tolina kigambo kyekusifu. Wano oyongerako endagamuntu yo eya SQRL ku akawunti yo omulundi gumu, oba ogiggyawo nate.
help-member-sqrl-how-it-works-descriptio: Nyiga Yongerako endagamuntu yange eya SQRL koodi ya QR n'erabika. Gisike ne app ya SQRL, oba nyiga Ggulawo SQRL client ku client eri ku kompyuta eno; akapapula kakubuulira endagamuntu lw'eyongeddwako, oba koodi bw'eba eweddeko oba nga kigaanye. Ggyawo endagamuntu yange eya SQRL egiggya ku akawunti yo.
help-member-two-factor-what-it-is-descri: Okukakasa okw'emitendera ebiri kufuula okuyingira okubuuza koodi ey'ennamba 6 okuva mu app y'okukakasa ku ssimu yo oluvannyuma lw'ekigambo kyo ekyekusifu, ekigambo ekyekusifu ekibbiddwa kyokka ne kitamala okuyingira mu akawunti yo.
help-member-two-factor-how-it-works-desc: Nyiga Koleeza Okukakasa okw'Emitendera Ebiri, oluvannyuma osike koodi ya QR ne app y'okukakasa oba owandiike koodi eragibwa wansi waayo mu app. Wandiika koodi ey'ennamba 6 app gy'eraga onyige Kakasa era Koleeza. Okuva olwo okuyingira kubuuza koodi, era akapapula ke kamu kasobola okukizikiza nate okuggyako ng'omuddukanya wo akyetaaga.
help-member-hidden-boards-what-it-is-des: Embaawo ezikwekeddwa ziraga embaawo z'oleka ze wali osobola okutuukako ng'oyita mu ttiimu, ekibiina oba domain ya imeyilo yo, WeKan n'ezikweka ku lulwo mu kifo ky'ekyo. Okuleka olubaawo ng'olwo tekukyusa bumemba bwo mu ttiimu oba mu kibiina.
help-member-hidden-boards-how-it-works-d: Akapapula kaaraga olunyiriri lumu ku buli lubaawo olukwekeddwa, oba kagamba nti tewali. Nyiga Zzaawo okumpi n'olubaawo okuluzza mu Mbaawo zonna. Kino kiluggya ku lukalala lwo olukwekeddwa lwokka; oba osobola okuggulawo olubaawo kikyasalibwawo olubaawo lwennyini.
help-member-change-language-what-it-is-d: Kyusa Olulimi erondawo olulimi lw'endabika ya WeKan ku lulwo. Okulonda kwo kuterekebwa ku profile yo, kale kukugoberera ku buli browser. Okutuusa lw'olonda, WeKan egoberera ennimi za browser yo era n'edda ku Lungereza.
help-member-change-language-how-it-works: Ennimi ziragibwa n'amannya gaazo zennyini, n'ebendera, olunyiriri lw'ekitundu ku nnimi ez'ebitundu n'ekiwandiiko ku nnimi eziwandiikibwa okuva ku ddyo okudda ku kkono; olulimi olwa kati lulina akabonero k'okukakasa. Nyiga olulimi era endabika ekyuka amangu ago.
help-member-invite-people-what-it-is-des: Yita Abantu eweereza imeyilo ne koodi y'okuyita eri abantu abatannaba kuba na akawunti, basobole okwewandiisa ng'okwewandiisa okw'obwannannyini kuzikiziddwa. Kikkiriza abamemba ba domain ya imeyilo ey'ekibiina okuleeta bannaabwe nga tewali muddukanya.
help-member-invite-people-how-it-works-d: Wandiika endagiriro za imeyilo, emu ku buli lunyiriri oba nga zaawuddwamu n'obuwumbi, kebera embaawo ze basaanidde okwegattako nga beewandiisa, onyige Yita. Akapapula kagamba oba okuyita kwaweerezeddwa. Weetaaga omulimu ku lubaawo oguyinza okuyita ku buli lubaawo olukebereddwa, era endagiriro eriko akawunti dda eyimiriza okuweereza.
help-member-date-what-it-is-description: Olunaku lulonda engeri ennaku gye ziwandiikibwamu ku lulwo, nga omwaka-omwezi-olunaku oba olunaku-omwezi-omwaka, n'essaawa oba nga tezirina. Engeri yo gy'okoleeza esinga ey'olubaawo n'ey'omukutu. Akapapula ke kamu kateekawo olunaku olusooka olwa wiiki n'enkola ya kalenda.
help-member-date-how-it-works-descriptio: Waggulu w'akapapula kaaraga engeri z'omukutu n'ez'olubaawo olwa kati, olabe ky'osikira. Kebera Entegeka za Memba: Engeri y'Ennaku era olonde engeri, teekawo entandikwa ya wiiki n'enkola ya kalenda bw'oba oyagala, onyige Tereka. Ggyako okukebera engeri yo era otereke okugoberera olubaawo oba omukutu nate.
help-bookmarks-what-it-is-description: Ekibinja ky'emmunyeenye ku mutwe ye menu y'ebiwandiiko byo by'olonze: ekuuma embaawo, empapula endala eza WeKan, n'okuva mu menu zaabyo obukubo, enkalala n'amakaadi nga biri okunyiga omulundi gumu. Emmunyeenye zo za ggwe wekka.
help-bookmarks-how-it-works-description: Nyiga emmunyeenye okuteekako oba okuggyako emmunyeenye ku lubaawo oba olupapula lw'olimu; omuwendo gulaga mmeka z'olina. Nyiga akasaale oba omuwendo okuggulawo olukalala era onyige olunyiriri okugendayo, oba Laba byonna ebirina emmunyeenye ku lupapula lwonna olw'Agalina emmunyeenye. Mu Mbaawo zonna / Agalina emmunyeenye osobola okuggyako emmunyeenye ku butimba n'okubusika okukyusa ensengeka.
help-card-similar-cards-what-it-is-descr: Amakaadi agafaanagana galaga amakaadi g'olubaawo luno omutwe n'ennyonyola byago ebisinga okufaanana n'eno, kopi ey'okubiri ey'omulimu gwe gumu erabibwe ng'omulimu tegunnakolebwa emirundi ebiri. Ekyenkanyankanya ennyo kibonerwa nti Kiyinza okuba kopi.
help-card-similar-cards-how-it-works-des: Amakaadi agafaanagana okutuuka ku taano galagibwa wano, buli emu n'olukalala lw'erimu, era omutwe gugabala. Nyiga emu okugiggulawo. Okugeraageranya kwe kukwataganya ebiwandiiko okwangu okukolebwa seva, nga tewali mpeereza ya AI. Ekitundu kisobola okukwekebwa mu Entegeka z'Olubaawo / Ekaadi, olunyiriri Amakaadi agafaanagana, Laga ku Kaadi.
help-card-activities-what-it-is-descript: Ebikolwa bye byafaayo by'ekaadi yennyini: ani yagikola, yakyusa omutwe gwayo, yayongerako akabonero, yagisengula, yawandiika endowooza oba yayungako fayiro, era ddi. Biddamu ekyabaawo ku kaadi eno nga tobuuzizza muntu yenna.
help-card-activities-how-it-works-descri: Ebibaddewo ebisinga obuggya biragibwa mu nsengeka, n'emitwe, obubonero, ebitundu by'endowooza n'amannya ga fayiro nga biragibwa mu ngeri y'emu nga ku kaadi yennyini. Nyiga omutwe oguliko link okugenda ku kaadi, olukalala oba olubaawo olwo. Omuddukanya w'omukutu asobola okulonda mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Entegeka / Obukuumi okulaga ebiwandiiko ebitegekeddwa ng'ebiwandiiko ebyangu oba nga tebirina links ezinyigibwa.
help-card-labels-what-it-is-description: Obubonero bwe bubonero obulina langi obw'olubaawo, obukozesebwa okugatta n'okusengejja amakaadi okusinziira ku mulamwa, obukulu oba ekintu kyonna ttiimu ky'ekkiriziganyako. Akabonero kayinza n'okuba n'olunaku lwako olusembayo, ekikafuula omutendera omwangu nga Sprint 1 oba v2.0 ku buli kaadi ekakwata.
help-card-labels-how-it-works-descriptio: Nyiga akabonero oba eppeesa lya plus okuggulawo akapapula k'obubonero, oluvannyuma onyige obubonero okubuteeka ku kaadi oba okubuggyako; akabonero k'okukakasa kalaga obulondeddwa. Ekkalaamu okumpi n'akabonero ekyusa erinnya lyako, langi n'olunaku olusembayo, era akabonero akalina olunaku olusembayo kalaga olunaku olwo okumpi nako. Obupapula obusiige n'ebifo biri mu kitundu kino kye kimu.
help-card-dates-what-it-is-description: Ekaadi erina ennaku nnya ez'okwesalirawo: Okufunibwa lw'omulimu lwe gwatuuka, Okutandika omulimu lwe gwatandika, Olusembayo ku nkomerero y'ekiseera ate Okumaliriza lwe gwamalirizibwa. Akabonero k'olunaku olusembayo kalina langi okusinziira ku bwangu era kabala ennaku ezisigadde, omulimu oguzze ekikeerezi ne gulabika ku lubaawo.
help-card-dates-how-it-works-description: Nyiga plus okumpi n'olunaku, oba akabonero k'olunaku, londa olunaku n'essaawa otereke; olunaku olusembayo olutaliko ssaawa endondeddwa lufuna 17:00. Ggulawo akapapula ke kamu nate okulukyusa oba okulusazaamu. Obusumuluzo bwa keyboard bwe bukola, okunyiga d ku kaadi kuggulawo olunaku lwayo olusembayo. Ekaadi era ebala emirundi olunaku lwayo olusembayo gye lukyusiddwa.
help-card-members-what-it-is-description: Ekitundu ky'Abamemba kigamba ani akwatibwako ekaadi: abamemba baayo, abaweereddwa omulimu, ani yagikola, ani yasaba omulimu n'ani yaguwa. Eyasaba ne Eyawa bisobola okukwata abamemba b'olubaawo era n'ekiwandiiko eky'eddembe, okugeza erinnya okuva mu kigoberera ekirala.
help-card-members-how-it-works-descripti: Nyiga plus enneekulungirivu mu lunyiriri okuggulawo olukalala lw'abamemba b'olubaawo olonde abantu; balagibwa ng'ebifaananyi oba ennukuta ezisooka, era okunyiga ekifaananyi nate kubaggyawo. Wansi wa Eyasaba ne Eyawa, link ya Yongerako wansi wa plus ewandiika ekiwandiiko eky'eddembe mu kifo ky'ekyo. Ennyiriri ki ezirabika birondebwa mu Entegeka z'Olubaawo / Ekaadi.
help-card-fields-what-it-is-description: Ekitundu ky'Ekaadi kikwata ebifo by'ekaadi yennyini eby'okukola, nga okwesigamako, embeera y'okuziyizibwa, ekika ky'empeereza, obubonero bw'obukulu, ennamba yaayo ey'okusengeka n'amappeesa gaayo. Ekaadi enzigule eraga buli kifo olubaawo kye lwalonda okulaga ku makaadi, kibe kikalu oba nedda, nga kyetegefu okujjuzibwa.
help-card-fields-how-it-works-descriptio: Jjuza oba kyusa ekifo butereevu mu kitundu kino. Ekirabika wano, mu kitundu ki ne mu nsengeka ki kisalibwawo ku lubaawo lwonna mu Entegeka z'Olubaawo / Ekaadi, mu kitundu kya Laga ku Kaadi: kebera oba ggyako okukebera olunyiriri, oba lusike okukyusa ensengeka. Ekaadi entono egoberera ekitundu kya Laga ku Kaadi Ntono mu ngeri y'emu.
help-card-time-what-it-is-description: Okugoberera ebiseera kuwandiika essaawa mmeka ezikozeseddwa ku kaadi, n'okubalirira okw'okwesalirawo, obubonero bwa Billable ne Overtime n'ekitabo kya buli lunaku eky'ani yakola bbanga ki. Omugatte guliisa endaba z'olubaawo ez'ebiseera, emirimu n'okusasuza, era essaawa za Flowtime ne Pomodoro wano zigwongerako.
help-card-time-how-it-works-description: Nyiga akabonero k'ebiseera oba menu ey'ennyiriri essatu okumpi n'Ebiseera ebikozeseddwa okuggulawo Kyusa ebiseera ebikozeseddwa, wandiika essaawa (ennamba ez'obutundu zikkirizibwa), okubalirira n'obubonero bw'oyagala, otereke. Wansi w'Ebiseera buli lunaku, londa olunaku, wandiika essaawa n'ekiwandiiko onyige Wandiika ebiseera; osobola okuggyawo ekiwandiiko kyo okutuusa lwe kikakasibwa oba lwe kisasulwa. Akabonero kafuuka akamyufu nga Overtime ekebereddwa.
help-card-custom-fields-what-it-is-descr: Ebifo eby'obwannannyini bye bifo eby'enjawulo eby'olubaawo lwennyini eby'amakaadi gaalwo, okumpi n'ebyo ebizimbiddwamu: enkyusa, bajeti, kasitoma, akasanduuko k'okukebera oba okulonda okuva mu lukalala. Binnyonnyolwa omulundi gumu ku lubaawo, era buli kaadi n'esobola okukwata omuwendo gwayo.
help-card-custom-fields-how-it-works-des: Wano olonda ebifo eby'obwannannyini ki eby'olubaawo ekaadi eno by'ekozesa era ojjuze emiwendo gyabyo. Ebifo ebipya bikolebwa mu Entegeka z'Olubaawo / Ekaadi, mu kitundu ky'Ebifo eby'obwannannyini, ng'olonda erinnya n'ekika nga Ebiwandiiko, Ennamba, Olunaku, Okulondako, Akasanduuko k'okukebera oba Ensimbi. Ekifo kisobola okulagibwa ne ku kaadi entono, era ebifo by'ennamba bisobola okugattibwa waggulu wa buli lukalala.
help-card-planning-poker-what-it-is-desc: Planning Poker ekkiriza ttiimu okubalirira ekaadi awamu. Buli omu alonda omuwendo okuva mu kibinja nga talaba bya balala bye baalonda, era okulonda bwe kuggwa WeKan eraga ani yalonda ki n'omuwendo ki ogwawangula, okubalirira ne kukkiriziganyizibwako mu kifo ky'okulowoozebwa omuntu omu.
help-card-planning-poker-how-it-works-de: Ggulawo menu ey'ennyiriri essatu ey'ekitundu, Kyusa Planning Poker, kkiriza abakozesa bonna abayingidde n'oteekawo ekiseera ky'enkomerero bw'oyagala, otereke. Buli alonda anyiga omuwendo gumu; okunyiga omulala kukyusa okulonda. Omuddukanya w'olubaawo anyiga Maliriza okulaba ebivaamu, awandiika ennamba n'anyiga Teekawo Okubalirira. Ddamu esangula okulonda ku mutendera omupya.
help-card-scrum-what-it-is-description: Entegeka za Scrum zikwata ekifo ky'ekaadi mu kuteekateeka kwa Scrum okw'olubaawo: sprint yaayo ne sprints eziyise, okufulumya, ekika ky'ensonga, ebisaanyizo by'okukkiriza n'eddaala lya backlog. Ekaadi era esobola okubonerwa nga Story oba Task, endaba za sprint ne backlog bye zikozesa.
help-card-scrum-how-it-works-description: Ggulawo Kyusa wansi w'ebifo okubikyusa otereke; abo bokka abayinza okukyusa ekaadi be basobola okubikyusa. Menu ey'ennyiriri essatu mu mutwe gw'ekitundu erondawo ekika ky'ekaadi: tewali, Story oba Task. Sprints zennyini ziteekebwateekebwa, zitandikibwa era ziggalwa mu ndaba za Scrum ez'olubaawo, era ebifo ki ku bino ebirabika biteekebwawo mu Entegeka z'Olubaawo / Ekaadi.
help-card-description-what-it-is-descrip: Ennyonyola kye kiwandiiko ekikulu eky'ekaadi: ebikwata ku mulimu, ebiwandiiko, links oba ebiwandiiko by'olukiiko ebiteereddwamu. Ewandiikibwa mu Markdown, kale esobola okuba n'emitwe, enkalala, links, emoji n'ebifaananyi nga esigala ebiwandiiko ebyangu okukyusa.
help-card-description-how-it-works-descr: Nyiga ennyonyola okugikyusa mu kasanduuko k'ebiwandiiko ebyangu. Wandiika akabonero ka at n'entandikwa y'erinnya okufuna ebiteeso by'abamemba. Tereka, era ebiwandiiko biragibwa nga bitegekeddwa. Fayiro eziteekeddwako zisigala mu kitundu ky'Ebiyungiddwako era zisobola okwogerwako okuva mu biwandiiko.
help-card-checklists-what-it-is-descript: Olukalala lw'okukebera lukalala lw'ebintu ku kaadi, buli kimu nga kikeberwa nga kiwedde, ku mitendera, ebisaanyizo by'okukkiriza oba ebya bulijjo. Ekaadi esobola okuba n'enkalala eziwera, era ekaadi entono esobola okulaga ebintu bimeka ebimaliriziddwa.
help-card-checklists-how-it-works-descri: Yongerako olukalala lw'okukebera ne plus yaalwo, oluvannyuma oyongereko ebintu obikebere nga biwedde. Menu ey'ennyiriri essatu eya buli lukalala erina ebikolwa byalwo: okukyusa ebintu byonna omulundi gumu ng'ebiwandiiko, okufulumya oba okuyingiza, okulusengula oba okulukoppa, okukebera oba okuggyako okukebera ebintu byonna, okukweka ebintu ebikebereddwa, okuteekawo okuddamu okw'otoma okuggyako okukebera kwonna buli lunaku, buli wiiki oba buli mwezi, oba okulusazaamu. Olukalala lw'okukebera luyinza n'okuba n'olunaku lwalwo olusembayo.
help-card-subtasks-what-it-is-descriptio: Emirimu emitono gyawula ekaadi ennene mu makaadi amatono, buli emu esobola okuweebwa omuntu, okuteekerwa ebiseera n'okusengulwa ku bwayo, ate ekaadi eno enzadde n'egiraga n'ebala emmeka egimaliriziddwa. Omulimu omutono ye kaadi eya bulijjo, ekuumibwa ku lubaawo olulondeddwa ku mirimu emitono.
help-card-subtasks-how-it-works-descript: Nyiga plus, wandiika omutwe era Tereka okukola omulimu omutono; kebera Sikira obubonero bw'omuzadde okukoppa obubonero bw'ekaadi eno ku gwo. Akabonero ka link kayongerako ekaadi eriwo ng'omulimu omutono mu kifo ky'ekyo. Menu ey'ennyiriri essatu eya buli mulimu omutono erina Gulabe, Genda ku Lubaawo era, ku baddukanya b'olubaawo, Sazaamu. Nyiga omutwe gw'omulimu omutono okugukyusa erinnya.
help-card-attachments-what-it-is-descrip: Ebiyungiddwako ze fayiro ezikuumibwa n'ekaadi: ebiwandiiko, ebifaananyi, vidiyo, logs oba archives. Ekifaananyi kisobola n'okufuuka ekifaananyi ky'oku ngulu ekiragibwa ku kaadi entono.
help-card-attachments-how-it-works-descr: Nyiga plus okwongerako fayiro okuva ku kompyuta yo, teekamu oba suula ekifaananyi, yunga ekaadi endala, oba kuba ekifaananyi ekipya. Ekkomo ly'obunene lyonna n'ebika bya fayiro ebikkirizibwa biragibwa wansi w'okulonda kuno. Nyiga ekiyungiddwako okukiggulawo mu kulaga ebifaananyi, era kozesa amappeesa okumpi nakyo okukiwanula, okukikyusa erinnya oba okukisazaamu; menu yaakyo ey'ennyiriri essatu erina okulonda kw'ekifaananyi ky'oku ngulu.
help-card-comments-what-it-is-descriptio: Endowooza ye mboozi y'ekaadi: ebibuuzo, eby'okuddamu, amawulire n'ebisalibwawo, ebikuumibwa n'omulimu gwe bikwatako. Endowooza esobola okuddamu eyasooka, era okuddamu kuragibwa wansi waayo ng'olujegere.
help-card-comments-how-it-works-descript: Wandiika mu kifo ky'endowooza, ng'okozesa Markdown era ng'oyogera ku bantu n'akabonero ka at, ogiteeke. Nyiga Ddamu okumpi n'endowooza okugiddamu; ekiwandiiko kya Mu kuddamu kiraga ky'oddamu, era okukiggalawo kukola endowooza eya bulijjo. Osobola okukyusa oba okusazaamu endowooza zo, era ku mbaawo ezimu awandiika endowooza yekka y'asobola okugikyusa.
help-card-stickers-what-it-is-descriptio: Obupapula obusiige bubonero butono obuteekebwa ku kaadi, nga engalo eyimusiddwa, ekiwuka, essaawa oba ekikopo, okugibonera mu kutunula omulundi gumu nga tokozesezza kabonero oba langi. Buragibwa ku kaadi entono ne mu kaadi enzigule.
help-card-stickers-how-it-works-descript: Nyiga akapapula akasiige mu kulonda okukateeka ku kaadi; akabonero k'okukakasa kalaga nti kali ku kaadi, era okukanyiga nate kukaggyako. Mu kaadi, akasalaba akatono okumpi n'akapapula akasiige kakaggyawo. Okwongerako n'okuggyawo kwetaaga olukusa okukyusa ekaadi.
help-card-locations-what-it-is-descripti: Ekaadi esobola okuba n'ebifo ebiwera, ebifo omulimu we gukolerwa, nga ofiisi ya kasitoma, ekifo oba ekifo eky'omukolo. Buli kimu kirina erinnya, endagiriro era, bwe zimanyibwa, ennamba z'ekifo ne link ya Ggulawo ku maapu.
help-card-locations-how-it-works-descrip: Jjuza erinnya ly'ekifo, endagiriro, latitude ne longitude onyige Tereka. Okuteekamu link ya maapu kukkiriza akapapula okuzuula ekifo ku lulwo, waleme kubaawo muntu yenna awandiika nnamba z'ekifo. Okunyiga ekifo ku kaadi kukiggulawo nate okukikyusa oba okukisazaamu, era akasalaba okumpi nakyo kakiggyawo amangu ago.
help-card-dependencies-what-it-is-descri: Okwesigamako kuyunga ekaadi eno ku makaadi amalala: egaziyiza, eziyizibwa go, egalongoosa, ekoppa go oba ekwatagana nago. Okwesigamako bwe kukoleezebwa mu Entegeka za Memba, kukubibwa nga layini ez'obusaale ezirina langi ku lubaawo lwonna, ensengeka y'omulimu n'erabika mu kutunula omulundi gumu.
help-card-dependencies-how-it-works-desc: Londa ekika ky'enkolagana ne langi, oluvannyuma onoonye era onyige ekaadi ey'okuyungako. Link eragibwa mu Kwesigamako kw'ekaadi era nga layini ku lubaawo. Nyiga layini, oba kozesa Okwesigamako kw'ekaadi, okukyusa ekika kyayo, langi oba akabonero, oba okugiggyawo. Osobola n'okusika omukono gw'okuyunga ogw'ekaadi entono ku kaadi endala.
help-card-action-items-what-it-is-descri: Ebikolwa bifuula ennyiriri ez'eby'okukola eziri mu biwandiiko by'olukiiko ebiteereddwamu amakaadi. Ennyiriri nga TODO: Kwata ekifo, olunyiriri lw'omulimu olutakebereddwa, oba olunyiriri olutandika n'okwogera ku muntu zizuulibwa okusinziira ku ndabika yazo, nga tewali AI.
help-card-action-items-how-it-works-desc: Akapapula kaaraga amakaadi agandikoleddwa, buli emu n'akabonero k'okukebera ne memba okwogera ku muntu kw'osonga. Ggyako okukebera ky'otayagala onyige Kola. Amakaadi amaggya gagenda mu lukalala lwe lumu n'ekaadi eno era gaddamu okugiyungako. Okwogera ku muntu kufuuka memba bwokka ng'omuntu oyo memba akola ku lubaawo.
help-card-history-what-it-is-description: Ebyafaayo lwe lukalala lwa buli nkyukakyuka eyakolebwa ku kaadi eno: ani yakyusa ki, ddi, n'okuva ku muwendo ki okudda ku ki. Enkyukakyuka yonna esobola okulondebwa n'ezzibwawo, ensobi esobole okuggibwawo ne bwe kiba oluvannyuma.
help-card-history-how-it-works-descripti: Wandiika mu Noonya okukendeeza ku nnyiriri, oba nyiga ekifaananyi ky'omuntu okulaba enkyukakyuka ze zokka. Tambula mu mpapula n'obusaale. Kebera olunyiriri lumu oba okusingawo onyige Zzaawo; ennyiriri eziwera zizzibwawo ezisinga obukadde nga ze zisooka ng'enkyukakyuka emu, eyo yennyini esobola okuggibwawo. Ctrl+Z ne Ctrl+Y nabyo biggyawo era biddamu enkyukakyuka yo esembayo.
help-card-qr-code-what-it-is-description: Koodi ya QR eraga link y'ekaadi eno nga koodi gy'osobola okusika, okuggulawo ekaadi ku ssimu oba tablet nga towandiise ndagiriro yaayo. Tekyusa kintu ku kaadi.
help-card-qr-code-how-it-works-descripti: Tunuza kkamera y'essimu ku koodi era oggulewo link; endagiriro era eragibwa ng'ebiwandiiko wansi waayo. Koodi ekubibwa mu browser yo era tewali kiweerezebwa wonna. Buli agisika akyetaaga okuyingira n'okuba n'olukusa ku lubaawo. Link empanvu ennyo ku koodi ya QR etegeezebwa mu kifo ky'ekyo.
help-card-move-what-it-is-description: Sengula Ekaadi esengula ekaadi ku kifo ekirala ku lubaawo luno oba ku lubaawo olulala. Ekola okusika kye kukola, ne we kutasobola kutuuka, nga olubaawo olulala oba ekifo ekituufu mu lukalala oluwanvu.
help-card-move-how-it-works-description: Londa olubaawo, akakubo n'olukalala, oluvannyuma ekaadi n'oba ogenda waggulu oba wansi waayo. Osobola okukyusa omutwe, okuwandiika ensonga y'okusengula bw'oyagala, n'okukebera Leka link mu kifo ekyasooka okukuuma ekaadi eyungiddwa we yali. Nyiga Kimaliriziddwa ekifo ekigendebwamu bwe kimala okutikka. Shift+M nayo eggulawo akapapula kano, era ekifo ekigendebwamu kijjukirwa ku buli lubaawo.
help-card-copy-what-it-is-description: Koppa Ekaadi ekola kopi empya eyeetongodde ey'ekaadi ku lubaawo luno oba olulala, n'ennamba yaayo ne kopi zaayo ez'endowooza, enkalala z'okukebera, ebiyungiddwako n'emirimu emitono.
help-card-copy-how-it-works-description: Kyusa omutwe bw'oyagala; omutwe omukalu tegukoppa kintu. Londa olubaawo, akakubo n'olukalala, oluvannyuma ekaadi n'oba kopi egenda waggulu oba wansi waayo, onyige Kimaliriziddwa. Kopi bw'egaanibwa, ensonga eragibwa wano. Shift+C nayo eggulawo akapapula kano, era ekifo ekigendebwamu kijjukirwa ku buli lubaawo.
help-card-recurrence-what-it-is-descript: Okuddiŋŋana kw'ekaadi kufuula WeKan okukola kopi empya ey'ekaadi eno mu lukalala lwe lumu okusinziira ku nteekateeka, ku mulimu oguddiŋŋana nga lipoota ya buli wiiki oba invoyisi ya buli mwezi egyandikoleddwa n'omukono.
help-card-recurrence-how-it-works-descri: Londa Buli lunaku, Buli wiiki oba Buli mwezi, oba Kizikiziddwa okukiyimiriza; Kizikiziddwa kye kya bulijjo. Seva olwo ekola kopi yokka, nga tewali nteekateeka ndala yeetaagisa. Okutwala ekaadi mu tterekero nakwo kukiyimiriza okukola kopi endala, ne bwe kiba nti ebbanga likyateekeddwawo.
help-card-copy-many-what-it-is-descripti: Koppa Ekyokulabirako ku Makaadi Amangi ekola kopi eziwera ez'ekaadi eno omulundi gumu. Ekaadi ekola ng'ekyokulabirako: enkalala zaayo ez'okukebera, ebiyungiddwako, obubonero n'ebifo ebirala bigenda ku buli kopi, era omutwe n'ennyonyola byokka bye byawukana.
help-card-copy-many-how-it-works-descrip: Mu kasanduuko k'ebiwandiiko, wandiika ekiwandiiko kimu ku buli kaadi n'omutwe gwayo n'ennyonyola, ng'ogoberera ekyokulabirako ekimaze okujjuzibwamu. Londa olubaawo, akakubo, olukalala n'ekifo okumpi n'ekaadi, oluvannyuma onyige Kimaliriziddwa. Ebiwandiiko bwe bitaba mu ngeri entuufu, tewali kikolebwa era ensobi eragibwa wano.
help-card-color-what-it-is-description: Teekawo langi ewa ekaadi langi yaayo ey'emabega erabike ku lubaawo, okugeza emmyufu ku mulimu ogw'amangu oba langi ya kasitoma. Ebiwandiiko by'ekaadi bifuulibwa ebisomeka ku langi mu ngeri ey'otoma.
help-card-color-how-it-works-description: Nyiga emu ku langi ezirina amannya, langi ey'obwannannyini emaze okukozesebwa ku lubaawo luno, oba londa langi yonna wansi wa Langi ey'obwannannyini, oluvannyuma onyige Tereka. Ggyawo eggyawo langi. Langi eragibwa ku kaadi entono ne mu kaadi enzigule, okuggyako ng'ezikiziddwa mu Entegeka z'Olubaawo / Ekaadi.
help-card-drawing-what-it-is-description: Okukuba ebifaananyi kukukkiriza okukuba oba okuwandiika n'omukono ku kaadi ne mouse, olugalo oba ekkalaamu: ekifaananyi ekyangu, ekipande, omukono oba ekiwandiiko eky'omukono. Ekifaananyi kisigala nga kisobola okukyusibwa era ekifaananyi kyakyo kiterekebwa ng'ekiyungiddwako ku kaadi.
help-card-drawing-how-it-works-descripti: Londa langi n'obugazi bwa layini okube. Ggyawo eddayo emabega, Ekisangula kiggyawo layini ze kikwatako ate Sangula byonna kiggyawo byonna. Tereka ekuuma layini ku kaadi n'etereka ekifaananyi ng'ekiyungiddwako; ekifaananyi ekipya kifuuka ekifaananyi ky'oku ngulu eky'ekaadi. Ebifaananyi ebiterekeddwa biragibwa wano okubiggulawo n'okubikyusa nate, era Wanula nga SVG etereka kimu nga fayiro.
help-card-more-what-it-is-description: Ebisingawo biraga link y'ekaadi, amakaadi gaayo amazadde ne lwe yakolebwa. Wano ekaadi w'efuulibwa omulimu omutono ogw'ekaadi endala, era omuddukanya w'olubaawo w'asazaamu ekaadi emirembe gyonna.
help-card-more-how-it-works-description: Koppa link y'ekaadi ku clipboard ekoppa endagiriro y'ekaadi. Wansi wa Kyusa omuzadde w'ekaadi, londa olubaawo olw'ensibuko n'ekaadi enzadde, oba tewali okugifuula ekaadi ey'oku ntikko nate; Yongerako ekaadi enzadde endala eyongerako abazadde abalala, era akasalaba okumpi n'omu kamuggyawo. Sazaamu, ya baddukanya b'olubaawo bokka, eggyawo ekaadi emirembe gyonna oluvannyuma lw'okukakasa.
help-card-create-board-what-it-is-descri: Kola olubaawo okuva ku kaadi eno efuula ekaadi link ey'olubaawo oluggya. Kya kaadi ekuze n'efuuka pulojekiti yaayo: omulimu gusengukira ku lubaawo lwagwo, era ekaadi esigala we yali ng'ekkubo eriyingira mu lwo.
help-card-create-board-how-it-works-desc: Erinnya ly'olubaawo oluggya lujjuzibwa n'omutwe gw'ekaadi; likyuse bw'oyagala onyige Kola olubaawo okuva ku kaadi eno. Olubaawo lukolebwa nga ggwe omuddukanya waalwo, era ekaadi olwo n'eggulawo olubaawo olwo. Tewali kirala ku kaadi ekikyuka. Bwe kigaanibwa, ensonga eragibwa era tewali kikyuka.
help-card-link-to-board-what-it-is-descr: Yunga ku lubaawo eteeka ekaadi eyungiddwa ey'ekaadi eno ku lubaawo olulala oluliwo. Ekaadi olwo n'eragibwa ku mbaawo zombi: eyasooka esigala w'eri, era link eraga ebirimu byayo w'ogiteeka.
help-card-link-to-board-how-it-works-des: Londa olubaawo, akakubo n'olukalala, oluvannyuma ekaadi n'oba link egenda waggulu oba wansi waayo, onyige Kimaliriziddwa. Mu lukalala olukalu link egenda wansi. Ekaadi eyasooka tekyusibwa, era obubonero tebukoppebwa. Ekifo ekigendebwamu kijjukirwa ku buli lubaawo.
help-card-actions-what-it-is-description: Menu y'ekaadi ey'ennyiriri essatu, Ebikolwa by'Ekaadi, ekuŋŋaanya buli kye wasobola okukola n'ekaadi yonna, so si n'ekimu ku bifo byayo. Ebiwandiiko ki ebirabika bisinziira ku mulimu gwo ku lubaawo.
help-card-actions-how-it-works-descripti: Sengula era okoppe erina Sengula Ekaadi, Koppa Ekaadi, Tereka ng'Ekyokulabirako, Koppa Ekyokulabirako ku Makaadi Amangi, Okuddiŋŋana kw'ekaadi n'okusengula okudda waggulu oba wansi w'olukalala. Oluvannyuma waddako Kuuma n'Emmunyeenye, n'Endabika ne Teekawo langi, Okukuba ebifaananyi ne Kola amakaadi okuva mu bikolwa. Gabana erina link y'ekaadi, Yunga ku lubaawo, koodi ya QR n'Ebyafaayo, oluvannyuma Fulumya ne Yingiza. Tterekero lirina Twala ekaadi mu tterekero, Ebisingawo ne Kola olubaawo okuva ku kaadi eno.
help-admin-version-what-it-is-descriptio: Ekitundu kya Enkyusa kiraga WeKan eno ky'eddukanya: enkyusa ya WeKan n'engeri gye yateekebwamu, enkola ya kompyuta, Meteor, database ne Node.js. Kye kitundu ekisooka mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Entegeka era kye kiwandiiko eky'okukoppa mu lipoota y'ensobi ng'osaba obuyambi.
help-admin-version-how-it-works-descript: Soma tabbulu, egattiddwa mu Platform, OS, Meteor, Database ne Node. Nyiga Kebera Enkyusa okugeraageranya n'enkyusa ezisembayo okufulumizibwa eza WeKan, FerretDB, Meteor, Node ne NPM; nga kikola kigamba nti kitikka, era okukebera bwe kugwa olaba obubaka obumu obw'okugwa mu kifo ky'ekyo.
help-admin-appearance-what-it-is-descrip: Endabika esalawo WeKan eno bw'efaanana n'Embaawo zonna kye ziraga: ebitundu ebikwekeddwa nga embaawo eza bonna oba ebikolwa by'olubaawo, ani ayinza okukola embaawo, engeri y'ennaku, ebikwata ku kaadi bwe biggulukira obugazi, endagiriro za links, okuyunga okw'otoma okw'ekigoberera ensonga eky'ebweru, erinnya ly'ekintu, langi ne logo.
help-admin-appearance-how-it-works-descr: Kyusa ebifo by'ekibinja kimu era onyige Tereka ey'ekibinja ekyo, etereka ekibinja ekyo kyokka. Okukebera wansi w'Embaawo zonna: Kweka kutegeeza nti ekintu kikwekeddwa, okuggyako embaawo buli mukozesa ayingidde z'asobola okukyusa, ekikeberwa nga kikkirizibwa. Kyusa langi etereka nga tewali ppeesa lya Tereka era kye kibinja kyokka omuddukanya w'ekibiina kyennyini ky'alaba.
help-admin-features-what-it-is-descripti: Ebikozesebwa we wali omuddukanya w'omukutu w'akoleeza oba w'azikiza ebitundu bya WeKan eby'okwesalirawo ku mukutu gwonna: endaba z'olubaawo, abayambi, ebikozesebwa bya Kanban ne Scrum, ebifo by'ekaadi, Workload ne capacity, Bajeti n'okusasuza, SQRL, ActivityPub, Amateeka ag'okusoma obusomi n'ebikozesebwa bya API ebikwatagana eby'okwesalirawo. Obukubo n'enkalala bibeerawo bulijjo.
help-admin-features-how-it-works-descrip: Ggyako okukebera WeKan eno ky'etasaana kuwa, nga mw'otwalidde ebifo by'ekaadi olubaawo lwonna bye lutasaana kulaga, onyige Tereka. Ekikozesebwa ekitakebereddwa kibula mu ndabika ya buli muntu era seva nayo ekigaana, naye data yaakyo ekuumibwa. Osobola okwetaagisa okukakasa ku bikozesebwa enkyusa ya WeKan by'eyongerako, n'okutuuma abakozesa abagezesa abakyalaba ebikozesebwa ebizikiziddwa.
help-admin-feature-profiles-what-it-is-d: Profile y'ebikozesebwa ewa abakozesa, ttiimu oba ebibiina ebirondeddwa WeKan entono ng'ekweka ebikozesebwa ebimu eby'okwesalirawo, ate buli muntu omulala ne yeeyongera okulaba byonna. Esobola okukweka ebikozesebwa bye bimu ekitundu ky'Ebikozesebwa bye kisobola okuzikiza.
help-admin-feature-profiles-how-it-works: Nyiga Yongerako profile, giwe erinnya, kebera ebikozesebwa by'ekweka era olage abakozesa baayo, ttiimu n'ebibiina, oluvannyuma onyige Tereka ey'ekitundu. Amannya agatakwatagana na muntu yenna gategeezebwa oluvannyuma lw'okutereka era tegaterekebwa. Profiles zigezesebwa mu nsengeka y'olupapula, era menu y'omukozesa emubuulira profile ki ekweka ebikozesebwa bimeka.
help-admin-security-what-it-is-descripti: Obukuumi bukwata ebikoleeza by'omukutu gwonna ebisalawo ebiwandiiko ebitegekeddwa kye bisobola okukola n'ekiyinza okuyingizibwa oba okufulumizibwa. Bikozese okuyimiriza links ezinyigibwa, okulaga ebiwandiiko byonna ebitegekeddwa nga ensibuko enyangu, okuziyiza okuyingiza oba okufulumya, okussa ekkomo ku bunene bw'okuyingiza, okuleka ebifaananyi by'abantu, oba okukyusa endagamuntu entuufu ez'abakozesa n'amannya agatamanyiddwa.
help-admin-security-how-it-works-descrip: Kebera ekikoleeza era kiterekebwa amangu ago; obunene obusinga obw'okuyingiza buterekebwa bw'ova mu kifo, era omuwendo omukalu gutegeeza nti tewali kkomo. Buli kikoleeza kizikiziddwa mu bulijjo era kikakasibwa seva, kale okuyingiza oba okufulumya okuzikiziddwa kugaanibwa ne bwe wabaawo akuyita butereevu.
help-admin-activities-what-it-is-descrip: Ebikoleeza bisatu eby'omukutu gwonna ku mikutu egirina okussa ekkomo ku kugoberera ebikolwa: okuyimiriza okuwandiika ani yakola ki, okuyimiriza okuweereza obubaka ku bikolwa, oba okuyimiriza abakozesa okukuuma embaawo, enkalala n'amakaadi.
help-admin-activities-how-it-works-descr: Kebera ekikoleeza era kiterekebwa amangu ago. Ebikolwa bwe bizikizibwa, tewali kipya kiwandiikibwa era ebiwandiiko ebiriwo tebikyalagibwa. Obubaka bwe buzikizibwa, tewali bubaka bwa mu app, bwa imeyilo oba obulala buweerezebwa. Okukuuma bwe kuzikizibwa, tewali asobola kukyusa ddaala lya kukuuma. Ggyako okukebera okukikoleeza nate; ebikolwa ebitaawandiikibwa mu kiseera ekyo tebikomawo.
help-admin-delete-what-it-is-description: Okusazaamu mu WeKan mu bulijjo kubonera bulazi enkalala, amakaadi n'ebiyungiddwako nti bisaziddwamu bisobole okuzzibwawo. Ekitundu kino kikwata ekikoleeza ekimu ekikkiriza omuddukanya w'omukutu okuzikiriza ebirimu ng'ebyo emirembe gyonna.
help-admin-delete-how-it-works-descripti: Kebera Koleeza okusazaamu okw'olubeerera ku Muddukanya Omukulu; kiterekebwa amangu ago era tekisazaamu kintu kyokka. Obubonero bw'okusazaamu olwo ne bulabika we kuweebwa okusazaamu okw'olubeerera, nga olukalala mu kisero oba olubaawo oluli mu tterekero mu tterekero ly'Embaawo zonna. Buli nkyukakyuka mu ntegeka n'okugezaako okusazaamu okw'olubeerera biwandiikibwa mu Recovery. Ggyako okukebera bw'omala.
help-admin-announcement-what-it-is-descr: Ekirango eky'omukutu gwonna eky'okubuulira buli mukozesa ayingidde ekintu omulundi gumu, nga okuwummula okw'okuddaabiriza, endagiriro empya oba enkyukakyuka mu nkola. Kyawukana ku kirango ky'olubaawo lwennyini.
help-admin-announcement-how-it-works-des: Kebera Ekirango ky'Omukutu Gwonna Ekikola, wandiika obubaka onyige Tereka. Ekirango kirabika waggulu wa Awaka, Embaawo zonna n'embaawo abakozesa ze bali bamemba. Omukozesa asobola okukiggalawo, era kisigala nga kiggaddwa ku ye okutuusa lw'okyusa ebiwandiiko. Ggyako okukebera akasanduuko okukiggyawo ku buli muntu.
help-admin-accessibility-what-it-is-desc: Olupapula lw'okutuukirirwa we wali WeKan eno w'ebuulira abakozesa baayo bw'etuukirirwa n'ani gw'okutuukirira ku kiziyiza. Ekitundu kino kikoleeza olupapula olwo era kiteekawo omutwe gwalwo n'ebirimu.
help-admin-accessibility-how-it-works-de: Kebera Olupapula lw'okutuukirirwa lukoleezeddwa, ekiterekebwa amangu ago, oluvannyuma owandiike omutwe n'ebirimu onyige Tereka. Ebirimu bitegekebwa ng'ennyonyola y'ekaadi. Abamemba b'olubaawo olwo bazuula link ya Okutuukirirwa mu kitundu ky'oku ddyo eky'olubaawo. Ggyako okukebera okukweka link nate.
help-admin-translation-what-it-is-descri: Ebiwandiiko by'okuvvuunula eby'obwannannyini bisinga ebiwandiiko bya WeKan ebizimbiddwamu ku mukutu guno, ku buli lulimi, okugeza okukozesa ekigambo ky'ekibiina kyo ku lubaawo oba okulongoosa ekiwandiiko ng'okuvvuunula okutuufu tekunnatuuka.
help-admin-translation-how-it-works-desc: Nyiga Kipya, londa olulimi, wandiika ekisumuluzo ky'ekiwandiiko eky'okukyusa (so si sentensi y'Olungereza) n'ekiwandiiko eky'okulaga mu kifo kyakyo, oluvannyuma Tereka. Ekiwandiiko ky'okuvvuunula kyokka eky'olunyiriri oluliwo kye kisobola okukyusibwa, era olunyiriri lusobola okusazibwamu okuva mu menu yaalwo. Okusinga kuno kukola ku biwandiiko seva by'ekola, nga imeyilo; mu browser kati birabika ku baddukanya b'omukutu bokka.
help-admin-pwa-what-it-is-description: Ekitundu kya PWA kifuga browsers n'amasimu kye bisoma ku WeKan yennyini: tags endala eza meta ne link mu buli lupapula, web manifest ekozesebwa WeKan bw'eteekebwa nga app, ne fayiro ya Android app links ekkiriza app ya Android okuggulawo links za WeKan.
help-admin-pwa-how-it-works-description: Kebera ekitundu ky'oyagala okukyusa, ekiterekebwa amangu ago, teekamu tags zo oba JSON onyige Tereka. JSON etali ntuufu egaanibwa era tewali kiterekebwa. Tags za meta zongerwako nga ebintu bya meta byokka, kale scripts, styles ne tags eziddamu okutikka olupapula biggibwamu. Ekikoleeza bwe kizikizibwa, WeKan ekozesa entegeka zaayo ez'olubereberye.
help-admin-global-webhooks-what-it-is-de: Webhooks ez'omukutu gwonna ziweereza obubaka ku ndagiriro endala, nga chat oba seva ya automation, buli lwe wabaawo ekintu ku lubaawo lwonna olwa WeKan eno. Zikozesa foomu y'emu ng'eya webhooks z'olubaawo lwennyini. Ekitundu era kiraga hosts ez'omunda webhooks ze ziyinza okutuukako ne webhook y'okuyingira n'okwewandiisa.
help-admin-global-webhooks-how-it-works-: Jjuza foomu enkalu n'erinnya, endagiriro, token ey'okwesalirawo n'ekika, ekya ludda lumu oba ebbiri, onyige Kola. Ku webhook eterekeddwa osobola okugizikiza, okulonda ebikolwa ki by'eweereza n'engeri gy'etuusamu, oluvannyuma Tereka. Laga hosts ku mukutu gwa WeKan gwennyini wansi wa Ebifo eby'omunda, emu ku buli lunyiriri, webhooks zisobole okukkirizibwa okuzituukako.
help-admin-shared-labels-what-it-is-desc: Obubonero obugabanibwa buwa akabonero erinnya limu ne langi emu ku mbaawo nnyingi omulundi gumu: ku buli lubaawo, ku mbaawo z'ekibiina, oba ku mbaawo za ttiimu. Bukozese ku bubonero nga Kya mangu oba Kasitoma obusaana okufaanana wonna.
help-admin-shared-labels-how-it-works-de: Yongerako akabonero mu lunyiriri olusembayo n'erinnya, langi ne katalogu, oluvannyuma onyige Yongerako akabonero akagabanibwa; buli lunyiriri lutereka oba lusazaamu ku lwalwo. Ku bubonero bw'ekaadi, abamemba b'olubaawo balaba obubonero obugabanibwa olubaawo lwabwe bwe luyinza okukozesa era banyiga kamu okukayongerako. Okukyusa erinnya oba langi wano kukikyusa ku buli lubaawo, era okukisazaamu kukireka ku mbaawo ezo ng'akabonero kaazo.
help-admin-email-what-it-is-description: Ekitundu kya Imeyilo kiteekawo WeKan bw'eweereza ebbaluwa, oba ng'eyita mu ntegeka za seva ez'ebbaluwa oba mu muwereza ateekeddwawo wano, era kikwata entegeka ezikwatagana: domain ya imeyilo ki eyinza okuyita abantu ng'okwewandiisa okw'obwannannyini kuzikiziddwa, oba abakozesa bayinza okukyusa endagiriro yaabwe, eky'okukola ku bbaluwa ezizzibwayo, n'ebyokulabirako bya imeyilo z'okuyita n'ez'ebikolwa.
help-admin-email-how-it-works-descriptio: Kebera Koleeza wansi w'entegeka za imeyilo, londa SMTP oba omuwereza azimbiddwamu, jjuza erinnya ly'omukozesa, ekigambo ekyekusifu n'endagiriro y'aweereza onyige Tereka; ekigambo ekyekusifu ekiterekeddwa kikuumibwa ng'ekifo kirekeddwa nga kikalu. Weereza imeyilo ey'okugezesa eri ggwe okukebera oba ekola. Awatali kukebera, entegeka za seva ez'ebbaluwa zisigala nga zikozesebwa. Ebifo by'ebyokulabirako ebikalu bikuuma imeyilo ezizimbiddwamu.
help-admin-notifications-what-it-is-desc: Entegeka ya bulijjo ey'omukutu gwonna ey'obubaka: oba akasanduuko k'obubaka mu app ne imeyilo bikola oba bizikiziddwa ku buli muntu, n'engeri imeyilo, akasanduuko ne webhooks ezifuluma gye bituusa mu bulijjo. Entegeka z'olubaawo n'eza buli memba zisobola okugisinga mu kifo kyabwe.
help-admin-notifications-how-it-works-de: Londa Yee oba Nedda ku Kasanduuko k'obubaka ne ku Imeyilo; okulonda kuterekebwa amangu ago. Ggulawo omukutu okuteekawo endabika yaagwo, kye gulaga, obubaka bwe bugattibwa ne lwe buweerezebwa, buli kimu nga kiterekebwa amangu ago. Abaddukanya b'olubaawo n'abamemba basobola okulonda Bulijjo okudda ku ky'oteekawo wano. Entegeka za imeyilo okudda ku kaadi ziri mu kitundu kye kimu.
help-admin-domains-what-it-is-descriptio: Domains eraga buli domain ya imeyilo ekozesebwa akawunti ku WeKan eno, n'abakozesa bameka buli emu b'erina. Ngeri ya mangu ey'okulaba ebibiina ki ebiri ku mukutu n'okulaba domain etasuubirwa nga tosomye lukalala lwonna olw'abakozesa.
help-admin-domains-how-it-works-descript: Soma tabbulu, olunyiriri lumu ku buli domain n'omuwendo gw'abakozesa baayo. Wandiika ekitundu kya domain mu kasanduuko k'okunoonya onyige Enter okugizuula, era tambula wakati w'empapula n'amappeesa ekyasooka n'ekiddako. Tewali kiterekebwa; tabbulu ebalibwa buggya buli lw'eragibwa.
help-admin-organizations-what-it-is-desc: Ebibiina bigatta abakozesa okusinziira ku kampuni, ekitongole oba kasitoma, embaawo n'embaawo z'ebyokulabirako zisobole okugabanibwa ne bonna, abamemba baabyo basobole okukuumibwa nga bakwatagana ne directory nga LDAP, era, ne multitenancy, ekibiina kisobola okuba ne domains zaakyo, endabika yaakyo n'abaddukanya baakyo.
help-admin-organizations-how-it-works-de: Nyiga Kipya ku mutwe gw'empagi esooka okukola kimu, Kyusa okukyusa olunyiriri, ne menu y'olunyiriri okukisazaamu oba okulonda abaddukanya b'ekibiina. Ebikoleeza by'olunyiriri eby'ebyokulabirako ebigabanibwa, okwongerako abamemba ku mbaawo n'okukwataganya abamemba okuva ku muwereza w'okuyingira bitereka amangu ago. Kebera Yongerako abamemba b'olubaawo okuva mu Kibiina kye kimu bokka okussa ekkomo ku bayinza okwongerwako ku mbaawo.
help-admin-teams-what-it-is-description: Ttiimu zigatta abakozesa abakolera awamu olubaawo oba embaawo z'ebyokulabirako zisobole okugabanibwa ne ttiimu yonna, abamemba basobole okukuumibwa nga bakwatagana ne directory nga LDAP, era olukalala lw'Abantu lusobole okukendeezebwa ku ttiimu emu. Zikola ng'ebibiina naye nga tezirina kitundu kya tenant.
help-admin-teams-how-it-works-descriptio: Nyiga Kipya ku mutwe gw'empagi esooka okukola ttiimu, Kyusa okugikyusa, oba menu y'olunyiriri okugisazaamu. Ebikoleeza by'olunyiriri bitereka amangu ago. Okuteeka abantu mu ttiimu, bakebere mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Abantu / Abantu onyige Ttiimu. Kebera Yongerako abamemba b'olubaawo okuva mu Ttiimu emu bokka okussa ekkomo ku bayinza okwongerwako ku mbaawo.
help-admin-people-what-it-is-description: Abantu eraga buli akawunti ku WeKan eno ne imeyilo yaayo, embeera y'obuddukanya, profile y'ebikozesebwa, embeera y'okukola, ensi z'okuyingiramu, embeera y'okusibibwa, ekikolwa ekisembayo n'olunaku lw'okukolebwa. We wali w'okola, w'okyusa, w'ozikiza, w'osumulula, w'ofuuka omuntu omulala, w'okweka erinnya era w'osazaamu akawunti.
help-admin-people-how-it-works-descripti: Noonya okusinziira ku linnya ly'omukozesa, erinnya oba imeyilo onyige Enter, era okendeeze ne Laga ne Ttiimu. Nyiga Kipya okukola omukozesa ne Kyusa okukyusa omu. Nyiga akabonero k'okukola okuzikiza oba okukoleeza, n'ekkufulu emmyufu oba Sumulula Byonna okusumulula. Menu y'olunyiriri erina okufuuka omuntu omulala, okukweka erinnya n'okusazaamu; kebera abantu abawera onyige Ttiimu okukyusa ttiimu zaabwe.
help-admin-locked-users-what-it-is-descr: Obukuumi ku kugezaako okw'amaanyi busiba akawunti oluvannyuma lw'okugezaako okuyingira okulemereddwa emirundi emingi ennyo. Ekitundu kino kiteekawo okulemererwa kumeka okuleeta okusibibwa, okusibibwa kumala bbanga ki n'ekiseera mw'okulemererwa kubalirwa, okwawukana ku mannya g'abakozesa agaliwo ne ku mannya agataliiwo.
help-admin-locked-users-how-it-works-des: Jjuza okulemererwa, ebbanga ly'okusibibwa n'ekiseera, mu sekonda, ku bakozesa abamanyiddwa n'abatamanyiddwa onyige Tereka; emiwendo emipya gikola amangu ago nga tewali kuddamu kutandika. Okulaba n'okusumulula akawunti ezisibiddwa, ggulawo Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Abantu / Abantu, londa Abakozesa Abasibiddwa Bokka onyige ekkufulu emmyufu, oba Sumulula Byonna.
help-admin-audit-log-what-it-is-descript: Ekitabo ky'okwekebejja lwe lukoba lw'abaddukanya b'omukutu kye baakola, ebisinga obuggya nga bye bisooka: ddi, ani, kikolwa ki, oba kyatuuka ku buwanguzi, ebikwata ku kyo n'endagiriro gye kyava. Kiddamu ani yakyusa ekintu era ddi ku ntegeka z'abantu, okuyingira, okutereka ne kopi-ey'obukuumi.
help-admin-audit-log-how-it-works-descri: Soma tabbulu ya Ddi, Omuddukanya, Ekikolwa, Ebikwata ku kyo ne IP; ekikolwa ekyagaanibwa kibonerwa n'ensobi yaakyo. Wandiika mu kasanduuko k'okunoonya okukendeeza ku nnyiriri okusinziira ku muddukanya, ekikolwa oba ebikwata ku kyo, era kozesa obusaale wansi wa tabbulu okutambula wakati w'empapula.
help-admin-roles-what-it-is-description: Emirimu gisalawo emirimu gy'olubaawo ki egiyinza okuyita abantu ku lubaawo, gikukkiriza okuzimba emirimu egy'obwannannyini okuva ku memba w'olubaawo by'ayinza okukola, era giraga buli mulimu by'eyinza okukola. Abaddukanya b'omukutu balina buli ddembe bulijjo.
help-admin-roles-how-it-works-descriptio: Wansi wa Kkiriza Okuyita ku Lubaawo, kebera emirimu egiyinza okuyita onyige Tereka. Wansi w'Emirimu egy'obwannannyini, wandiika erinnya, kebera omulimu by'eyinza okukola onyige Yongerako omulimu; buli lunyiriri lutereka oba lusazaamu ku lwalwo, era abaddukanya b'olubaawo olwo basobola okuwa abamemba omulimu ogwo. Tabbulu y'Embeera y'Emirimu eraga ekiva mu kukebera kwo, ne bw'oba tonnaba kutereka.
help-admin-shared-templates-what-it-is-d: Ebyokulabirako ebigabanibwa bikukkiriza okutunuulira embaawo z'ebyokulabirako ez'abakozesa ezisobola okugabanibwa okusinziira ku kibiina, ttiimu oba domain ya imeyilo. Okukebera era kusalawo ebika by'ebibinja ki olubaawo lw'ekyokulabirako lwe luyinza okugabanibwa nabyo okuva mu Mbaawo zonna / Ebyokulabirako.
help-admin-shared-templates-how-it-works: Kebera Ebibiina, Ttiimu oba Domains; buli kukebera kuterekebwa amangu ago ku mukutu gwonna. Wansi wa buli kitundu ekikebereddwa olaba buli kibinja, abakozesa baakyo n'embaawo zaabwe ez'ebyokulabirako, era okunyiga olubaawo lw'ekyokulabirako kuluggulawo. Oba ebyokulabirako by'ekibinja kimu bituuka ku bamemba baakyo biteekebwawo ku buli kibiina ne ttiimu mu bitundu byabyo.
help-admin-login-what-it-is-description: Okuyingira kusalawo ekikkirizibwa ng'oyingira, nga okwerabira ekigambo ekyekusifu, okwewandiisa okw'obwannannyini, okukyusa erinnya ly'omukozesa, okusazaamu akawunti yo n'okulonda enkola. Era kukukkiriza okusinga entegeka za seva ez'okuyingira nga tewali kuddamu kutandika, okugeza okuyingira n'ekigambo ekyekusifu, enkola eya bulijjo, obuwanvu bw'ekiseera, okufuluma okw'otoma, amateeka g'ebigambo ebyekusifu n'okukakasa okw'emitendera ebiri okw'obuwaze.
help-admin-login-how-it-works-descriptio: Kebera oba ggyako okukebera obusanduuko bwa Okuyingira: Kkiriza; buli kamu katereka ng'onyize. Okwewandiisa okw'obwannannyini bwe kuzikizibwa, kozesa Yita Abantu okuyita endagiriro ku mbaawo endondeddwa. Mu foomu y'entegeka buli kifo kigamba omuwendo ki ogukola; wandiika oba londa omuwendo otereke, oba kirekere awo nga kikalu oba londa Bulijjo okudda ku ntegeka za seva. Buli nkola y'okuyingira erina ekitundu kyayo mu menu y'Abantu.
help-admin-saml-what-it-is-description: Okuyingira kwa SAML kukkiriza abantu okuyingira nga bayita mu muwereza w'endagamuntu ow'ekibiina kyo mu kifo ky'ekigambo ekyekusifu ekya WeKan. Omuwereza akakasa bwe bali n'obubaka obuteereddwako omukono era WeKan n'ebayingiza, ng'ekola akawunti ku kuyingira okusooka.
help-admin-saml-how-it-works-description: Wandiika endagiriro y'okuyingira ey'omuwereza w'endagamuntu ne satifikeeti y'okuteekako omukono, erinnya ly'awaayo erya WeKan eno n'engeri endala mu kitundu kino, oba mu ntegeka za seva; omuwendo oguterekeddwa wano gusinga ogwa seva. Bwe kumala okukoleezebwa, olupapula lw'okuyingira luraga eppeesa lya Yingira ne SAML eritwala omukozesa eri omuwereza w'endagamuntu n'okudda.
help-admin-ldap-what-it-is-description: Okuyingira kwa LDAP kukkiriza abantu okuyingira n'erinnya ly'omukozesa n'ekigambo ekyekusifu bye balina dda mu directory yo, nga Active Directory oba OpenLDAP. WeKan ekebera ekigambo ekyekusifu ku directory, ekola akawunti ku kuyingira okusooka era esobola okukuuma amannya, imeyilo, embeera y'obuddukanya, ebibiina ne ttiimu nga bikwatagana ne directory.
help-admin-ldap-how-it-works-description: Jjuza endagiriro ya directory, port, okusiba, base n'engeri abakozesa gye banoonyezebwamu, oluvannyuma otereke; omuwendo oguterekeddwa gusinga entegeka za seva era Bulijjo ezzaawo omuwendo gwa seva. Nyiga Gezesa Okukwatagana kwa LDAP okugezesa entegeka ezikola, ne Kwataganya abakozesa ba LDAP kati okuddukanya okukwataganya okw'emabega amangu ago. Londa LDAP ng'enkola eya bulijjo mu kitundu ky'Okuyingira.
help-admin-oauth2-what-it-is-description: Okuyingira kwa OAuth2 ne OpenID Connect kukkiriza abantu okuyingira ne akawunti ku mpeereza endala, nga Keycloak, Authelia oba GitLab, mu kifo ky'ekigambo ekyekusifu ekya WeKan. Okwawukana ku bawereza b'okuyingira ab'emikutu egy'empuliziganya abagere, okusonga ku muwereza yenna ng'owa endagiriro ze.
help-admin-oauth2-how-it-works-descripti: Wandiisa WeKan nga app ku muwereza, oluvannyuma owandiike client id yaayo, ekyama, endagiriro ya seva, endpoints n'engeri ebifo by'omukozesa bwe bikwatagana ne WeKan wano; omuwendo oguterekeddwa wano gusinga entegeka za seva era gukola ku kuyingira okuddako nga tewali kuddamu kutandika. Olupapula lw'okuyingira olwo luraga eppeesa ly'okuyingira ebiwandiiko byalyo nga biteekeddwawo mu kitundu ky'Okuyingira.
help-admin-cas-what-it-is-description: CAS ye nkola y'okuyingira omulundi gumu: abantu bayingira omulundi gumu ku seva ya CAS ey'ekibiina kyo, era WeKan yeesiga tikiti gy'ezzaayo, kale WeKan terabira ddala kigambo kyekusifu.
help-admin-cas-how-it-works-description: Wandiika endagiriro za base, okuyingira n'okukakasa eza seva ya CAS wano era ogikoleeze; omuwendo oguterekeddwa wano gusinga entegeka za seva. Londa CAS ng'enkola eya bulijjo mu kitundu ky'Okuyingira, oba leka abakozesa bagironde mu kulonda enkola. Okuyingira kutwala browser ku lupapula lw'okuyingira olwa CAS n'okudda ku WeKan, ng'oyingidde.
help-admin-header-login-what-it-is-descr: Okuyingira okw'omutwe kukkiriza reverse proxy eyesigika eyamaze okukola okuyingira omulundi gumu okubuulira WeKan omukozesa bw'ali, omukozesa n'ayingira nga tewali kigambo kyekusifu era akawunti n'ekolebwa ku kujja okusooka.
help-admin-header-login-how-it-works-des: Entegeka zino ziragibwa wano nga za kusoma bwokka era tezisobola kuterekebwa okuva mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya, kubanga proxy eyesigika esobola okuyingira nga buli muntu; ziteekebwawo mu ntegeka za seva n'okuddamu okutandika. Proxy erina okukakasa omukozesa, okuweereza emitwe gy'endagamuntu n'okuggyawo emitwe gyonna egy'engeri eyo egiweerezeddwa ba client, era endagiriro za proxy ezirambikiddwa zokka ze zeesigibwa.
help-admin-oauth-providers-what-it-is-de: Gano ge mappeesa g'okuyingira ag'emikutu egy'empuliziganya agamaze okukolebwa: Google, GitHub, Facebook, Twitter, Meteor Developer, Weibo ne Meetup. Buli limu lyetaaga app id n'ekyama omuwereza by'akuwa byokka, era gasobola okukozesebwa wamu n'okuyingira kwa OAuth2 okwa bulijjo.
help-admin-oauth-providers-how-it-works-: Kola app ku mukutu gw'abazimbi ogw'omuwereza n'endagiriro ya callback eya WeKan, oluvannyuma owandiike id yaayo n'ekyama wano era okoleeze omuwereza; omuwendo oguterekeddwa wano gusinga entegeka za seva. Eppeesa lya Yingira ne ery'omuwereza oyo olwo ne lirabika ku lupapula lw'okuyingira.
help-admin-passwordless-what-it-is-descr: Okuyingira awatali kigambo kyekusifu kukkiriza omukozesa okuyingira ne koodi ey'omulundi gumu WeKan gy'emuweereza ku imeyilo, mu kifo ky'ekigambo ekyekusifu. Kya bwangu eri abantu abeerabira ebigambo ebyekusifu, so si mutendera ogw'okubiri, era kiri mu bukuumi nga ekisanduuko kya imeyilo ky'omukozesa bwe kiri.
help-admin-passwordless-how-it-works-des: Kakasa nti imeyilo efuluma ekola, oluvannyuma okikoleeze wano; omuwendo oguterekeddwa wano gusinga entegeka za seva. Olupapula lw'okuyingira olwo luwa okuweereza koodi y'okuyingira ku imeyilo: omukozesa awandiika endagiriro ye, afuna koodi ekola okumala akaseera akatono, agiwandiika era ayingira.
help-admin-backup-what-it-is-description: Kopi-ey'obukuumi ekwata archive ya WeKan eno kati oba okusinziira ku nteekateeka, n'ebiwandiiko bya data, ebiyungiddwako n'ebifaananyi by'abantu ng'okulonda okwawukana, era egizzaawo. Omuddukanya w'omukutu akola kopi y'omukutu gwonna oba ekibiina kimu; omuddukanya w'ekibiina kyennyini akola kopi y'embaawo zaakyo zokka. Kopi-ey'obukuumi ey'olubeerera mu kifo ky'ekyo eweereza buli nkyukakyuka osobole okuzzaawo okutuuka ku kaseera konna.
help-admin-backup-how-it-works-descripti: Londa ekitundu, kebera eby'okuteekamu onyige Kola kopi kati; kopi enzijuvu yeetaaga byonna bisatu n'omukutu gwonna. Teekawo enteekateeka ya buli lunaku, buli wiiki oba buli mwezi era Tereka. Nyiga Laga kopi era ozzeewo emu, ng'oyongerako data ebula yokka oba ng'okyusa byonna. Mu Kopi-ey'obukuumi ey'olubeerera, teekawo fayiro egendebwamu, ebirimu n'okukuuma, oluvannyuma olonde akaseera k'okuzzaawo.
help-admin-attachments-what-it-is-descri: Ebitundu by'Ebiyungiddwako bisalawo ebiyungiddwako by'amakaadi n'ebifaananyi by'abantu we biterekebwa, bunene ki bwe biyinza okuba, bbanga ki lye bikuumibwa n'engeri gye bisengukamu wakati w'ebitereka. Fayiro zisobola okukuumibwa ku disiki ya seva, mu database oba mu kitereka kya cloud nga S3, MinIO, Azure, Google Cloud Storage oba WebDAV.
help-admin-attachments-how-it-works-desc: Londa ekitundu okuva mu menu ey'oku kkono. Teekawo ekitereka fayiro empya mwe zigenda, teekateeka buli kitereka n'ebikoleeza byakyo eby'okusoma n'okuwandiika, era osengule ebiyungiddwako oba ebifaananyi by'abantu okuva mu kitereka ekimu okudda mu kirala. Amakomo gateekawo obunene bw'okuteekako n'okuwanula, Okukuuma kusazaamu ebiyungiddwako ebikadde oluvannyuma lw'ennaku ezimu, ate Okusengula database kusengula ebiwandiiko bya data wakati wa MongoDB ne FerretDB.
help-admin-problems-summary-what-it-is-d: Olupapula olusooka olwa Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Bizibu era okukebera kwo okwa buli lunaku okwa seva yonna. Lukubuulira ekikola kati, ekikyamu kati, n'ebizibu ebipya bimeka buli lipoota by'ekuŋŋaanyizza, n'amappeesa g'okubitereeza oba okubikkiriza.
help-admin-problems-summary-how-it-works: Embeera eraga okusengula n'okuddaabiriza ebiri mu kukolebwa, ebiyinza okuddiriza okuyingira, nga biddirirwa buli kizibu n'omuwendo n'eky'okukola, n'eppeesa lya Ddaabiriza amakaadi agamenyese, Zzaawo oba Ddaabiriza we likola. Okuddaabiriza okusazaamu data kukusaba okusooka okunyiga Kakasa. Wansi w'Obulamu bwa data, Tandika eddukanya okwekebejja okw'emabega. Wansi wa Bizibu, kebera lipoota z'otunuulidde onyige Kkiriza okuzzaawo omuwendo gwazo omupya, oba Sangula okusazaamu ennyiriri zazo.
help-admin-problems-security-what-it-is-: Buli kugezaako omukuumi w'obukuumi kwe yagaana oba kwe yalaba: kye kyali, kya bulabe bwenkana wa, ani yakigezaako, okuva wa era emirundi emeka. Kiraga nti waliwo eyagezaako, so si nti ekituli kiggaddwa kyokka. Ebikoleeza by'obukuumi byennyini biri mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Entegeka / Obukuumi.
help-admin-problems-security-how-it-work: Ennyiriri ziragibwa ezisinga obuggya nga ze zisooka, era okugezaako okuddiŋŋana lunyiriri lumu omuwendo gwalwo ogw'Okugezaako ne gukula, ate Ebikwata ku kyo bigamba omukuumi kye yalaba. Wandiika erinnya, ekika, ensibuko, erinnya ly'omukozesa oba endagiriro mu kasanduuko k'okunoonya okusengejja ng'owandiika, era onyige erinnya ly'omukozesa okuggulawo akawunti eyo. Kkiriza oba sangula lipoota ku Bizibu / Omugatte.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-what-i: Olukoba lw'okwekebejja olw'abaddukanya abakola nga abakozesa abalala. Okufuuka omuntu omulala kukkiriza omuddukanya okulaba WeKan nga omukozesa omu bw'agiraba, okugeza okufulumya olubaawo olwa kyama, era lipoota eno ekuuma obuyinza obwo nga bulabika oluvannyuma.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-how-it: Olunyiriri luwandiikibwa omuddukanya bw'alonda Fuuka omukozesa mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Abantu, bw'akola token y'okuyingira ey'omukozesa omulala ng'ayita mu REST API, oba bw'afulumya olubaawo, ekaadi oba ekiyungiddwako ng'afuuse omulala. Buli lunyiriri luraga olunaku, omuddukanya, omukozesa eyafuulibwa, olubaawo n'ensonga, ebisinga obuggya nga bye bisooka. Nyiga erinnya okuggulawo omukozesa oyo, era onoonye ne Enter. Tewali kiri wano ekikyusa oba ekisazaamu lunyiriri.
help-admin-problems-password-length-what: Kiraga ani ayingira n'ekigambo ekyekusifu ekimpi okusinga obuwanvu obutono, okuva wa, era oba yakikyusizza okuva olwo. Osobola okulaba ani yandikwatiddwako nga tonnaba kuwaliriza buwanvu butono ku bigambo ebyekusifu ebipya.
help-admin-problems-password-length-how-: Teekawo Obuwanvu obutono obw'ekigambo ekyekusifu, kebera Wagaliriza obuwanvu obutono okugaana ebigambo ebyekusifu ebipya ebimpi, onyige Tereka. Okuyingira tekugaanibwa n'akatono, naye okuwaliriza bwe kukola, akawunti erina ekigambo ekyekusifu ekikadde ekimpi esabibwa okusooka kukikyusa. Tabbulu erina olunyiriri lumu ku buli akawunti n'okuyingira okusooka n'okusembayo, endagiriro, omuwendo gw'okuyingira ne lwe kyatereezebwa. Sengejja okusinziira ku Kigambo ekyekusifu ekimpi ennyo, Kyatereezebwa okudda ku kigambo ekiwanvu ekimala oba Byonna. Akawunti eziyingira nga ziyita mu LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS oba Sandstorm tezilagibwa.
help-admin-problems-performance-what-it-: Kinnyonnyola WeKan bw'etikka amakaadi g'olubaawo, ekisalawo olubaawo olunene bwe lusaasaanya okuluggulawo. Kye kinnyonnyola kyokka, nga tewali kya kunyiga oba kya kutereka.
help-admin-problems-performance-how-it-w: Okutikka amakaadi kwa otoma ku buli lubaawo: olubaawo olulina amakaadi agasukka 500 lutikka amakaadi gokka agalabika mu buli lukalala ng'oseeseetula, n'emiwendo okuva ku seva, ate olubaawo olutono lutikka buli kaadi. Addukanya seva asobola okuwaliriza okutikka kwonna oba okw'obugayaavu, oba okukyusa omuwendo gw'amakaadi, mu ntegeka za seva n'oluvannyuma n'addamu okutandika. Endaba y'Ebibalo ey'olubaawo eraga enkola gy'ekozesa.
help-admin-problems-speed-what-it-is-des: Kiraga okusaba kw'empapula z'omukutu ne REST API okwatwala ebbanga ddene okuddibwamu, olabe empapula ki oba okuyita ki okugenda empola era emirundi emeka.
help-admin-problems-speed-how-it-works-d: Buli kusaba okuggyako fayiro ezitakyukakyuka kubalirwa ebiseera, era okutwala sekonda bbiri oba okusingawo mu bulijjo kuwandiikibwa. Okusaba kwe kumu okugenda empola kukuumibwa ng'olunyiriri lumu omuwendo gwalwo n'olunaku ne byeyongera, era Ebikwata ku kyo biraga enkola, ekkubo n'ebbanga lye kwatwala. Okunoonya kusengejja ng'owandiika, era Bizibu / Omugatte kukkiriza oba kusangula. Ekkomo, oba okulizikiza, liteekebwawo mu ntegeka za seva. Ebiseera ebiramu eby'okuyita kw'enkola n'okufulumya biri wansi wa Instrumentation.
help-admin-problems-tests-what-it-is-des: Okwekebera okwa seva ekola okwalemererwa. Amangu ddala oluvannyuma lw'okutandika, WeKan ekebera nti database eddamu, nti etterekero lya fayiro lisobola okuwandiikibwamu, nti memory heap ekyalimu ebbanga era nti disiki erina ekifo ekyereere.
help-admin-problems-tests-how-it-works-d: Okukebera kuddukanyizibwa omulundi gumu, nga sekonda 15 oluvannyuma lwa seva okutandika, era okulemererwa kwokka kwe kukola olunyiriri: Ensibuko etuuma okukebera ate Ebikwata ku kyo biwa obubaka bwakwo obw'ensobi. Tewali bizibu bipya kitegeeza nti tewali kyalemererwa okuva lipoota lwe yasembayo okusangulwa. Ekitundu tekirina ppeesa lya kubiddukanya nate, kale ddamu otandike WeKan. Kkiriza oba sangula ku Bizibu / Omugatte.
help-admin-problems-cpu-what-it-is-descr: Kitunuulira omugugu gwa processor ogw'ekyuma kyonna, kubanga WeKan ne database yaayo ku kompyuta emu bisobola okukozesa CPU emala okuddiriza pulogulaamu endala. Ebiseera bya CPU eya waggulu ebigenda mu maaso biwandiikibwa wano, era emirimu emiwanvu gigenda mpola ng'ekyuma kiri mu mirimu.
help-admin-problems-cpu-how-it-works-des: Olunyiriri olwa waggulu luraga okukozesa kwa CPU okwa kati, omuwendo gwa cores, load average, ekisembayo okuba ekitono, eky'awakati n'ekisinga, ne WeKan ky'ekola, nga kizzibwa buggya buli sekonda 5. Tabbulu wansi eraga ebiseera eby'emirimu emingi ebyayita: olunyiriri lw'okutandika, waakiri olunyiriri lumu ku kuddiriza, n'olunyiriri lw'enkomerero n'ebbanga, entikko n'oba okuddiriza kwayamba. Okunoonya kusengejja ng'owandiika. Ebipimo, oba okuzikiza okutunuulira, biri mu ntegeka za seva.
help-admin-problems-ram-what-it-is-descr: Kitunuulira memory ne swap ekyuma kyonna bye kikozesa, era kiwandiika ekiseera ky'okukozesa memory ennyingi lwe kitandika ne lwe kiggwa. Okuggwaako memory, oba okukozesa swap, kuddiriza oba kumenya WeKan ne pulogulaamu endala ku kyuma kye kimu.
help-admin-problems-ram-how-it-works-des: Olunyiriri waggulu luraga okukozesa memory okwa kati nga ebitundu ku kikumi era nga gigabytes ezikozeseddwa n'omugatte, ne swap ng'ekyuma kirina, nga kizzibwa buggya buli sekonda 5. Wansi waakyo, tabbulu ekwata olunyiriri lumu olw'okutandika n'olumu olw'enkomerero ku buli kiseera kya memory ennyingi, ebisinga obuggya nga bye bisooka, ennyiriri 10 ku lupapula, n'akasanduuko k'okunoonya. Kkiriza oba sangula ku Bizibu / Omugatte. Amakomo gali mu ntegeka za seva era gasomebwa seva bw'etandika.
help-admin-problems-disk-what-it-is-desc: Kitunuulira ekifo ekyereere ku disiki ezikwata database, ebiyungiddwako n'ebiteekeddwako. Disiki ejjudde efuula okuteekako okulemererwa era eyimiriza database okuwandiika, kale kino kiwa okulabula amangu nga ekyo tekinnabaawo.
help-admin-problems-disk-how-it-works-de: Olunyiriri lumu oluramu ku buli disiki luraga ebitundu ku kikumi ebikozeseddwa, gigabytes ezeereere n'omugatte, ekifo kyayo ne WeKan ky'ekuumirayo, nga kizzibwa buggya buli sekonda 30, era disiki eri mu kiseera ekya waggulu eragibwa mu ngeri ey'enjawulo. Tabbulu wansi erina olunyiriri lw'okutandika n'olw'enkomerero ku buli kiseera ky'okukozesa okungi, era okunoonya kusengejja ng'owandiika. Kkiriza oba sangula ku Bizibu / Omugatte. Disiki endala ez'okutunuulira zisobola okwongerwako mu ntegeka za seva.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-what: Ebibalo ebiramu eby'ekyo seva eno eya WeKan ky'ekola: okukwatagana kumeka okuggule, era buli nkola n'okufulumya bwe biyitibwa emirundi emeka, bwe bigwa emirundi emeka n'ebbanga lye bitwala. Kiraga ekitundu kya WeKan ekiri mu mirimu oba ekigwa kati nga tewali kikozesebwa kya kutunuulira kyawukana.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-how-: Olunyiriri olwa waggulu luraga okukwatagana okukola, okwaggulwawo n'okwaggalwawo ne lwe kwatandika okubala. Emiggo ku buli kitundu, nga Amakaadi, Embaawo, Okuyingira oba Ebiyungiddwako, giraga okuyita, ebbanga ery'awakati n'ensobi; nyiga ekitundu okulaga ennyiriri zaakyo zokka, era nate okulaga zonna. Tabbulu eraga okuyita, okumaliriziddwa, ensobi, n'ebbanga ery'awakati n'erisinga. Ezzibwa buggya buli sekonda taano, ebala pulosesi ya seva eno yokka, era etandika nate okuva ku zeero ng'eddamu okutandika.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-what-it: Kiraga amakaadi olubaawo lwonna lwe lutasobola kulaga, kubanga olubaawo, akakubo oba olukalala bye gali mu byo bibulawo. Kibikka buli lubaawo ku seva, ne bw'oba oli memba oba nedda.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-how-it-: Buli lunyiriri luraga omutwe gw'ekaadi, id yaayo, emitwe gy'olubaawo, akakubo n'olukalala ebikyaliwo, ekika kyayo ne lwe yakolebwa; ekifo ekikalu kye kitundu ekibula. Wandiika ekitundu ky'omutwe onyige Enter okunoonya, era otambule mu mpapula n'amappeesa ekyasooka n'ekiddako. Ekitundu kiraga amakaadi bulazi: gaddaabirize ne Ddaabiriza amakaadi agamenyese ku Bizibu / Omugatte. Okuggulawo olubaawo nakwo kuddaabiriza amakaadi gaalwo.
help-admin-problems-files-what-it-is-des: Kiraga ebiyungiddwako ebiterekeddwa ku seva eno, n'amappeesa agakebera database ky'egamba ku buli kiyungiddwako n'ekifaananyi ky'omuntu ng'egeraageranya n'ebiri ddala mu kitereka. Okukebera kuzuula fayiro ezibula, ezitayogerwako oba ezituumiddwa obubi n'ebyafaayo ebiyinza okubinnyonnyola.
help-admin-problems-files-how-it-works-d: Tabbulu eraga ekifaananyi ekitono, erinnya lya fayiro, obunene, ekika n'ennamba za id ez'ekiyungiddwako, olubaawo n'ekaadi, n'akasanduuko k'okunoonya. Kebera fayiro n'ebyafaayo, Kebera ebika bya fayiro n'obuwanvu, oba Kebera fayiro ezibula n'ezitagobererwa etandika okukebera; Sazaamu okukebera kukuyimiriza. Oluvannyuma, soma emiwendo, obubikka n'ekyokulabirako ky'ebyazuuliddwa, oba kozesa Wanula omugatte gw'embeera. Okukebera tekukyusa, tekusengula era tekusazaamu fayiro yonna wadde ekiwandiiko.
help-admin-problems-rules-what-it-is-des: Kiraga buli tteeka lya automation ku seva n'olubaawo lwalyo, olabe mu kifo kimu WeKan ky'ekola yokka ku mbaawo zonna, okugeza ng'onoonya etteeka erisengula amakaadi mu ngeri etasuubirwa.
help-admin-problems-rules-how-it-works-d: Tabbulu eraga omutwe gw'etteeka, olubaawo lwalyo, ekika ky'ekikolwa kyalyo n'ekika ky'ekikolwa eky'ekisitula kyalyo, ennyiriri 10 ku lupapula, nga zisengekeddwa okusinziira ku lubaawo. Wandiika ekitundu ky'omutwe gw'etteeka onyige Enter okunoonya, era osangule akasanduuko onyige Enter okulaba byonna nate. Ekitundu kya kusoma bwokka: okukyusa etteeka, ggulawo olubaawo lwalyo era olikyuse mu mateeka g'olubaawo olwo.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-what-it-is-: Tabbulu ya buli webhook ku seva, webhooks za buli lubaawo n'ez'omukutu gwonna: buli emu ya lubaawo ki, ani yagyongerako era gy'eweereza. Eyamba nga tonnaba kuzikiza webhooks, oluvannyuma lw'akabenje, oba data bw'egenda ewalala nga tewali ajjukira kugiteekateeka.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-how-it-work: Olunyiriri lumu ku buli webhook, ezisinga obuggya nga ze zisooka, luraga olubaawo, nannyini, erinnya, endagiriro, ekika, oba ekola oba ezikiziddwa, ebikolwa ki by'eweereza, oba token eteekeddwawo, ne lwe yayongerwako. Sengejja Webhooks zonna, Ezikola oba Ezizikiziddwa, era onoonye ne Enter. Tokens n'ebigambo ebyekusifu tebiragibwa n'akatono. Nyiga omutwe gw'olubaawo okuggulawo olubaawo n'okukyusiza eyo webhook yaalwo, ate webhooks ez'omukutu gwonna ziri mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya / Entegeka / Webhooks ez'omukutu gwonna.
help-admin-problems-boards-what-it-is-de: Kiraga buli lubaawo ku seva n'okulabika kwalwo, abamemba, ebibiina ne ttiimu. Kiddamu embaawo ki eziriwo, ani asobola okulaba buli lumu n'ani aluliko, nga toggulawo buli lubaawo.
help-admin-problems-boards-how-it-works-: Buli lunyiriri luraga omutwe, id, olukusa, oba olubaawo luli mu tterekero, abamemba abakola, n'ebibiina ne ttiimu lwe lugabanibwa nabyo. Wandiika ekitundu ky'omutwe onyige Enter okunoonya, oba londa Byonna, Kya bonna, Abakozesa abayingidde oba Kya kyama wansi w'Olukusa; byombi bitandika nate okuva ku lupapula olusooka. Tambula mu mpapula n'amappeesa ekyasooka n'ekiddako. Tewali kisobola kukyusibwa wano.
help-admin-problems-cards-what-it-is-des: Kiraga buli kaadi ku seva, w'eri n'ani agiriko, ku mbaawo zonna ne bw'oba oli memba oba nedda. Kiddamu ekaadi w'eri n'abamemba baayo n'abaweereddwa omulimu be baani, nga toggulawo mbaawo emu ku emu.
help-admin-problems-cards-how-it-works-d: Buli lunyiriri luraga omutwe gw'ekaadi, olubaawo lwayo, akakubo n'olukalala, n'amannya g'abakozesa ab'abamemba baayo n'abaweereddwa omulimu. Wandiika ekitundu ky'omutwe onyige Enter okunoonya, ekitandika nate okuva ku lupapula olusooka, era otambule mu mpapula n'amappeesa ekyasooka n'ekiddako. Tewali kisobola kukyusibwa wano.
help-admin-problems-recovery-what-it-is-: We wali w'okuuma database nga temuli bulabe era w'omaliriza omulimu ogwayimirira wakati. Kiraga ebyafaayo by'okukebera database, kopi-ey'obukuumi n'okuzzaawo, era kikukkiriza okusalawo ekibaawo ku imeyilo ezisibiddwa, obubaka, imeyilo z'amateeka, emirimu gy'okukwataganya enkalala n'okuyingiza embaawo okwasalibwako.
help-admin-problems-recovery-how-it-work: Okuva waggulu olaba amappeesa g'okukebera fayiro, oluvannyuma ebitundu nga olunyiriri lw'okutuusa imeyilo, obubaka bw'ebikolwa obulindiridde, imeyilo z'amateeka, emirimu gy'okukwataganya enkalala n'okuyingiza okwasalibwako, buli kimu n'amappeesa nga Yimiriza, Ddamu, Gezaako nate, Suula oba Kuuma. Kakasa ng'obuuziddwa, era omulimu bwe guba mu kukolebwa, nyiga Zza buggya ogezeeko nate. Tabbulu wansi ewandiika buli kibaddewo eky'okuzzaawo n'ekisalibwawo; laga Byonna, Ebimaliriziddwa, Ebyalemereddwa oba Ebisaziddwamu era onoonye ne Enter.
help-admin-problems-offices-what-it-is-d: Kibala okuyingira okwatuuka ku buwanguzi okusinziira ku muntu n'endagiriro, olabe buli akawunti gy'eyingirira n'endagiriro ki akawunti eziwera ze zigabana. Endagiriro egabanibwa eyinza okuba ofiisi, VPN oba omukutu ogugabanibwa; tekakasa nti akawunti muntu omu.
help-admin-problems-offices-how-it-works: Abantu baragibwa omu ku omu, buli omu n'olunyiriri ku buli ndagiriro: IPv4, IPv6, okuyingira okusooka n'okusembayo, omuwendo gw'okuyingira, n'ekifo proxy eri mu maaso ga WeKan bw'ekiwa. Wandiika erinnya ly'omukozesa, erinnya lyonna, endagiriro oba ekifo onyige Enter okunoonya, era otambule mu mpapula n'amappeesa ekyasooka n'ekiddako. Tewali kiziyizibwa olwa lipoota eno, kale endagiriro egabanibwa teggalira bantu bweru n'akatono.
help-admin-problems-api-what-it-is-descr: Kiraga endpoints za REST API ki ezikozesebwa, ani azikozesa n'emirundi emeka. Ebitundu ebirala bigamba ekyakyamu; kino kigamba seva ky'esabibwa okukola. Ku seva REST API gy'etakoleezeddwa, kisigala nga kikalu.
help-admin-problems-api-how-it-works-des: Buli lunyiriri ye akawunti ne endpoint, ezisinga okukozesebwa nga ze zisooka: omuwendo gw'okuyita, lwe yasooka ne lwe yasembayo okuyitibwa, n'endagiriro ezisembayo eza IPv4 ne IPv6 n'ekifo kyazo. Erinnya ly'omukozesa ekkalu litegeeza okuyita okuva ku muntu atalina akawunti, amanyibwa okuyita mu ndagiriro. Wandiika endpoint, enkola, erinnya ly'omukozesa oba endagiriro okusengejja ng'owandiika, era otambule mu nnyiriri 10 omulundi gumu.
help-admin-problems-database-what-it-is-: Kinnyonnyola database kye yagamba. Ensobi okuva mu MongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB oba SAP HANA mu bulijjo ewandiikibwa abazimbi baayo, kale ekitundu kino kituuma database, kisengeka ekizibu mu kika nga disiki, okuyingira, enkozesa y'ebigambo oba ekiseera okuggwaako, era ne kyongerako ennyinnyonnyola enyangu n'omutendera oguddako.
help-admin-problems-database-how-it-work: Ennyiriri ziragibwa ezisinga obuggya nga ze zisooka. Ebikwata ku kyo bigamba ekizibu kye kitegeeza n'eky'okukola, nga biddirirwa obubaka bwa database bwennyini, era empagi endala ziraga database, ekika, obulabe, omulimu, ani era okuva wa bwe kimanyibwa, n'emirundi emeka. Okunoonya kusengejja ng'owandiika, nga mw'otwalidde ebigambo bya database byennyini. Bwe kimala okukolebwako, kkiriza oba sangula ku Bizibu / Omugatte.
help-admin-problems-integrity-what-it-is: Kiraga oba seva eno yayimirira bulungi, ekyagimenya, era oba kopi-ey'obukuumi ey'olubeerera yalemererwa, wamu n'amappeesa ge gamu ag'okukebera fayiro nga mu Lipoota ya Fayiro. Tunuulira wano oluvannyuma lw'okuggwaako okutasuubirwa.
help-admin-problems-integrity-how-it-wor: Olunyiriri luwandiikibwa ku kuddamu okutandika awatali kuyimirira bulungi, ng'okuddamu okutandika okw'amangu seva bwe yakomawo mu ddakiika ssatu oba okumenyeka bwe yamala ebbanga eddene ng'ennyimiridde, ku nsobi etakwatiddwa n'obubaka bwayo, ne kopi-ey'obukuumi ey'olubeerera bw'elemererwa. Ennyiriri zisinga obuggya nga ze zisooka, 10 ku lupapula, era okunoonya kusengejja ng'owandiika. Amappeesa g'okukebera fayiro waggulu tegakyusa fayiro wadde ekiwandiiko. Kkiriza oba sangula ku Bizibu / Omugatte.
help-admin-cloud-what-it-is-description: Cloud Panel lwe lupapula lw'addukanya hosting olw'okuddukanya domains za WeKan nnyingi eza bakasitoma okuva mu kifo kimu: ennaku zaazo, databases, invoyisi, tikiti z'obuyambi ne chat, ebiwandiiko bya DNS n'amakubo ga web server. Lubaawo bwokka entegeka za seva bwe zirukoleeza ku domain yaayo, era abaddukanya b'omukutu bokka eyo, Cloud Admins, be balulaba.
help-admin-cloud-how-it-works-descriptio: Yongerako domains za bakasitoma n'ennaku zaazo n'oba buli emu erina WeKan yaayo ne database oba egabana eno, gezesa okukwatagana kwa database, era owandiike invoyisi. Buli domain efuna olubaawo lw'obuyambi olwa tikiti ne chat. Kebera era ozze buggya ebiwandiiko bya DNS, tikka amakubo ga web server, era olage endagiriro ezikkirizibwa okussa ekkomo ku Cloud Admins we bayinza okuyingirira. Bakasitoma bayingira okulaba domain yaabwe.
help-all-boards-what-it-is-description: Embaawo zonna lwe lupapula oluraga embaawo zo. Menu ey'oku kkono erondawo embaawo ki ezirabika, nga Agalina emmunyeenye, Ezisigadde, Awaka, Ebyokulabirako, Tterekero, ekifo ky'okukoleramu oba ekibiina oba ttiimu, ate olunyiriri lw'omutwe lulina okusengeka, okunoonya, okufulumya n'Okulonda ebingi.
help-all-boards-how-it-works-description: Nyiga ekitundu mu menu ey'oku kkono oluvannyuma olubaawo okuluggulawo. Kozesa Tegeka Embaawo ku nsengeka y'okusika ey'obwannannyini oba okusinziira ku mutwe, ne menu y'endaba okukyusa wakati w'obubonero bw'embaawo ne tabbulu. Koleeza Okulonda ebingi era okebere embaawo okuzitwala mu tterekero, okuzikoppa, okuzifulumya oba okuteekawo emu ng'olubaawo lwo olw'Awaka, oba sika olubaawo ku Tterekero.
help-workload-what-it-is-description: Workload ne capacity biraga, wiiki ku wiiki, buli muntu omulimu gw'alina bwe gwenkana bw'ogeraageranya n'essaawa z'alina, ku buli lubaawo lw'okolerako. Biraga ani alina emirimu mingi nnyo, ani yandisobodde okutwala ebisingawo, n'ekyo pulojekiti ejja kye yeetaaga nga tewali muntu atuumiddwa.
help-workload-how-it-works-description: Londa wiiki esooka, wiiki mmeka n'oba olaga essaawa oba story points, oluvannyuma onyige wiiki okulaba amakaadi gaayo. Wiiki ezirina omulimu omungi okusinga essaawa zimyufu. Teekawo ebiseera byo eby'okukola, obukugu n'obutabaawo, abaddukanya b'olubaawo bongerako okugabibwa n'ebifo by'emirimu, era abaddukanya b'omukutu bongerako ennaku z'eggandaalo ez'olukale.
help-billing-what-it-is-description: Bajeti n'okusasuza we wali abaddukanya b'olubaawo we bateekateekera era we basasuzza omulimu gw'olubaawo: bajeti yaalwo, omulimu kye gwasaasaanya n'ekye gulisaasaanya, emiwendo gya buli ssaawa, ebisaasaanyizibwa, ensasula ezigere, ebiteeso by'omuwendo n'invoyisi, nga byesigamiziddwa ku biseera ebigobereddwa ku makaadi.
help-billing-how-it-works-description: Londa ensimbi n'emiwendo gya buli ssaawa ku buli memba n'ogwa bulijjo ogw'olubaawo, teekawo bajeti, era oyongereko ebisaasaanyizibwa n'ensasula. Ebiseera ebiwandiikiddwa ku makaadi olwo biragibwa ng'ebikozeseddwa n'ebilagulwa bw'ogeraageranya ne bajeti. Bw'oyagala kakasa ebiseera nga tonnakola invoyisi. Jjuza ebikukwatako ng'akola invoyisi omulundi gumu, oluvannyuma okole invoyisi ez'ekiseera, oziwanule, ozibonere nti ziweerezeddwa era owandiike ensasula, oba okole ekiteeso ky'omuwendo ku mulimu ogukyasigadde okukolebwa.
gitea-not-configured: Tewali kifo kya Gitea kiteekeddwawo. Teekawo GITEA_APP_INI ku lupapula lw'Entegeka.
gitea-not-local: Tekiri ku disiki ya wano, kale tekipimiddwa:
gitea-not-sqlite: Omi asoma Gitea ekozesa SQLite yokka. Gitea eno ekozesa:
gitea-read-only: Empapula zino zisoma ekifo kya Gitea kyokka; tewali kino ekikikyusa wano.
gitea-tree: Olukalala lwa tree -s olw'ekifo kya Gitea, kya kwelonda
gitea-delete: Sazaamu omukozesa ono oba ekibiina kino
gitea-dry-run: Tewali kikyusiddwa; kino kye kusazaamu kwandikoze.
gitea-delete-plan: Okusazaamu kuggyawo ennyiriri zino ne fayiro zino:
gitea-delete-confirm: Kino kisazaamu omukozesa oba ekibiina, etterekero lyakyo n'ebikwata byabwe byonna okuva mu kifo kya Gitea emirembe gyonna. Wandiika erinnya okugenda mu maaso:
gitea-delete-wrong-name: Erinnya eriwandiikiddwa si lya nnannyini. Tewali kisaziddwamu.
gitea-running: Gitea ekola. Sooka ogiyimirize: Omi awandiika mu Gitea eyimiriziddwa yokka.
gitea-backup-first: Sooka kopi-ey'obukuumi: kopi ya github-to-gitea ey'nnannyini ono, okuva ku GitHub okudda mu BACKUPS_DIR. Okusazaamu kugenda mu maaso nga kopi eyise bulungi yokka.
gitea-no-backup: Tewali kopi ya github-to-gitea ey'nnannyini ono mu BACKUPS_DIR.
gitea-import-help: Kiyingiza ekibiina kya GitHub oba omukozesa, oba ebimu ku tterekero lyakyo, butereevu mu kifo kya Gitea: git, ensonga, okusaba okusika, ebiteeso, obubonero, emitendera, ebifulumizibwa n'ebiyungiddwako. Gitea erina okuba nga eyimiriziddwa. Gizzeemu okuleeta ebipya oba ebikyuse byokka.
gitea-github-token: Akabonero ka GitHub, katerekebwa mu fayiro era tekalagibwa n'akatono
gitea-token-rejected: GitHub tekkiriza kabonero: kakyamu, kaggwaako oba kasaziddwamu. Tereka akapya mu Entegeka.
gitea-job-stop-requested: Kiyimirizibwa: omulimu gujja kuyimirira nga tegunnasaba GitHub omulundi oguddako.
gitea-bad-name: Eryo si linnya lituufu lya nnannyini oba tterekero.
gitea-doer: Omukozesa wa Gitea okuyingiza kukolebwa mu linnya lye
gitea-sync-exclude-file: olukalala lw'ebitereke github-to-gitea ne Omi bye bitakyesigika
gitea-delete-repo: Sazaamu tereka lino ne fayiro zaalyo
gitea-delete-repo-confirm: Kino kisazaamu tereka, wiki yaalyo ne data yaalyo yonna okuva mu kifo kya Gitea emirembe gyonna. Wandiika owner/name okugenda mu maaso:
gitea-delete-repo-wrong-name: Erinnya eriwandiikiddwa si owner/name lya tereka. Tewali kisaziddwamu.
gitea-exclude-too: Era kigyeko ku kwesigika, kwesigika okuddako kuleme kukizzaayo
gitea-packages-unlinked: Ebipapula ebikigattiddwako bisigala ne nnannyini, nga tebigattiddwa:
gitea-index-stale: Kikadde okuva ku kusazaamu: pima nate okufuna obunene obutuufu.
gitea-db-migration-version: Enkyusa y'okusengula tterekero ly'ebikwata erya Gitea
gitea-orphans-delete-confirm: Kino kisazaamu emirembe gyonna okuva mu kifo kya Gitea fayiro bamulekwa ezitakozesebwa kintu kyonna mu tterekero ly'ebikwata, n'ennyiriri z'omu tterekero ly'ebikwata ezibuzeeko fayiro zaazo. Buli kikozesebwa mu kiseera we kisazibwamu kikuumibwa. Wandiika omuwendo gwa bamulekwa okugenda mu maaso:
gitea-orphans-delete-wrong-number: Ennamba ewandiikiddwa si gwe muwendo gwa bamulekwa. Tewali kisaziddwamu.
